<!--
LIFE BILLING V2 — ERROR CLEANUP BUILD
Build: 2026-09-16

Changes:
- Prevents HTTP 417 when Loan Consent Video is written to a submitted
  Payment Entry. The field is updated only while Payment Entry is Draft.
- Removes calls to nonexistent lifescc.billing.send_wati endpoint.
- Receipt popup now offers explicit “Send WhatsApp” via wa.me.
- Repeated success logs moved from console.info to console.debug where found.
- Existing L1/L2/L3 validation, approval rendering, date format,
  stock warning and Pricing Rule fixes are preserved.

Note:
- Highlight.js initHighlighting deprecation comes from Frappe/site assets
  and is not a Billing failure.
-->
<!--
LIFE BILLING V2 — L2/L3 DISCOUNT VALIDATION FIX
Build: 2026-09-16

Fixes:
- Request Discount modal now loads complete approval history using
  lifeLoadInvoiceDiscountRequests(), same as the Bill drawer.
- Branch users can no longer re-request an L2/L3 level that is already
  Pending or Approved but hidden by direct browser permissions.
- Submit rechecks the latest approval state immediately before creation.
- Per-level validation: 0.5% to 5%.
- Cumulative L1 + L2 + L3 hard cap: 15%.
- If L1/L2/L3 are all already used, the modal clearly states that no
  additional normal approval request can be raised.
- Existing approval date format DD-MMM-YY h:mm am/pm preserved.
- Existing stock-warning, pricing-rule, payment and Billing logic preserved.
-->
<!--
LIFE BILLING V2 — FULL REWRITTEN DATE DISPLAY BUILD
Build: 2026-09-16
Approval timestamp display: DD-MMM-YY h:mm am/pm
Example: 16-Sep-26 6:10 pm
Stored ERP timestamps remain unchanged.
All previous approval-render reset, bootstrap merge, stock-warning,
Pricing Rule, Billing, payment and UI functionality is preserved.
-->
<!--
LIFE BILLING V2 — APPROVAL RENDER RESET AS BEFORE
Build: 2026-09-16
Approval behaviour:
1. Direct Discount Approval Request getList restored as the first source.
2. Existing bootstrap discount_requests is merged when available.
3. No false "No discount requested" message while approval rows are loading.
4. Existing calculation, stock warning, pricing-rule and Billing functionality preserved.
-->
<!--
LIFE BILLING V2 — FULL REWRITTEN WEB PAGE
Build: 2026-09-16
Includes:
- stock receipt warning only (Billing never blocked)
- Close enabled after 10 seconds; no auto-close
- compact fixed/scrolling subtotal layout
- long package-name summary handling
- working secondary client search
- complimentary dropdown mousedown selection
- complete approval workflow via existing lifescc.billing.bootstrap
- compatibility approval fallback for older bootstrap
- approval actions preserve sibling workflow rows
- dynamic Pricing Rule loader waits for frappe.call
- hardened global call() wrapper
-->
<script id="life-email-early-route-v11">
(function () {
    try {
        var p = new URLSearchParams(
            window.location.search || ""
        );

        if (
            p.get("invoice") &&
            p.get("request")
        ) {
            /*
             * Email deep link takes priority over saved tab.
             */
            localStorage.setItem(
                "life_billing_active_view_v1",
                "recent"
            );
        }
    } catch (error) {}
})();
</script>








<style>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LIFE CLINICS — BILLING MODULE (Green & White Theme)
   Pure billing: Search → Summary → Collect / New Bill →
   Preview → Invoice · Recent Bills · Pending Bills
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{max-width:100%;overflow-x:hidden}
:root{
  --g0:#053B2A;--g1:#0B6B4A;--g2:#0F8A5F;--g3:#16A34A;--g4:#22C55E;
  --gbg:#F2FAF6;--gbg2:#E7F6EE;--gline:#D2EADC;
  --card:#FFFFFF;--border:#DCEDE4;--border2:#BBDCCB;
  --txt:#14352A;--txt2:#33574A;--txt3:#5F8272;--txt4:#8FAEA1;
  --red:#DC2626;--red-bg:#FEF2F2;--red-bd:#FCA5A5;--red-dk:#991B1B;
  --amber:#D97706;--amber-bg:#FFFBEB;--amber-bd:#FCD34D;
  --blue:#2563EB;--blue-bg:#EFF6FF;--blue-bd:#BFDBFE;
  --purple:#7C3AED;--purple-bg:#F5F3FF;--purple-bd:#C4B5FD;
  --sh:0 1px 4px rgba(11,107,74,.08);--sh2:0 5px 22px rgba(11,107,74,.14);--sh3:0 14px 48px rgba(5,59,42,.22);
  --r:10px;--r2:14px;
}
html,body{height:100%;font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;background:var(--gbg);color:var(--txt)}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px;height:6px}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(11,107,74,.25);border-radius:3px}
input,select,textarea,button{font-family:inherit}
.money{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:700}

/* ── TOPBAR ── */
.topbar{
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--g0),var(--g1) 45%,var(--g2));
  height:58px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;

  /* reserve space for Portal fullscreen back button */
  padding:0 18px 0 58px;

  gap:12px;

  position:sticky;
  top:0;
  z-index:300;

  box-shadow:0 3px 16px rgba(5,59,42,.35);
}
.logo-box{background:#fff;border-radius:9px;width:38px;height:38px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0}
.brand{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.2px}
.brand-sub{font-size:9.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);letter-spacing:.5px}
.nav-pills{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-left:0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nav-pill{padding:6px 15px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.nav-pill:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff}
.nav-pill.active{background:#fff;color:var(--g1);border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.scope-sel{height:32px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;padding:0 10px;cursor:pointer;outline:none;margin-left:auto}
.scope-sel option{color:var(--txt);background:#fff}
#clock{font-size:10.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* ── VIEWS ── */
.view{display:none}.view.active{display:block}
.wrap{
    max-width:1500px;
    width:100%;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:16px 20px;
    overflow-x:hidden;
}
/* ── SEARCH HERO ── */
.hero{
    background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--g0),var(--g1) 55%,var(--g2));

    /* increased vertical height */
    padding:45px 24px 50px;

    position:relative;
    overflow:visible;

    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
}
.hero-clip{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.hero-clip::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-90px;right:-70px;width:280px;height:280px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}
.hero-clip::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-70px;left:26%;width:220px;height:220px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}
.hero-title{
    font-size:22px;
    font-weight:900;
    color:#fff;
    text-align:center;
    position:relative;
    z-index:1;
    margin-bottom:24px;
    line-height:1.2;
}
.hero-sub{font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);text-align:center;margin:4px 0 20px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.search-wrap{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    max-width:700px;
    margin:0 auto;
    z-index:250;
}
.search-input{width:100%;height:54px;padding:0 120px 0 52px;border:2.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:27px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff;font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600;outline:none;transition:all .2s}
.search-input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);font-weight:400}
.search-input:focus{border-color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.search-icon{position:absolute;left:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:20px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);pointer-events:none}
.search-btn{position:absolute;right:7px;top:7px;height:40px;padding:0 22px;border-radius:22px;background:#fff;border:none;color:var(--g1);font-size:13px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.search-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.search-dd{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:var(--r2);box-shadow:var(--sh3);display:none;overflow:hidden;max-height:340px;overflow-y:auto;z-index:260}
.search-dd.show{display:block;animation:ddIn .15s ease}
@keyframes ddIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.sd-item{padding:11px 16px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;transition:background .1s}
.sd-item:hover{background:var(--gbg2)}
.sd-av{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0}
.sd-name{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--g0)}
.sd-meta{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--txt3);margin-top:2px}
.sd-right{margin-left:auto;text-align:right}
.sd-empty{padding:20px;text-align:center;color:var(--txt4)}

/* ── KPI ── */
.kpi-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:12px;margin:0 0 16px}
.kpi{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
@media(max-width:900px){.kpi-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.kpi{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:var(--sh);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.kpi::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:4px}
.kpi-green::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--g2),var(--g4))}
.kpi-red::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red),#F87171)}
.kpi-amber::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--amber),#FBBF24)}
.kpi-blue::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),#60A5FA)}
.kpi-ic{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:6px}
.kpi-val{font-size:32px;font-weight:900;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1}
.kpi-green .kpi-val{color:var(--g2)}.kpi-red .kpi-val{color:var(--red)}.kpi-amber .kpi-val{color:var(--amber)}.kpi-blue .kpi-val{color:var(--blue)}
.kpi-lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--txt4);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;margin-top:5px}
.kpi-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--txt3);margin-top:2px}

/* ── CARDS / SECTIONS ── */
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r2);box-shadow:var(--sh);overflow:hidden}
.card-hdr{padding:11px 16px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FBFEFC,#F4FBF7)}
.card-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;font-weight:900;color:var(--g0)}
.empty{padding:34px;text-align:center;color:var(--txt4);font-size:14px}
.empty-ic{font-size:38px;margin-bottom:8px}
/* Billing landing empty section — fit fully in viewport */
#v-billing #stage .empty{
    padding:18px 20px 20px;
}

#v-billing #stage .empty-ic{
    font-size:32px;
    margin-bottom:4px;
}

/* ── BADGES / BUTTONS ── */
.badge{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:11px;display:inline-block;white-space:nowrap}
.bg-green{background:#E7F8EF;color:var(--g1);border:1px solid #A7E3C4}
.bg-red{background:var(--red-bg);color:var(--red-dk);border:1px solid var(--red-bd)}
.bg-amber{background:var(--amber-bg);color:#92400E;border:1px solid var(--amber-bd)}
.bg-blue{background:var(--blue-bg);color:#1E40AF;border:1px solid var(--blue-bd)}
.bg-purple{background:var(--purple-bg);color:#4C1D95;border:1px solid var(--purple-bd)}
.bg-grey{background:#F1F5F3;color:var(--txt3);border:1px solid var(--border2)}
.btn{border:none;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;height:38px;padding:0 16px;transition:all .15s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;justify-content:center}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
.btn:active{transform:none}
.btn-sm{height:32px;padding:0 12px;font-size:13px;border-radius:7px}
.btn-green{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--g1),var(--g3));color:#fff}
.btn-white{background:#fff;color:var(--g1);border:1.5px solid var(--border2)}
.btn-white:hover{border-color:var(--g2)}
.btn-red{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#B91C1C,var(--red));color:#fff}
.btn-amber{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#B45309,var(--amber));color:#fff}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--txt3);border:1px dashed var(--border2)}
.btn:disabled,.btn.locked{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none!important;box-shadow:none!important}

/* ── FORMS ── */
.f-lbl{font-size:13px;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-weight:800;color:var(--txt3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.f-inp,.f-sel{width:100%;height:40px;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:8px;padding:0 12px;font-size:15px;color:var(--txt);background:#fff;outline:none;transition:border .15s}
.f-inp:focus,.f-sel:focus{border-color:var(--g2);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(15,138,95,.12)}
textarea.f-inp{height:auto;padding:8px 10px;resize:vertical}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:10px}
.grid4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px}
.req{color:var(--red)}
@media(max-width:760px){.grid3,.grid4{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}

/* ── TABLES ── */
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13.5px}
.tbl th{background:#F2FAF6;color:var(--txt3);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;padding:11px 12px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--border);white-space:nowrap}
.tbl td{padding:11px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);vertical-align:middle}
.tbl tr:hover td{background:#FAFDFB}

/* ── CLIENT SUMMARY ── */
.cs-head{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--g0),var(--g1) 50%,var(--g2));border-radius:var(--r2);padding:18px 20px;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;color:#fff;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
.cs-av{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:var(--g1);background:#fff;flex-shrink:0;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
.inv-row{border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);margin-bottom:10px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.inv-head{padding:11px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;cursor:pointer;flex-wrap:wrap;transition:background .12s}
.inv-head:hover{background:#FAFDFB}
.inv-body{display:none;border-top:1.5px dashed var(--border);padding:12px 14px;background:#FBFEFC}
.inv-row.open .inv-body{display:block}
.inv-row.open .chev{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.chev{transition:transform .15s;color:var(--txt4);font-size:12px}
.due-strip{background:var(--red-bg);border:1.5px solid var(--red-bd);border-radius:var(--r);padding:10px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* ── BILLING WORKSPACE ── */
.bill-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 360px;gap:14px;align-items:start}
.bill-grid>*{min-width:0}
@media(max-width:900px){.bill-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.b-sec{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r2);margin-bottom:12px;overflow:visible;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.b-sec-hdr{padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FBFEFC,#F2FAF6);border-radius:var(--r2) var(--r2) 0 0}
.b-num{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--g1);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
.b-sec-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--g0)}
.b-body{padding:14px 16px}
.tp-row{border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px;background:#FBFEFC;position:relative}
.tp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2.2fr .7fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 30px;gap:10px;align-items:end}
@media(max-width:860px){.tp-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.tp-cats{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.tp-range{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--txt3);margin-top:3px;font-weight:600}
.tp-range b{color:var(--g1)}
.tp-dd{position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:var(--sh3);z-index:60;max-height:260px;overflow-y:auto;display:none}
.tp-dd.show{display:block}
.tp-dd-item{padding:9px 13px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.tp-dd-item:hover{background:var(--gbg2)}
.rate-warn{border-color:var(--red)!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(220,38,38,.12)!important}
.del-btn{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--red-bd);background:var(--red-bg);color:var(--red);cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:900}
.del-btn:hover{background:var(--red);color:#fff}

/* validity */
.val-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F0FDF4,#ECFDF5);border:1.5px solid #A7E3C4;border-radius:var(--r);padding:12px 14px}
.val-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #C8EAD6}
.val-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}

/* discount */
.toggle{position:relative;width:44px;height:24px;flex-shrink:0}
.toggle input{opacity:0;width:0;height:0}
.tg-slider{position:absolute;cursor:pointer;inset:0;background:#CBD5D1;border-radius:24px;transition:.2s}
.tg-slider:before{content:'';position:absolute;height:18px;width:18px;left:3px;top:3px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;transition:.2s;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.toggle input:checked + .tg-slider{background:var(--g3)}
.toggle input:checked + .tg-slider:before{transform:translateX(20px)}
.disc-body{display:none;margin-top:12px}
.disc-body.show{display:block}
.appr-step{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:9px 12px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;margin-bottom:8px;background:#fff}
.appr-step.done{border-color:#A7E3C4;background:#F0FDF4}
.appr-step.pend{border-color:var(--amber-bd);background:var(--amber-bg)}

/* payments */
.pay-modes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
@media(max-width:760px){.pay-modes{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.pm-card{border:2px solid var(--border2);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 6px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;background:#fff;position:relative}
.pm-card:hover{border-color:var(--g2)}
.pm-card.active{border-color:var(--g1);background:var(--g1)}
.pm-card.active .pm-ic,.pm-card.active .pm-lbl{color:#fff}
.pm-card.disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:not-allowed;background:#F6F8F7}
.pm-ic{font-size:19px;display:block}
.pm-lbl{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--txt2);display:block;margin-top:4px}
.pm-note{position:absolute;top:-7px;right:-5px;font-size:12px}
.pay-fields{border:1.5px dashed var(--border2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:12px;margin-top:10px;background:#FBFEFC;display:none}
.pay-fields.show{display:block}
.loan-block{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F5F3FF,#FAF5FF);border:1.5px solid var(--purple-bd)}
.lsc{border:1.5px solid var(--purple-bd);border-radius:9px;padding:9px 10px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;text-align:center;transition:all .12s}
.lsc:hover{border-color:var(--purple)}
.lsc.sel{background:var(--purple);border-color:var(--purple)}
.lsc.sel *{color:#fff!important}
.lsc-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#4C1D95}
.lsc-rate{font-size:10px;color:var(--txt3);margin-top:2px}
.loan-warn{background:var(--red-bg);border:1.5px solid var(--red-bd);border-radius:9px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--red-dk);margin-top:10px}
.split-line{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr 1.2fr 34px;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;align-items:end;min-width:0}
.split-line>div{min-width:0}

/* ── RAZORPAY (online collection inside the Collect drawer) ── */
.rzp-box{border:1.5px solid #BFD9FF;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F6FAFF,#EEF5FF);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-top:10px}
.rzp-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:9px}
.rzp-logo{font-size:14px;font-weight:900;color:#0B3C8D;letter-spacing:.2px}

<script>
'use strict';
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LIFE CLINICS — BILLING MODULE · LIVE DATA LAYER (v13 · Razorpay)
   Runs inside a Frappe Custom HTML Block. Reads/writes go through
   frappe.call → Server Scripts (API type). No mock data.

   FLOW:  Patient (client) → Therapy Plan → Sales Invoice → Payment Entry
   NEW:   Collect Due Amount → mode "Razorpay" → Pay Now (Checkout SDK),
          hosted payment link + QR, and WhatsApp payment link (WATI).
          Backed by life_slimming/razorpay_payment.py.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── DOM root resolution ── */
var ROOT = document;
var REC_DATE_FIELD_KEY='life_recent_datefield_v1';
(function(){
  try{
    var cs = document.currentScript;
    if(cs && cs.getRootNode){
      var rn = cs.getRootNode();
      if(rn && rn.getElementById && rn.getElementById('app')) ROOT = rn;
    }
  }catch(e){}
  if(!(ROOT.getElementById && ROOT.getElementById('app')) &&
     document.getElementById('app')) ROOT = document;
})();
function _q(sel){ return (ROOT.querySelector && ROOT.querySelector(sel)) || document.querySelector(sel); }
function _g(id){ var e = ROOT.getElementById ? ROOT.getElementById(id) : ROOT.querySelector('#'+id); return e || document.getElementById(id); }
function _s(id,h){ var e=_g(id); if(e)e.innerHTML=h; }
function _t(id,t){ var e=_g(id); if(e)e.textContent=t; }
function _v(id){ var e=_g(id); return e?e.value:''; }
function _all(sel){ var n=(ROOT&&ROOT.querySelectorAll)?ROOT.querySelectorAll(sel):null; return (n&&n.length)?n:document.querySelectorAll(sel); }

/* ── formatting ── */
function today(){ try{ if(typeof frappe!=='undefined' && frappe.datetime && frappe.datetime.get_today) return frappe.datetime.get_today(); }catch(e){} return new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]; }

/*
 * Approval timeline display only.
 * ERP value is NOT modified; this only changes what the Billing UI shows.
 * Example: 2026-09-16 18:10:00 -> 16-Sep-26 6:10 pm
 */
function lifeFmtApprovalDateTime(value){

  if(!value){
    return '';
  }

  var raw=String(value).trim();

  /*
   * Frappe timestamps normally arrive as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.
   * Parse manually so the displayed clock value is not shifted by
   * browser timezone conversion.
   */
  var match=raw.match(
    /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})(?:[ T](\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?)?/
  );

  if(!match){
    return raw;
  }

  var year=match[1];
  var month=parseInt(match[2],10);
  var day=match[3];
  var hour=parseInt(match[4]||'0',10);
  var minute=match[5]||'00';

  var months=[
    'Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun',
    'Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'
  ];

  var monthName=months[month-1];

  if(!monthName){
    return raw;
  }

  var shortYear=String(year).slice(-2);

  if(!match[4]){
    return day+'-'+monthName+'-'+shortYear;
  }

  var ampm=hour>=12 ? 'pm' : 'am';
  var hour12=hour%12;

  if(hour12===0){
    hour12=12;
  }

  return (
    day+
    '-'+monthName+
    '-'+shortYear+
    ' '+hour12+
    ':'+minute+
    ' '+ampm
  );
}
function fmtM(n){ n=parseFloat(n||0); return '₹'+n.toLocaleString('en-IN',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}); }
function buildCostBreakdownHtml(sellingPrice, doc){
  doc = doc || {};
  var productCost = parseFloat(doc.custom_product_cost||0);
  var clinicalCost = parseFloat(doc.custom_clinical_operational_cost||0);
  var gstAmount = parseFloat(doc.total_taxes_and_charges||0);
  var totalCost = parseFloat(doc.custom_total_cost||0) || (productCost+clinicalCost+gstAmount);
  var netProfit = parseFloat(doc.custom_net_profit||0) || (sellingPrice-totalCost);
  function pct(a){ return sellingPrice ? ((a/sellingPrice)*100).toFixed(2) : '0.00'; }
  return '<div style="margin-top:10px"><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--g0);margin-bottom:6px">Cost Justification</div>'+
    '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px">'+
      '<tr style="background:var(--gbg2)"><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border)">Final Selling Price</td><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right;font-weight:800">'+fmtM(sellingPrice)+'</td><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right">100%</td></tr>'+
      '<tr><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border)">Product Cost</td><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right">'+fmtM(productCost)+'</td><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right">'+pct(productCost)+'%</td></tr>'+
      '<tr><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border)">Clinical & Operational Cost</td><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right">'+fmtM(clinicalCost)+'</td><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right">'+pct(clinicalCost)+'%</td></tr>'+
      '<tr><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border)">GST</td><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right">'+fmtM(gstAmount)+'</td><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right">'+pct(gstAmount)+'%</td></tr>'+
      '<tr style="background:var(--gbg2);font-weight:800"><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border)">Total Cost</td><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right">'+fmtM(totalCost)+'</td><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right">'+pct(totalCost)+'%</td></tr>'+
      '<tr style="background:#F0FDF4;font-weight:800"><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #BBF7D0;color:#065F46">Net Profit</td><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #BBF7D0;text-align:right;color:#059669">'+fmtM(netProfit)+'</td><td style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #BBF7D0;text-align:right;color:#059669">'+pct(netProfit)+'%</td></tr>'+
    '</table>'+
    '<div style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--txt3);margin-top:4px">Reflects this invoice\'s actual figures, not a fixed industry standard (benchmark for cosmetic clinics: 20–30% Clinical & Operational Cost).</div>'+

/* Generic debounce: waits `wait` ms after the last call before firing. */
function lifeDebounce(fn, wait){
  var timer=null;
  function debounced(){
    var ctx=this, args=arguments;
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer=setTimeout(function(){ fn.apply(ctx,args); }, wait);
  }
  debounced.cancel=function(){ clearTimeout(timer); timer=null; };
  return debounced;
}

/* ── frappe.call promise wrapper ── */
function call(method,args){
  return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){

    /*
     * LIFE Billing Web Page runs inside Frappe Website.
     * Some late-loaded patches can execute while the global frappe
     * object exists but frappe.call has not yet been attached.
     *
     * Never throw "frappe.call is not a function".
     * Wait briefly for the real request API and then execute.
     */
    var attempts=0;
    var maxAttempts=80;

    function executeRequest(){

      attempts+=1;

      var frappeApi=
        window.frappe &&
        typeof window.frappe.call==='function'
          ? window.frappe
          : null;

      if(!frappeApi){

        if(attempts<maxAttempts){
          window.setTimeout(
            executeRequest,
            100
          );
          return;
        }

        reject({
          message:
            'Frappe request API is not ready. Please refresh the page and try again.'
        });

        return;
      }

      busy('Please wait…');

      frappeApi.call({
        method:method,
        args:args||{},

        callback:function(r){
          unbusy();
          resolve(r&&r.message);
        },

        error:function(xhr){
          unbusy();

          var e=xhr||{};

          try{
            if(xhr && xhr.responseJSON){

              if(xhr.responseJSON._server_messages){
                e._server_messages=
                  xhr.responseJSON._server_messages;
              }

              if(xhr.responseJSON.exception){
                e.exception=
                  xhr.responseJSON.exception;
              }

              if(xhr.responseJSON.exc){
                e.exc=
                  xhr.responseJSON.exc;
              }
            }
          }catch(_){}

          reject(e);
        }
      });
    }

    executeRequest();
  });
}

/* Pull a human-readable message out of a Frappe ajax error object.
   Frappe puts the real validation text in _server_messages / exc. */
function serverErr(e){
  try{
    if(e && e._server_messages){
      var arr=JSON.parse(e._server_messages);
      if(arr && arr.length){
        var m=arr[0];
        try{ m=JSON.parse(m); }catch(_){}
        var txt=(m && m.message) ? m.message : m;
        return String(txt).replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'');   // strip html
      }
    }
    if(e && e.responseJSON && e.responseJSON.exception) return String(e.responseJSON.exception);
    if(e && e.message) return String(e.message);
    if(e && e.exc){ var s=String(e.exc).split('\n').filter(Boolean); if(s.length) return s[s.length-1]; }
  }catch(_){}
  return 'server error (check the browser console for details)';
}

/* build <option> list of payment modes; Cash first, Razorpay next.
   The Razorpay mode is ALWAYS offered even when the bootstrap does not
   return it — razorpay_payment.py creates the Mode of Payment record on
   the first online collection, so it may not exist yet. */
function modeOptions(sel){
  var list=(MODES&&MODES.length)?MODES.slice():[{name:'Cash',type:'Cash'}];
  var hasRzp=false;
  list.forEach(function(m){ if(isRazorpayMode(m.name)) hasRzp=true; });
  if(!hasRzp) list.push({name:RZP_MODE_NAME, type:'Bank'});
  list.sort(function(a,b){
    if(a.name==='Cash')return -1; if(b.name==='Cash')return 1;
    var ar=isRazorpayMode(a.name), br=isRazorpayMode(b.name);
    if(ar&&!br)return -1; if(br&&!ar)return 1;
    return a.name<b.name?-1:1;
  });
  return list.map(function(m){
    return '<option value="'+esc(m.name)+'"'+(m.name===sel?' selected':'')+'>'+
           (isRazorpayMode(m.name)?'⚡ ':'')+esc(m.name)+'</option>';
  }).join('');
}
/* Collapse duplicate practitioner IDs that share the same name+branch down to
   ONE entry — the most recently used (by last invoice) — and drop inactive
   ones. When a selected id must be preserved, it is always kept. The bootstrap
   supplies p.status ('Active'/'Disabled') and p.last_used (ISO date or ''). */
function dedupePractitioners(list, keepId){
  var best={};
  (list||[]).forEach(function(p){
    var active = (p.status===undefined) || (String(p.status).toLowerCase()==='active');
    if(!active && p.name!==keepId) return;
    var key=((p.practitioner_name||p.name||'')+'|'+(p.branch||'')).toLowerCase();
    var cur=best[key];
    if(!cur){ best[key]=p; return; }
    /* prefer the id that was used more recently; ties -> the one flagged active;
       always prefer an explicitly-kept id */
    if(p.name===keepId){ best[key]=p; return; }
    if(cur.name===keepId) return;
    var lu=String(p.last_used||''), cu=String(cur.last_used||'');
    if(lu>cu) best[key]=p;
  });
  var out=[];
  for(var k in best){ if(best.hasOwnProperty(k)) out.push(best[k]); }
  out.sort(function(a,b){ return (a.practitioner_name||'').localeCompare(b.practitioner_name||''); });
  return out;
}
/* practitioner <option> list, STRICTLY filtered by branch.
   Previously this fell back to every practitioner when a branch had none,
   which is why Head Office staff appeared under Banjara Hills. */
function practitionerOptions(branch,sel){
  var list=(PRACTITIONERS||[]).slice();
  if(branch){
    list=list.filter(function(p){ return p.branch===branch; });
    if(!list.length) return '<option value="">— No practitioner mapped to '+esc(branch)+' —</option>';
  }
  list=dedupePractitioners(list, sel);
  return '<option value="">— Select practitioner —</option>'+list.map(function(p){
    return '<option value="'+esc(p.name)+'"'+(p.name===sel?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(p.practitioner_name)+'</option>';
  }).join('');
}
/* A mode counts as "cash" (no reference needed) only when its TYPE is Cash
   AND the account it settles into is a Cash account. Modes like
   "mobile payments" are typed Cash but settle into a bank account, so they
   still need a reference / UTR. */
function isCashMode(m){
  var rec=null; (MODES||[]).forEach(function(x){ if(x.name===m)rec=x; });
  if(!rec) return m==='Cash';
  if(rec.acct_type && rec.acct_type!=='Cash') return false;   // bank-backed
  return rec.type==='Cash';
}
/* offers available for a given item_code + qty (validity + qty band) */
function offersFor(itemCode, qty){
  qty=parseFloat(qty||0);
  return OFFERS.filter(function(o){
    if(o.apply_on!=='Item Code') return false;
    if(o.item_code!==itemCode) return false;
    var mn=parseFloat(o.min_qty||0), mx=parseFloat(o.max_qty||0);
    if(mn && qty<mn) return false;
    if(mx && qty>mx) return false;
    return true;
  });
}
/* effective offer rate for an item (fixed rate, % off, or amount off base) */
function offerRate(o, baseRate){
  baseRate=parseFloat(baseRate||0);
  if(o.price_or_product_discount==='Price'){
    if(parseFloat(o.rate||0)>0) return parseFloat(o.rate);
    if(parseFloat(o.discount_percentage||0)>0) return Math.round(baseRate*(1-o.discount_percentage/100)*100)/100;
    if(parseFloat(o.discount_amount||0)>0) return Math.max(0, baseRate-parseFloat(o.discount_amount));
  }
  return baseRate;
}

var _qT;
function doSearch(q,force){
  clearTimeout(_qT);
  var dd=_g('q-dd'); if(!dd)return;
  var raw=(q||'').trim();
  if(raw.length<(force?1:3)){dd.classList.remove('show');return;}

  // decide: mobile-number search or name search
  var looksNumeric=/^[\d\s\-+()]+$/.test(raw);
  if(looksNumeric){
    var digits=raw.replace(/\D/g,'');
    if(digits.length===12 && digits.slice(0,2)==='91') digits=digits.slice(2);
    else if(digits.length===11 && digits.charAt(0)==='0') digits=digits.slice(1);
    // (only strips a genuine country-code/leading-0 prefix — a bare 10-digit
    //  number starting with 91, e.g. 9187654321, is left untouched)
    if(digits.length && !/^[6-9]/.test(digits)){
      dd.innerHTML='<div class="sd-empty">📱 Indian mobile numbers start with 6, 7, 8 or 9</div>';
      dd.classList.add('show'); return;
    }
    if(digits.length>10){
      dd.innerHTML='<div class="sd-empty">📱 A mobile number can’t be more than 10 digits</div>';
      dd.classList.add('show'); return;
    }
    if(digits.length<4 && !force){ dd.classList.remove('show'); return; }
    _qT=setTimeout(function(){ runSearch([['mobile','like','%'+digits+'%']], raw); },220);
    return;
  }
  // name search
  _qT=setTimeout(function(){ runSearch([['patient_name','like','%'+raw+'%']], raw); },220);
}
function runSearch(filters,label){
  var dd=_g('q-dd'); if(!dd)return;
  getListSilent('Patient',filters,
    ['name','patient_name','mobile','sex','custom_branch','custom_lead','status'],
    {limit:8, order_by:'modified desc'})
  .then(function(list){
    list=list||[];
    if(!list.length){
      var typed=String(label||'').trim();
      var numeric=/^[\d\s\-+()]+$/.test(typed);
      var mobile=typed.replace(/\D/g,'');
      if(mobile.length===12 && mobile.slice(0,2)==='91')mobile=mobile.slice(2);
      else if(mobile.length===11 && mobile.charAt(0)==='0')mobile=mobile.slice(1);
      var canRegister=!numeric || /^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(mobile);
      dd.innerHTML='<div class="sd-empty">😕 No client found for "'+esc(label)+'"</div>'+ 
        (canRegister
          ? '<div class="sd-item" style="background:var(--gbg2);justify-content:center" data-reg="'+esc(numeric?mobile:typed)+'">'+
            '<span style="font-weight:900;color:var(--g1)">➕ Register "'+esc(numeric?mobile:typed)+'" as a new client</span></div>'
          : '<div class="sd-empty" style="color:var(--red);font-weight:800">Enter the complete valid 10-digit mobile number to register a client.</div>');
      dd.classList.add('show');
      var rb=dd.querySelector('[data-reg]'); if(rb)rb.onclick=function(){openRegister(this.getAttribute('data-reg'));};
      return;
    }
    var names=list.map(function(p){return p.name;});
    getListSilent('Sales Invoice',[['patient','in',names],['docstatus','=',1],['outstanding_amount','>',0]],
            ['patient','outstanding_amount'],{limit:0})
    .then(function(inv){
      var dueMap={}; (inv||[]).forEach(function(i){ dueMap[i.patient]=(dueMap[i.patient]||0)+(i.outstanding_amount||0); });
      dd.innerHTML=list.map(function(p){
        var due=dueMap[p.name]||0;
        return '<div class="sd-item" data-pid="'+esc(p.name)+'">'+
          '<div class="sd-av" style="background:'+avc(p.patient_name)+'">'+ini(p.patient_name)+'</div>'+
          '<div><div class="sd-name">'+esc(p.patient_name)+'</div><div class="sd-meta">'+esc(p.name)+' · 📱 '+esc(p.mobile||'—')+' · 📍 '+esc(p.custom_branch||'—')+'</div></div>'+
          '<div class="sd-right">'+(due>0?'<span class="badge bg-red">Due '+fmtI(due)+'</span>':'<span class="badge bg-green">No dues</span>')+'</div></div>';
      }).join('');
      dd.querySelectorAll('[data-pid]').forEach(function(el){ el.onclick=function(){pickClient(this.getAttribute('data-pid'));}; });
      dd.classList.add('show');
    });
  }).catch(function(){ toast('Search failed — check portal connection','red'); });
}

function openRegister(name){
  var entered=String(name||'').trim();
  if(/^[\d\s\-+()]+$/.test(entered)){
    var enteredMobile=normMobile(entered);
    if(!/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(enteredMobile)){
      alertMsg('Enter the complete valid 10-digit mobile number before registering a client.','red');
      return;
    }
    name=enteredMobile;
  }
  resetRegisterForm();
  _g('rg-name').value=/\d{6,}/.test(name)?'':name;
  _g('rg-mobile').value=/^\d{6,}$/.test(name)?name:'';
  var sel=_g('rg-branch');
  sel.innerHTML=BRANCHES.map(function(b){return '<option'+(b===(SCOPE||USER_BRANCH)?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(b)+'</option>';}).join('');
  var emp=_g('rg-emp'); if(emp)emp.innerHTML=practitionerOptions(SCOPE||USER_BRANCH,'');
  var pn=_g('rg-pd-number'); if(pn)pn.value='';
  var pf=_g('rg-pd-file'); if(pf)pf.value='';
  var ps=_g('rg-pd-status'); if(ps){ps.textContent='Attach the client\'s PD form (image or PDF).';ps.style.color='var(--txt3)';}
  var eb=_g('rg-err'); if(eb)eb.style.display='none';
  REG_LEAD=null;

  if((_v('rg-mobile')||'').length>=10) regCheckLead();
}
function regErr(msg){ var b=_g('rg-err'); if(b){b.innerHTML='⚠️ '+esc(msg);b.style.display='block';} alertMsg(msg,'red'); }

/* When the mobile matches a Lead, the client came in through the call
   centre — pull their details and lock the source, mirroring the Desk
   "Patient - Auto Fill From Lead" script. */
/* strip non-digits and cap at 12 (91 + 10), same as the Desk script */
function regMobileInput(){
  var el=_g('rg-mobile'); if(!el)return;
  var v=(el.value||'').replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,12);
  if(el.value!==v) el.value=v;
  try{ mobileCheck(); }catch(e){}
  var clean=(v.length===12 && v.slice(0,2)==='91')?v.slice(2):v;
  if(clean.length===10) regCheckLead();
}
function normMobile(v){
  var d=String(v||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
  if(d.length===12 && d.slice(0,2)==='91') d=d.slice(2);
  return d;
}
var REG_LEAD=null;
function regCheckLead(){
  var raw=(_v('rg-mobile')||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
  if(raw.length===12 && raw.slice(0,2)==='91') raw=raw.slice(2);
  var note=_g('rg-lead-note');
  if(raw.length!==10){ REG_LEAD=null; if(note){note.innerHTML='';note.style.display='none';} return; }
  if(note){ note.style.display='block'; note.innerHTML='Checking for a matching lead…'; note.style.color='var(--txt3)'; }
  call('lifescc.billing.lead_lookup',{mobile:raw}).then(function(res){
    var ms=_g('rg-source');
    if(!res || !res.found){
      REG_LEAD=null;
      if(note){ note.innerHTML='No matching lead — treat as a walk-in / direct client.'; note.style.color='var(--txt3)'; }
      if(ms)ms.disabled=false;
      return;
    }
    REG_LEAD=res;
    if(res.patient_name && !(_v('rg-name')||'').trim()) _g('rg-name').value=res.patient_name;
    if(res.sex){ var sx=_g('rg-sex'); if(sx)sx.value=res.sex; }
    if(res.dob){ var db=_g('rg-dob'); if(db)db.value=String(res.dob).slice(0,10); }
    if(res.branch){ var br=_g('rg-branch');
      if(br && Array.prototype.some.call(br.options,function(o){return o.value===res.branch;})){
        br.value=res.branch;
        var emp=_g('rg-emp'); if(emp)emp.innerHTML=practitionerOptions(res.branch,'');
      } }
    if(res.visited_for){ var vf=_g('rg-for');
      if(vf && Array.prototype.some.call(vf.options,function(o){return o.value===res.visited_for;})) vf.value=res.visited_for; }
    if(ms && res.media){
      if(!Array.prototype.some.call(ms.options,function(o){return o.value===res.media;})){
        var op=document.createElement('option'); op.value=res.media; op.textContent=res.media; ms.appendChild(op);
      }
      ms.value=res.media; ms.disabled=true;
    }
    if(note){
      note.innerHTML='🔗 Lead found (<b>'+esc(res.lead)+'</b>) — details filled, source locked to <b>'+esc(res.media||'Call Center')+'</b>.';
      note.style.color='var(--g1)';
    }
  }).catch(function(){
    REG_LEAD=null;
    if(note){ note.innerHTML=''; note.style.display='none'; }
  });
}

/* upload a File to Frappe; resolves with the file_url. */
function csrfToken(){
  try{
    if(typeof frappe!=='undefined'){
      if(frappe.csrf_token) return frappe.csrf_token;
      if(frappe.boot && frappe.boot.csrf_token) return frappe.boot.csrf_token;
    }
    var m=document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]');
    if(m && m.content) return m.content;
    if(window.csrf_token) return window.csrf_token;
  }catch(e){}
  return '';
}
function uploadFile(file, doctype, docname){
  return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
    if(!file){ reject(new Error('No file selected')); return; }
    if(file.size > 10*1024*1024){ reject(new Error('File is larger than 10 MB')); return; }
    var fd=new FormData();
    fd.append('file', file, file.name);
    fd.append('is_private', '1');
    fd.append('folder', 'Home/Attachments');
    /* NOTE: we deliberately do NOT send doctype/docname — the Patient
       doesn't exist yet at upload time, and attaching to a non-existent
       doc is what makes upload_file fail. The file_url is stored on the
       PD Form row instead. */
    var xhr=new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open('POST','/api/method/upload_file',true);
    var csrf=csrfToken();
    if(csrf) xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Frappe-CSRF-Token', csrf);
    xhr.setRequestHeader('Accept','application/json');
    xhr.onload=function(){
      var body=null;
      try{ body=JSON.parse(xhr.responseText); }catch(e){}
      if(xhr.status>=200 && xhr.status<300 && body && body.message && body.message.file_url){
        resolve(body.message.file_url);
        return;
      }
      /* dig the real message out of the Frappe error payload */
      var msg='';
      try{
        if(body && body._server_messages){
          var arr=JSON.parse(body._server_messages);
          if(arr.length){ var m0=arr[0]; try{ m0=JSON.parse(m0); }catch(_){}
            msg=String(m0 && m0.message ? m0.message : m0).replace(/<[^>]*>/g,''); }
        }
        if(!msg && body && body.exception) msg=String(body.exception);
        if(!msg && body && body.exc){ var s=String(body.exc).split('\n').filter(Boolean); if(s.length) msg=s[s.length-1]; }
      }catch(e){}
      if(!msg){
        if(xhr.status===403) msg='Not permitted to upload files (403). Your portal role may not have File create permission.';
        else if(xhr.status===413) msg='File too large for the server (413).';
        else if(xhr.status===417) msg='Upload rejected by the server (417).';
        else msg='Upload failed (HTTP '+xhr.status+')';
      }
      reject(new Error(msg));
    };
    xhr.onerror=function(){ reject(new Error('Network error while uploading')); };
    xhr.send(fd);
  });
}

function saveRegister(){
  var name=(_v('rg-name')||'').trim(), mob=normMobile(_v('rg-mobile'));
  var sex=_v('rg-sex'), branch=_v('rg-branch');
  var emp=_v('rg-emp'), visited=_v('rg-for'), decision=_v('rg-decision'), treat=_v('rg-treat');
  var pdNumber=(_v('rg-pd-number')||'').trim();
  var b=_g('rg-err'); if(b)b.style.display='none';
  /* name rule from the Desk script: at least 2 letters, letters only */
  var lettersOnly=name.replace(/[^A-Za-z]/g,'');
  if(!name){regErr('Full name is required');return;}
  if(/\d/.test(name)){regErr('Client name cannot contain numbers');return;}
  if(lettersOnly.length<2){regErr('Client name is invalid — it should contain at least 2 letters');return;}
  if(!/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(mob)){regErr('Mobile must be 10 digits starting 6/7/8/9 (91 prefix is accepted)');return;}
  if(!sex){regErr('Gender is required');return;}
  if(!branch){regErr('Branch is required');return;}
  if(!emp){regErr('Consultation Employee is required');return;}
  if(!visited){regErr('Visited For is required');return;}
  if(!decision){regErr('Booked / Not-Booked is required');return;}
  if(!treat){regErr('Treatment Category is required');return;}
  if(!dobCheck()){regErr('Check the date of birth — use the calendar picker');return;}
  if(!pdNumber){regErr('PD Form Number is required');var pn=_g('rg-pd-number');if(pn)pn.focus();return;}
  var pf=_g('rg-pd-file');
  if(!pf || !pf.files || !pf.files.length){regErr('PD Form attachment is required');return;}

  var btn=_q('#m-register .btn-green');
  var restoreR=btnBusy(btn,'Uploading PD form…');
  busy('Uploading the PD form…');
  var ps=_g('rg-pd-status');
  uploadFile(pf.files[0], 'Patient', null).then(function(fileUrl){
    if(ps){ps.innerHTML='PD form uploaded ✓ <a href="'+fileUrl+'" target="_blank" style="color:var(--g1);font-weight:800">view</a>';ps.style.color='var(--g1)';}
    busy('Registering the client…');
    var payload={
      patient_name:name, mobile:mob, sex:sex,
      dob:_v('rg-dob'), branch:branch,
      media:_v('rg-source'), visited_for:visited,
      consultation_employee:emp, final_decision:decision,
      treatment_category:treat, pd_form_number:pdNumber, pd_form_file:fileUrl
    };
    if(REG_LEAD && REG_LEAD.lead) payload.lead=REG_LEAD.lead;
    return call('lifescc.billing.create_client',payload);
  }).then(function(res){
    busyDone(); if(restoreR)restoreR();
    if(res&&res.name && !res.error){ resetRegisterForm(); closeM('m-register'); alertMsg(name+' registered as '+res.name,'green'); openSummary(res.name); }
    else if(res&&res.duplicate && res.name){ regErr((res.error||'Mobile already registered')+' — opening that client.'); setTimeout(function(){closeM('m-register');openSummary(res.name);},1200); }
    else { regErr((res&&res.error)||'Could not register client'); }
  }).catch(function(e){
    busyDone(); if(restoreR)restoreR();
    if(ps){ps.textContent='Upload failed';ps.style.color='var(--red)';}
    regErr('Register failed: '+(e&&e.message?e.message:serverErr(e)));
  });
}

var COL_INV=null, PAYS=[];
var COL_LIVE_OUT=0;      // outstanding refreshed after an online payment
var COL_MOBILE='';       // client's mobile, used for the WhatsApp payment link

function renderColInfo(){

    '<br>Total '+fmtM(d.rounded_total||d.grand_total)+

    '<div style="margin-top:8px;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap">'+
      '<button class="btn btn-white btn-sm" onclick="viewBill(\''+esc(d.name)+'\')">👁 View bill</button>'+
      '<button class="btn btn-white btn-sm" onclick="downloadBillPdf(\''+esc(d.name)+'\')">⬇ PDF</button>'+
    '</div>');

function openCollect(inv){
  rzpStopAllPolls();
  COL_MOBILE=''; LOAN_VIDEO={};
  getDoc('Sales Invoice',inv).then(function(d){
    COL_INV=d;
    COL_LIVE_OUT=parseFloat(d.outstanding_amount||0);
    /* reset the split BEFORE drawing the header — otherwise the previous
       invoice's Razorpay rows would still be counted in "paid online" */
    PAYS=[{mode:'Cash',amount:parseFloat(d.outstanding_amount||0),ref:''}];
    renderColInfo();
    renderPays();
    var eb=_g('col-err'); if(eb){eb.innerHTML='';eb.style.display='none';}
    openM('m-collect');
    /* the client's mobile prefills the WhatsApp payment-link field */
    if(d.patient){
      getDoc('Patient',d.patient).then(function(pt){
        COL_MOBILE=normMobile(pt&&pt.mobile);
        PAYS.forEach(function(p,i){
          var el=_g('rzp-mob-'+i);
          if(el && !el.value){ el.value=COL_MOBILE; }
        });
      }).catch(function(){});
    }
  }).catch(function(){ alertMsg('Could not open that invoice.','red'); });
}
function addPayRow(){
  var used=PAYS.reduce(function(s,p){return s+(parseFloat(p.amount)||0);},0);
  var left=Math.max(0,parseFloat(COL_INV&&COL_INV.outstanding_amount||0)-used);
  PAYS.push({mode:'Cash',amount:left,ref:''});
  renderPays();
}
function delPayRow(i){
  var p=PAYS[i];
  if(p && p.rzp && p.rzp.status==='paid'){
    alertMsg('This row was already paid online — it cannot be removed.','red');
    return;
  }
  rzpStopPoll(i);
  PAYS.splice(i,1);
  if(!PAYS.length)PAYS.push({mode:'Cash',amount:0,ref:''});
  renderPays();
}
/* Only the MODE change needs a full re-render (the fields differ).
   Amount / reference edits just update the model + summary, otherwise the
   input loses focus after every keystroke. */
function payChange(i,field,val){
  if(!PAYS[i])return;
  /* a row settled through Razorpay is frozen — the money already moved */
  if(PAYS[i].rzp && PAYS[i].rzp.status==='paid') return;
  PAYS[i][field] = (field==='amount') ? (parseFloat(val)||0) : val;
  if(field==='mode'){
    if(!isRazorpayMode(val)){ rzpStopPoll(i); PAYS[i].rzp=null; }
    renderPays();
    return;
  }
  if(field==='amount' && isRazorpayMode(PAYS[i].mode)){
    /* a link is issued for a fixed amount — changing it invalidates the link */
    var r=PAYS[i].rzp;
    if(r && (r.short_url||r.link_id)){
      rzpStopPoll(i);
      r.short_url=''; r.link_id=''; r.qr_image='';
      rzpRenderLink(i);
      rzpSay(i,'Amount changed — create a fresh payment link for the new amount.','wait');
    }
  }
  updatePaySummary();
}
/* LIVE LOAN-MINIMUM WARNING
   The loan box is drawn once per payment mode, so its amount line went stale.
   This refreshes the warning every time a payment amount / mode changes. */
function lifeLoanLiveWarn(){
  var lb=_g('col-loan'); if(!lb) return;
  var rows=[];
  PAYS.forEach(function(p,i){
    if(isLoanMode(p.mode)) rows.push({i:i,mode:p.mode,amount:parseFloat(p.amount)||0});
  });
  rows.forEach(function(r,k){
    var box=lb.children[k]; if(!box) return;
    var el=box.querySelector('.life-loan-live');
    if(!el){
      el=document.createElement('div');
      el.className='life-loan-live';
      el.style.cssText='font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px';
      var title=box.firstElementChild;
      var stale=title?title.nextElementSibling:null;
      if(stale) stale.style.display='none';
      if(title && title.nextSibling) box.insertBefore(el,title.nextSibling); else box.appendChild(el);
    }
    if(r.amount>0 && r.amount<LOAN_MIN){
      el.style.color='var(--red)';
      el.innerHTML='Loan modes need at least <b>'+fmtM(LOAN_MIN)+'</b> on this row (currently '+fmtM(r.amount)+'). Reduce the loan amount or add another payment mode for the rest.';
    } else {
      el.style.color='var(--txt3)';
      el.innerHTML='Amount on this row: <b>'+fmtM(r.amount)+'</b>';
    }
  });
}
function updatePaySummary(){
  setTimeout(function(){ try{ lifeLoanLiveWarn(); }catch(e){} },0);
  var total=PAYS.reduce(function(s,p){return s+(parseFloat(p.amount)||0);},0);
  var out=parseFloat(COL_INV&&COL_INV.outstanding_amount||0);
  var online=rzpPaidTotal();
  var manual=Math.round((total-online)*100)/100;
  var diff=Math.round((out-total)*100)/100;
  var sum=_g('col-paysum');
  if(sum){
    sum.innerHTML='Total entered: <b>'+fmtM(total)+'</b>'+
      (online>0?(' · Settled online: <b style="color:var(--g1)">'+fmtM(online)+'</b> · Left to record: <b>'+fmtM(manual)+'</b>'):'')+
      ' · Outstanding: <b>'+fmtM(out)+'</b> · '+
      (Math.abs(diff)<0.5 ? '<b style="color:var(--g1)">Fully settles this bill ✓</b>'
       : diff>0 ? '<b style="color:#B45309">Balance left: '+fmtM(diff)+'</b>'
                : '<b style="color:var(--red)">Over by '+fmtM(-diff)+'</b>');
    sum.style.background = (diff<-0.5)?'var(--red-bg)':'var(--gbg2)';
  }
  _t('col-words', total>0?numWords(total):'');
  /* keep each Razorpay panel's amount label in step with its row */
  PAYS.forEach(function(p,i){
    if(p && isRazorpayMode(p.mode)){
      var el=_g('rzp-amt-'+i);
      if(el) el.textContent=fmtM(parseFloat(p.amount)||0);
    }
  });
}
function renderPays(){
  var wrap=_g('col-pays'); if(!wrap)return;
  wrap.innerHTML=PAYS.map(function(p,i){
    var rzp=isRazorpayMode(p.mode);
    var paidOnline = rzp && p.rzp && p.rzp.status==='paid';
    var needsRef=!isCashMode(p.mode) && !rzp;
    var loan=isLoanMode(p.mode);
    var lock=paidOnline?' disabled':'';
    var refCell;
    if(needsRef){
      refCell='<div style="flex:1"><label class="f-lbl">Reference / UTR <span class="req">*</span></label>'+
              '<input class="f-inp" value="'+esc(p.ref||'')+'" oninput="payChange('+i+',\'ref\',this.value)"></div>';
    } else if(rzp){
      refCell='<div style="flex:1"><label class="f-lbl">Reference</label>'+
              '<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:'+(paidOnline?'var(--g1)':'var(--txt3)')+';padding-top:10px">'+
              (paidOnline?esc(p.rzp.payment_id||'—'):'Filled in by Razorpay')+'</div></div>';
    } else {
      refCell='<div style="flex:1"></div>';
    }
    return '<div style="border:1.5px solid '+(paidOnline?'#A7E3C4':'var(--border)')+';border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:9px;background:'+(paidOnline?'#F7FEFA':'#FBFEFC')+'">'+
      '<div class="grid3" style="align-items:end">'+
        '<div><label class="f-lbl">Payment mode</label><select class="f-sel"'+lock+' onchange="payChange('+i+',\'mode\',this.value)">'+modeOptions(p.mode)+'</select></div>'+
        '<div><label class="f-lbl">Amount ₹</label><input class="f-inp" type="number"'+lock+' value="'+(p.amount||0)+'" oninput="payChange('+i+',\'amount\',this.value)"></div>'+
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:flex-end">'+
          refCell+
          ((PAYS.length>1 && !paidOnline)?'<button class="del-btn" onclick="delPayRow('+i+')" title="Remove">✕</button>':'')+
        '</div>'+
      '</div>'+
      (loan?'<div style="font-size:11px;color:#6D28D9;font-weight:700;margin-top:6px">🏦 Loan mode — Aadhaar / PAN / documents required below.</div>':'')+
      (rzp?rzpPanelHtml(i):'')+
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
  updatePaySummary();
  colLoanFields();
  /* fill the link / QR blocks from the stored state */
  PAYS.forEach(function(p,i){ if(p && isRazorpayMode(p.mode)) rzpRenderLink(i); });
}
/* loan block shows when ANY selected mode is a loan mode */
/* Loan documents are collected PER loan mode — if two loan modes are used
   on the same collection, each needs its own Aadhaar / PAN / documents.
   A loan mode is only allowed when that row is at least LOAN_MIN. */
var LOAN_MIN=20000;

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PERSIST loan declaration videos after the collection is posted.
   Saves the recorded video URL to BOTH:
     • the Patient  → custom_client_video
     • every created Payment Entry → custom_loan_consent_video
   Uses frappe.client.set_value (logged-in session), so no server-script
   change is needed. Best-effort: a failure here never blocks the receipt,
   the money is already recorded. */
function persistLoanVideos(inv, paymentEntries){
  var urls=[]; var seen={};
  Object.keys(LOAN_VIDEO).forEach(function(k){
    var v=LOAN_VIDEO[k];
    if(v && v.url && !seen[v.url]){ seen[v.url]=1; urls.push(v.url); }
  });
  if(!urls.length) return;
  var vid=urls[0];   // one consent video per collection stamped everywhere

  /* Patient */
  if(inv && inv.patient){
    call('frappe.client.set_value',{
      doctype:'Patient', name:inv.patient,
      fieldname:'custom_client_video', value:vid
    }).catch(function(){});
  }
  /* each Payment Entry
     ------------------------------------------------------------
     Frappe does not allow this custom field to be changed after
     Payment Entry submission unless the field itself is configured
     as "Allow on Submit".

     Do not generate HTTP 417 errors. Only write the video field while
     the Payment Entry is still Draft. Submitted entries are left
     untouched; the uploaded file itself remains available.
     ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  (paymentEntries||[]).forEach(function(pe){

    if(!pe){
      return;
    }

    getDoc(
      'Payment Entry',
      pe
    )

    .then(function(doc){

      if(
        !doc ||
        Number(doc.docstatus)!==0
      ){

        console.debug(
          '[LIFE Billing] Loan video field skipped for submitted Payment Entry',
          pe
        );

        return;
      }

      return call(
        'frappe.client.set_value',
        {
          doctype:'Payment Entry',
          name:pe,
          fieldname:'custom_loan_consent_video',
          value:vid
        }
      );
    })

    .catch(function(error){

      console.debug(
        '[LIFE Billing] Loan video persistence skipped',
        pe,
        error
      );

    });
  });
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LOAN DECLARATION VIDEO MODAL
   Ported from the Patient "Photo Taking in LIKE LOAN" client script.
   Records webcam+mic, runs live speech recognition, and BLOCKS upload
   when fewer than 60% of the required words (client name parts + "loan"
   + branch) are detected. On success calls onLoanVideoSaved(rowIndex,url).
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function lifeOpenLoanVideoModal(rowIndex, patientName, branch){
  var consent_text = 'Hi, my name is '+patientName+'.\n'+

    'for my treatment. I agree to the terms and conditions.\n'+
    'Date: '+frappe.datetime.now_date();

  var branch_words = String(branch).toLowerCase().split(' ').filter(function(w){return w.length>2;});
  var seen={}, required_words=[];
  name_words.concat(['loan', branch_words[0]||'life']).forEach(function(w){ if(!seen[w]){seen[w]=1;required_words.push(w);} });

  var stream=null, mediaRecorder=null, chunks=[], timer_interval=null, seconds=0;
  var speech_rec=null, heard_text='';

  $('#life-video-modal').remove();
  $('body').append(
  '<div id="life-video-modal" style="position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.88);z-index:99999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;">'+
    '<div style="background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:26px 28px;width:640px;max-width:97vw;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 8px 40px #0005;">'+
      '<h4 style="margin:0 0 6px;color:#1a1a2e;font-size:18px;">🎥 Loan Declaration Video</h4>'+
      '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;margin-bottom:12px;">Client must read the statement below clearly on camera.</p>'+
      '<div style="background:#fff8e1;border:2px solid #ffc107;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#333;line-height:1.8;text-align:left;white-space:pre-line;">'+frappe.utils.escape_html(consent_text)+'</div>'+
      '<div style="background:#f8f9fa;border:1px solid #dee2e6;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;margin-bottom:10px;min-height:36px;text-align:left;"><span style="font-size:11px;color:#999;">🎤 Heard: </span><span id="life-heard-text" style="font-size:12px;color:#333;font-style:italic;">(waiting for recording to start...)</span></div>'+
      '<div id="life-speech-status" style="display:none;margin-bottom:10px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;"></div>'+
      '<div id="life-keywords" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:12px;">'+
        required_words.map(function(w){ return '<span id="kw-'+w+'" style="padding:3px 10px;border-radius:12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:#e9ecef;color:#6c757d;border:1px solid #dee2e6;">'+frappe.utils.escape_html(w)+'</span>'; }).join('')+
      '</div>'+
      '<div style="position:relative;display:inline-block;width:100%;">'+
        '<video id="life-vid-preview" autoplay muted playsinline style="width:100%;border-radius:8px;border:3px solid #dee2e6;background:#000;max-height:280px;object-fit:cover;"></video>'+
        '<div id="life-rec-badge" style="display:none;position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;background:red;color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;">● REC  <span id="life-timer">0:00</span></div>'+
        '<div id="life-size-est" style="display:none;position:absolute;bottom:10px;right:10px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);color:#fff;font-size:11px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:10px;">~0 KB</div>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div id="life-vid-status" style="margin-top:10px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;background:#e2e3e5;color:#41464b;">📷 Camera starting...</div>'+
      '<div style="margin-top:14px;display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;">'+
        '<button id="life-rec-btn" class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" disabled>●  Start Recording</button>'+
        '<button id="life-stop-btn" class="btn btn-warning btn-sm" disabled>■  Stop & Verify</button>'+
        '<button id="life-retry-btn" class="btn btn-info btn-sm" style="display:none;">↻  Retry</button>'+
        '<button id="life-cancel-btn" class="btn btn-default btn-sm">Cancel</button>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#aaa;margin-top:10px;">⚡ Compressed · Max 2 min · Speech verified automatically</p>'+
    '</div>'+
  '</div>');

  var video    = document.getElementById('life-vid-preview');
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('life-vid-status');
  var recBtn   = document.getElementById('life-rec-btn');
  var stopBtn  = document.getElementById('life-stop-btn');
  var retryBtn = document.getElementById('life-retry-btn');
  var recBadge = document.getElementById('life-rec-badge');
  var timerEl  = document.getElementById('life-timer');
  var sizeEl   = document.getElementById('life-size-est');
  var heardEl  = document.getElementById('life-heard-text');
  var speechSt = document.getElementById('life-speech-status');

  document.getElementById('life-cancel-btn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    lifeStopSpeech(speech_rec); lifeVidCleanup(stream, mediaRecorder, timer_interval);
    $('#life-video-modal').remove();
  });

  retryBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    chunks=[]; heard_text='';
    heardEl.textContent='(waiting for recording to start...)';
    speechSt.style.display='none';
    recBtn.disabled=false; stopBtn.disabled=true; retryBtn.style.display='none';
    statusEl.style.background='#d1e7dd'; statusEl.style.color='#0f5132';
    statusEl.textContent='✅ Ready. Press Start Recording again.';
    required_words.forEach(function(w){ var el=document.getElementById('kw-'+w); if(el){el.style.background='#e9ecef';el.style.color='#6c757d';el.style.borderColor='#dee2e6';} });
  });

  navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
    video:{ width:{ideal:480}, height:{ideal:360}, frameRate:{ideal:15,max:20}, facingMode:'user' },
    audio:{ echoCancellation:true, noiseSuppression:true, sampleRate:16000 }
  }).then(function(s){
    stream=s; video.srcObject=stream; video.play();

    statusEl.textContent='✅ Camera ready. Press Start Recording.';

    statusEl.textContent='❌ Camera/mic access denied.'; console.error(err);

    if(!stream) return;
    chunks=[]; seconds=0; heard_text='';
    speech_rec=lifeStartSpeech(function(transcript){
      heard_text += ' '+transcript.toLowerCase();
      heardEl.textContent=heard_text.trim();
      required_words.forEach(function(w){ var el=document.getElementById('kw-'+w); if(el && heard_text.indexOf(w)>-1){el.style.background='#d1e7dd';el.style.color='#0f5132';el.style.borderColor='#28a745';} });
    });
    var mime='video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus';
    if(!MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(mime)) mime='video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus';
    if(!MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(mime)) mime='video/webm';
    mediaRecorder=new MediaRecorder(stream,{mimeType:mime,videoBitsPerSecond:200000,audioBitsPerSecond:32000});

    mediaRecorder.onstop=function(){ clearInterval(timer_interval); lifeStopSpeech(speech_rec); lifeVerifyAndUpload(rowIndex, chunks, mediaRecorder.mimeType, stream, heard_text, required_words, statusEl, speechSt, retryBtn, stopBtn); };
    mediaRecorder.start(500);
    recBadge.style.display='block'; recBtn.disabled=true; stopBtn.disabled=false;
    statusEl.style.background='#f8d7da'; statusEl.style.color='#842029';
    statusEl.textContent='🔴 Recording... Client should speak now.';
    timer_interval=setInterval(function(){ seconds++; var m=Math.floor(seconds/60); var sec=seconds%60; timerEl.textContent=m+':'+(sec<10?'0':'')+sec; if(seconds>=120) stopBtn.click(); },1000);
  });

  stopBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    if(mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state!=='inactive'){
      stopBtn.disabled=true; recBadge.style.display='none';
      statusEl.style.background='#fff3cd'; statusEl.style.color='#856404';
      statusEl.textContent='⏳ Verifying speech...';
      setTimeout(function(){ mediaRecorder.stop(); },600);
    }
  });

function lifeStartSpeech(on_result){
  var SpeechRec=window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
  if(!SpeechRec){ console.warn('Speech Recognition not supported'); return null; }
  var rec=new SpeechRec();
  rec.lang='en-IN'; rec.continuous=true; rec.interimResults=true;
  rec.onresult=function(event){ for(var i=event.resultIndex;i<event.results.length;i++){ if(event.results[i].isFinal) on_result(event.results[i][0].transcript); } };
  rec.onerror=function(e){ console.warn('Speech error:', e.error); };
  rec.onend=function(){ try{ rec.start(); }catch(e){} };
  try{ rec.start(); }catch(e){ console.warn('Speech start error:', e); }
  return rec;
}
function lifeStopSpeech(rec){ if(rec){ rec.onend=null; try{ rec.stop(); }catch(e){} } }

function lifeVerifyAndUpload(rowIndex, chunks, mimeType, stream, heard_text, required_words, statusEl, speechSt, retryBtn, stopBtn){
  var matched   = required_words.filter(function(w){ return heard_text.indexOf(w)>-1; });
  var unmatched = required_words.filter(function(w){ return heard_text.indexOf(w)===-1; });
  var match_pct = required_words.length>0 ? matched.length/required_words.length : 1;
  speechSt.style.display='block';
  if(match_pct>=0.6){
    speechSt.style.background='#d1e7dd'; speechSt.style.color='#0f5132';
    speechSt.textContent='✅ Speech verified! Matched: '+matched.join(', ');
    statusEl.style.background='#cff4fc'; statusEl.style.color='#055160';
    statusEl.textContent='⏳ Uploading video...';
    lifeUploadVideo(rowIndex, chunks, mimeType, stream);
  } else {
    if(stream) stream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); });
    speechSt.style.background='#f8d7da'; speechSt.style.color='#842029';
    speechSt.textContent='❌ Speech not matched! Missing: "'+unmatched.join('", "')+'" — client must repeat.';
    statusEl.style.background='#f8d7da'; statusEl.style.color='#842029';
    statusEl.textContent='❌ Verification failed. Please retry and ask client to read clearly.';
    retryBtn.style.display='inline-block'; stopBtn.disabled=true;
    frappe.show_alert({message:'❌ Speech not verified. Missing words: '+unmatched.join(', '), indicator:'red'},6);
  }
}

function lifeUploadVideo(rowIndex, chunks, mimeType, stream){
  if(stream) stream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); });
  var ext=mimeType.indexOf('mp4')>-1?'mp4':'webm';
  var ts=frappe.datetime.now_datetime().replace(/[:\s]/g,'_');
  var filename='loan_consent_'+((COL_INV&&COL_INV.name)||'new')+'_'+ts+'.'+ext;
  var blob=new Blob(chunks,{type:mimeType});
  var file=new File([blob],filename,{type:mimeType});
  var fd=new FormData();
  fd.append('file', file, filename);
  fd.append('is_private','1');
  fd.append('folder','Home/Attachments');
  fetch('/api/method/upload_file',{ method:'POST', headers:{'X-Frappe-CSRF-Token':csrfToken()}, body:fd })
  .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
  .then(function(res){
    $('#life-video-modal').remove();
    if(res.message && res.message.file_url){
      onLoanVideoSaved(rowIndex, res.message.file_url);
      frappe.show_alert({message:'✅ Loan declaration video verified and saved!', indicator:'green'},6);
    } else {
      frappe.show_alert({message:'⚠️ Upload issue — check console.', indicator:'orange'},5);
      console.error(res);
    }
  })
  .catch(function(err){
    $('#life-video-modal').remove();
    frappe.show_alert({message:'❌ Upload failed: '+err.message, indicator:'red'},5);
  });
}

function lifeVidCleanup(stream, recorder, interval){
  if(interval) clearInterval(interval);
  if(recorder && recorder.state!=='inactive'){ try{ recorder.stop(); }catch(e){} }
  if(stream) stream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); });
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RAZORPAY — online collection inside the Collect Due Amount screen
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Server side (life_slimming/razorpay_payment.py):
     create_order                → Checkout order for the SDK popup
     verify_and_record_payment   → signature check → Payment Entry
     create_payment_link         → hosted link + QR (svg data-uri)
     send_payment_link           → hosted link + WhatsApp via WATI
     check_payment_link_payment  → poll; posts the Payment Entry when paid

   IMPORTANT: every one of those server methods creates AND SUBMITS the
   Payment Entry itself. A Razorpay row is therefore NEVER passed to
   lifescc.billing.collect_payment again — doing so would post the money
   against the bill twice. saveCollect() strips them out.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var RZP_M={
  order :'life_slimming.razorpay_payment.create_order',
  verify:'life_slimming.razorpay_payment.verify_and_record_payment',
  link  :'life_slimming.razorpay_payment.create_payment_link',
  send  :'life_slimming.razorpay_payment.send_payment_link',
  poll  :'life_slimming.razorpay_payment.check_payment_link_payment'
};
var RZP_SDK='https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js';
/* must match RAZORPAY_MODE_OF_PAYMENT in razorpay_payment.py */
var RZP_MODE_NAME='Razorpay Software Pvt Ltd -Link';
var RZP_OPEN=false;         // a Checkout window is on screen
var RZP_POLL_EVERY=6000;    // ms between link polls
var RZP_POLL_MAX=100;       // ~10 minutes of automatic polling

function isRazorpayMode(m){
  if(!m) return false;
  var n=String(m).toLowerCase();
  return n.indexOf('razorpay')>-1 || n===String(RZP_MODE_NAME).toLowerCase();
}
function loadRazorpaySdk(){
  return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
    if(window.Razorpay){ resolve(); return; }
    var s=document.createElement('script');
    s.src=RZP_SDK;
    s.onload=function(){ resolve(); };
    s.onerror=function(){ reject(new Error('Could not load the Razorpay SDK — check the internet connection.')); };
    document.body.appendChild(s);
  });
}
function rzpState(i){ var p=PAYS[i]; if(!p)return null; p.rzp=p.rzp||{status:'new'}; return p.rzp; }
function rzpPaidTotal(){
  var t=0;
  (PAYS||[]).forEach(function(p){
    if(p && isRazorpayMode(p.mode) && p.rzp && p.rzp.status==='paid') t+=parseFloat(p.rzp.amount||p.amount||0);

  return Math.round(t*100)/100;
}

function rzpSay(i,msg,tone,polling){

/* shared pre-flight for every online action on a row */
function rzpGuard(i){
  if(!COL_INV){ alertMsg('Open a bill first.','red'); return null; }
  var p=PAYS[i]; if(!p) return null;
  var amt=parseFloat(p.amount)||0;
  var out=parseFloat(COL_INV.outstanding_amount||0);
  if(!(amt>0)){ rzpSay(i,'Enter the amount to collect on this row first.','bad'); return null; }
  var all=PAYS.reduce(function(s,x){return s+(parseFloat(x.amount)||0);},0);
  if(all>out+0.5){
    rzpSay(i,'The split adds up to '+fmtM(all)+', more than the outstanding '+fmtM(out)+'. Fix the amounts before collecting online.','bad');
    return null;
  }
  return {row:p, amount:amt};
}
/* ── 1. Pay Now — Razorpay Checkout SDK ── */
function rzpPayNow(i){
  var g=rzpGuard(i); if(!g)return;
  rzpSay(i,'Creating the Razorpay order…','wait',true);
  busy('Creating the Razorpay order…');
  call(RZP_M.order,{sales_invoice:COL_INV.name, amount:g.amount}).then(function(d){
    unbusy();
    if(!d || !d.order_id){ rzpSay(i,'Razorpay did not return an order.','bad'); return null; }
    rzpSay(i,'Opening the Razorpay window — complete the payment there.','wait',true);
    return loadRazorpaySdk().then(function(){ rzpOpenCheckout(i,d); });
  }).catch(function(e){
    busyDone();
    rzpSay(i,'Razorpay failed: '+esc(e&&e.message?e.message:serverErr(e)),'bad');
  });
}
function rzpOpenCheckout(i,d){
  var amt=parseFloat(PAYS[i]&&PAYS[i].amount)||0;
  var mob=normMobile(_v('rzp-mob-'+i)||COL_MOBILE||d.contact_mobile||'');
  var opts={
    key:d.key_id,
    order_id:d.order_id,
    amount:d.amount,
    currency:d.currency||'INR',
    name:'LIFE Slimming & Cosmetic Clinics',
    description:'Payment for '+COL_INV.name,
    prefill:{ name:d.customer_name||COL_INV.patient_name||'', contact:mob||'', email:d.contact_email||'' },
    notes:{ sales_invoice:COL_INV.name },
    theme:{ color:'#0B6B4A' },
    /* open on UPI so the client sees the scannable QR straight away */
    config:{ display:{ blocks:{ upi:{ name:'Pay using UPI (scan the QR)', instruments:[{method:'upi'}] } },
             sequence:['block.upi'], preferences:{ show_default_blocks:true } } },
    handler:function(resp){
      RZP_OPEN=false;
      rzpSay(i,'Payment received — recording it against the bill…','wait',true);
      busy('Recording the Razorpay payment…');
      call(RZP_M.verify,{
        sales_invoice:COL_INV.name,
        razorpay_payment_id:resp.razorpay_payment_id,
        razorpay_order_id:resp.razorpay_order_id,
        razorpay_signature:resp.razorpay_signature
      }).then(function(res){
        unbusy();
        if(res && res.status==='paid'){
          rzpMarkPaid(i,{payment_id:resp.razorpay_payment_id, payment_entry:res.payment_entry, amount:amt});
        } else {
          rzpSay(i,'The payment was captured but could not be recorded — check the Frappe error log.','bad');
        }
      }).catch(function(e){
        busyDone();
        rzpSay(i,'Payment captured ('+esc(resp.razorpay_payment_id)+') but recording failed: '+esc(serverErr(e)),'bad');
      });
    },
    modal:{ ondismiss:function(){
      RZP_OPEN=false;
      rzpSay(i,'The Razorpay window was closed before the payment was completed.','bad');
    } }
  };
  var rzp=new window.Razorpay(opts);
  rzp.on('payment.failed',function(resp){
    RZP_OPEN=false;
    rzpSay(i,'Payment failed: '+esc((resp&&resp.error&&resp.error.description)||'declined by the bank'),'bad');
  });
  RZP_OPEN=true;
  rzp.open();
}

    rzpStartPoll(i);

/* ── 3. WhatsApp payment link (WATI template payment_request_to_customer) ── */
function rzpSendWa(i){
  var g=rzpGuard(i); if(!g)return;
  var mob=normMobile(_v('rzp-mob-'+i)||COL_MOBILE||'');
  if(!/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(mob)){
    rzpSay(i,'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number to send the payment link on WhatsApp.','bad');
    return;
  }
  rzpState(i).mobile=mob;
  rzpSay(i,'Creating the link and sending it on WhatsApp…','wait',true);
  busy('Sending the payment link on WhatsApp…');
  call(RZP_M.send,{sales_invoice:COL_INV.name, amount:g.amount, contact_mobile:mob}).then(function(d){
    unbusy();
    if(!d || !d.short_url){ rzpSay(i,'The payment link could not be created.','bad'); return; }
    var r=rzpState(i);
    r.short_url=d.short_url; r.link_id=d.payment_link_id||'';
    rzpRenderLink(i);
    rzpSay(i,'💬 Payment link sent on WhatsApp to '+esc(mob)+'. Waiting for the client to pay — you can leave this screen open, or close it and come back later.','wait',true);
    alertMsg('Payment link sent to '+mob+' on WhatsApp.','green');
    rzpStartPoll(i);
  }).catch(function(e){
    busyDone();
    /* the server creates the link first and only then throws if WATI fails,
       so fall back to the manual route rather than losing the link */
    rzpSay(i,'WhatsApp send failed: '+esc(serverErr(e))+
             ' — use “🔗 Payment link + QR” and share it manually instead.','bad');
  });
}
function rzpWaManual(i){

  var L=[];
  L.push('*LIFE Slimming & Cosmetic Clinics*');
