/* ── polling ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   The interval is stored on the row object itself and looks the row up
   by identity, so deleting or re-ordering rows can never leave a timer
   pointing at the wrong payment. */
function rzpStartPoll(i){
  rzpStopPoll(i);
  var row=PAYS[i], r=rzpState(i);
  if(!row || !r || !r.link_id) return;
  r.tries=0;
  r._timer=setInterval(function(){
    var idx=PAYS.indexOf(row);
    if(idx<0){ clearInterval(r._timer); r._timer=null; return; }
    if(r.status==='paid' || !r.link_id){ rzpStopPoll(idx); return; }
    r.tries=(r.tries||0)+1;
    if(r.tries>RZP_POLL_MAX){
      rzpStopPoll(idx);
      rzpSay(idx,'Stopped checking automatically. Press ⟳ Check status once the client tells you they have paid.','wait');
      return;
    }
    rzpPoll(idx,true);
  },RZP_POLL_EVERY);
}
function rzpStopPoll(i){
  var p=PAYS[i];
  if(p && p.rzp && p.rzp._timer){ clearInterval(p.rzp._timer); p.rzp._timer=null; }
}
function rzpStopAllPolls(){
  (PAYS||[]).forEach(function(p){
    if(p && p.rzp && p.rzp._timer){ clearInterval(p.rzp._timer); p.rzp._timer=null; }
  });
}
function rzpCheckNow(i){
  var r=(PAYS[i]&&PAYS[i].rzp)||null;
  if(!r || !r.link_id){ rzpSay(i,'Create or send a payment link first.','bad'); return; }
  rzpSay(i,'Checking with Razorpay…','wait',true);
  rzpPoll(i,false);
}
function rzpPoll(i,quiet){
  var r=(PAYS[i]&&PAYS[i].rzp)||null;
  if(!r || !r.link_id || !COL_INV) return;
  call(RZP_M.poll,{sales_invoice:COL_INV.name, payment_link_id:r.link_id}).then(function(res){
    res=res||{};
    if(res.status==='paid'){
      rzpMarkPaid(i,{payment_id:res.payment_id||r.link_id,
                     payment_entry:res.payment_entry,
                     amount:(PAYS[i]&&PAYS[i].amount)||0});
    } else if(res.status==='failed'){
      rzpStopPoll(i);
      rzpSay(i,'The payment link was '+esc(res.reason||'cancelled')+'. Create a new one.','bad');
    } else if(!quiet){
      rzpSay(i,'Not paid yet — the link is still open. Waiting…','wait',true);
    }
  }).catch(function(e){
    if(!quiet) rzpSay(i,'Could not check the status: '+esc(serverErr(e)),'bad');
  });
}
function rzpMarkPaid(i,info){
  var p=PAYS[i]; if(!p)return;
  var r=rzpState(i);
  rzpStopPoll(i);
  r.status='paid';
  r.payment_id=info.payment_id||'';
  r.payment_entry=info.payment_entry||'';
  r.amount=Math.round((parseFloat(info.amount||p.amount||0))*100)/100;
  r.polling=false;
  r.msg='';
  p.amount=r.amount;                 // freeze the row at what was actually paid
  p.ref=r.payment_id||p.ref||'';
  renderPays();
  alertMsg('Razorpay payment of '+fmtM(r.amount)+' received'+
           (r.payment_entry?(' · Payment Entry '+r.payment_entry):'')+'.','green',true);
  /* refresh the live outstanding shown at the top of the drawer */
  getList('Sales Invoice',[['name','=',COL_INV.name]],['outstanding_amount'],{limit:1})
    .then(function(rows){
      if(rows && rows[0]) COL_LIVE_OUT=parseFloat(rows[0].outstanding_amount||0);
      renderColInfo();
    }).catch(function(){ renderColInfo(); });
  renderKPIs(); updatePendBadge();
}

                "Savein Fintech Card Charges","Sai Roshini Card Charges",
                "Liqui Loans Charges","Loan Tap / Uno Finance Charges"];

/* ════════════════ RECORD THE COLLECTION ════════════════ */
function saveCollect(){
  if(!COL_INV)return;
  var eb=_g('col-err'); if(eb){eb.innerHTML='';eb.style.display='none';}
  var all=PAYS.filter(function(p){ return (parseFloat(p.amount)||0)>0; });
  if(!all.length){showColErr('Enter at least one payment amount');return;}
  var total=all.reduce(function(s,p){return s+parseFloat(p.amount);},0);
  if(total>parseFloat(COL_INV.outstanding_amount||0)+0.5){showColErr('Total entered exceeds the outstanding amount');return;}

  /* Razorpay rows must be settled online BEFORE the collection is recorded */
  var stillOpen=all.filter(function(p){ return isRazorpayMode(p.mode) && !(p.rzp && p.rzp.status==='paid'); });
  if(stillOpen.length){
    showColErr('Finish the online payment for "'+stillOpen[0].mode+'" first — use Pay Now, or the payment link / WhatsApp and wait for it to turn green. Otherwise change that row to another mode.');
    return;
  }
  /* …and are never posted again through collect_payment (Razorpay has already
     created and submitted their Payment Entry). */
  var onlineRows=all.filter(function(p){ return isRazorpayMode(p.mode); });
  var rows=all.filter(function(p){ return !isRazorpayMode(p.mode); });

  for(var k=0;k<rows.length;k++){
    if(!isCashMode(rows[k].mode) && !String(rows[k].ref||'').trim()){
      showColErr('Reference / UTR is required for '+rows[k].mode); return;
    }
  }
  /* Loan rows: each needs its own documents, and each must be >= LOAN_MIN */
  var loanRows=[];
  PAYS.forEach(function(p,idx){
    if(isLoanMode(p.mode) && (parseFloat(p.amount)||0)>0)
      loanRows.push({i:idx,mode:p.mode,amount:parseFloat(p.amount)});
  });
  for(var li=0; li<loanRows.length; li++){
    var lr=loanRows[li];
    if(lr.amount<LOAN_MIN){
      showColErr(lr.mode+' needs at least '+fmtM(LOAN_MIN)+' — this row is only '+fmtM(lr.amount)+'.');
      return;
    }
    if(!(_v('ln-aadhaar-'+lr.i)||'').trim()){showColErr('Aadhaar Card is required for '+lr.mode);return;}
    if(!(_v('ln-pan-'+lr.i)||'').trim()){showColErr('PAN Card is required for '+lr.mode);return;}
    if(!(_v('ln-txn-'+lr.i)||'').trim()){showColErr('Transaction ID is required for '+lr.mode);return;}
    var ids=['ln-do-','ln-aimg-','ln-pimg-','ln-consent-'];
    var lbls=['D.O Screenshot','Aadhaar Image','PAN Image','Loan Consent Image'];
    for(var k2=0;k2<ids.length;k2++){
      var fe=_g(ids[k2]+lr.i);
      if(!fe || !fe.files || !fe.files.length){ showColErr(lbls[k2]+' is required for '+lr.mode); return; }
    }
    var video=LOAN_VIDEO[lr.i];
    if(!video || !video.verified || !video.url){
      showColErr('Loan Declaration Video is mandatory for '+lr.mode+'. Record and verify the video before submitting.');
      var videoWrap=_g('lv-wrap-'+lr.i);
      if(videoWrap){
        videoWrap.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});
        videoWrap.style.outline='3px solid var(--red)';
        setTimeout(function(){videoWrap.style.outline='';},2500);
      }
      return;
    }
  }

  /* nothing left for the manual path — the whole amount came in online */
  if(!rows.length){ finishOnlineOnly(onlineRows); return; }

  var anyLoan=loanRows.length>0;
  var loanDocs=[], uploads=Promise.resolve();
  loanRows.forEach(function(lr){
    uploads=uploads.then(function(){
      var d={mode_of_payment:lr.mode,
             aadhaar_card:(_v('ln-aadhaar-'+lr.i)||'').trim(),
             pan_card:(_v('ln-pan-'+lr.i)||'').trim().toUpperCase(),
             transaction_id:(_v('ln-txn-'+lr.i)||'').trim()};
      return uploadFile(_g('ln-do-'+lr.i).files[0],'Payment Entry',null).then(function(u){ d.do_screenshot=u;
        return uploadFile(_g('ln-aimg-'+lr.i).files[0],'Payment Entry',null); }).then(function(u){ d.aadhaar_image=u;
        return uploadFile(_g('ln-pimg-'+lr.i).files[0],'Payment Entry',null); }).then(function(u){ d.pan_image=u;
        return uploadFile(_g('ln-consent-'+lr.i).files[0],'Payment Entry',null); }).then(function(u){ d.consent_image=u;
        var lvid=LOAN_VIDEO[lr.i]; d.consent_video=(lvid&&lvid.url)||'';
        loanDocs.push(d); });
    });
  });

  var btn=_g('col-save-btn');
  var restore=btnBusy(btn, anyLoan?'Uploading documents…':'Recording…');
  busy(anyLoan?'Uploading loan documents…':'Recording the payment…');
  uploads.then(function(){
    busy('Recording the payment…'); unbusy();
    var args={ sales_invoice:COL_INV.name, reference_date:today(),
               payments:JSON.stringify(rows.map(function(p){
                 return {mode_of_payment:p.mode, amount:parseFloat(p.amount), reference_no:p.ref||''};
               })) };
    if(loanDocs.length) args.loan_docs=JSON.stringify(loanDocs);
    return call('lifescc.billing.collect_payment_v4',args);
  }).then(function(res){
    unbusy(); if(restore)restore();
    if(res&&res.payment_entries&&res.payment_entries.length){
      persistLoanVideos(COL_INV, res.payment_entries);
      var online=rzpPaidTotal();
      var totalPaid=Math.round(((res.allocated||0)+online)*100)/100;
      closeM('m-collect');
      alertMsg('Payment recorded: '+res.payment_entries.join(', ')+' · '+fmtM(res.allocated)+
               (online>0?(' (plus '+fmtM(online)+' collected online)'):'')+
               (res.outstanding>0?(' · Balance still due '+fmtM(res.outstanding)):' · Bill fully paid'),'green');
      renderKPIs(); updatePendBadge();
      /* pull the client's mobile so the receipt can go out on WhatsApp */
      var inv=COL_INV;
      var paidRows=rows.map(function(p){return {mode:p.mode,amount:parseFloat(p.amount),ref:p.ref||''};})
        .concat(onlineRows.map(function(p){
          return {mode:p.mode, amount:parseFloat((p.rzp&&p.rzp.amount)||p.amount||0), ref:(p.rzp&&p.rzp.payment_id)||''};
        }));
      var entries=(res.payment_entries||[]).concat(
        onlineRows.map(function(p){ return (p.rzp&&p.rzp.payment_entry)||''; }).filter(Boolean));
      getDoc('Patient', inv.patient).then(function(pt){
        openReceipt({
          invoice:inv.name, client:inv.patient_name||inv.customer||'',
          branch:inv.branch||'', date:today(),
          rows:paidRows, paid:totalPaid, outstanding:res.outstanding,
          entries:entries, mobile:(pt&&pt.mobile)||COL_MOBILE||''
        });
      }).catch(function(){
        openReceipt({
          invoice:inv.name, client:inv.patient_name||inv.customer||'',
          branch:inv.branch||'', date:today(),
          rows:paidRows, paid:totalPaid, outstanding:res.outstanding,
          entries:entries, mobile:COL_MOBILE||''
        });
      });
      if(CUR)openSummary(CUR);
    } else { showColErr((res&&res.error)||'Payment failed (no response from server)'); }
  }).catch(function(e){
    busyDone(); if(restore)restore();
    showColErr('Collection failed: '+(e&&e.message?e.message:serverErr(e)));
  });
}
/* the whole due was collected online — Razorpay already posted the Payment
   Entries, so there is nothing to send to collect_payment. Just confirm. */
function finishOnlineOnly(onlineRows){
  var inv=COL_INV;
  var paid=rzpPaidTotal();
  var btn=_g('col-save-btn');
  var restore=btnBusy(btn,'Finishing…');
  busy('Refreshing the bill…');
  getDoc('Sales Invoice',inv.name).then(function(d){
    unbusy(); if(restore)restore();
    var out=parseFloat(d.outstanding_amount||0);
    closeM('m-collect');
    alertMsg('Razorpay collection of '+fmtM(paid)+' recorded against '+inv.name+
             (out>0?(' · Balance still due '+fmtM(out)):' · Bill fully paid'),'green',true);
    renderKPIs(); updatePendBadge();
    var rows=onlineRows.map(function(p){
      return {mode:p.mode, amount:parseFloat((p.rzp&&p.rzp.amount)||p.amount||0), ref:(p.rzp&&p.rzp.payment_id)||''};
    });
    var entries=onlineRows.map(function(p){ return (p.rzp&&p.rzp.payment_entry)||''; }).filter(Boolean);
    var receipt={ invoice:inv.name, client:inv.patient_name||inv.customer||'',
                  branch:inv.branch||'', date:today(), rows:rows, paid:paid,
                  outstanding:out, entries:entries, mobile:COL_MOBILE||'' };
    getDoc('Patient',inv.patient).then(function(pt){
      receipt.mobile=(pt&&pt.mobile)||COL_MOBILE||'';
      openReceipt(receipt);
    }).catch(function(){ openReceipt(receipt); });
    if(CUR)openSummary(CUR);
  }).catch(function(e){
    busyDone(); if(restore)restore();
    showColErr('Could not refresh the bill: '+serverErr(e));
  });
}

/* Template-wise billing: expand the template's child therapy_types into
   the lines table (data already came from the bootstrap API). */
function loadTemplateLines(){
  var tpl=_v('bl-template'); if(!tpl){toast('Pick a template first','amber');return;}
  var t=null; (TEMPLATES||[]).forEach(function(x){ if(x.name===tpl)t=x; });
  if(!t){toast('Template not found','red');return;}
  var dets=t.lines||[];
  if(!dets.length){toast('Template has no therapy lines','red');return;}
  BILL.lines=[]; _g('bl-lines').innerHTML='';
  dets.forEach(function(td){
    addLine();
    var i=BILL.lines.length-1;
    var rows=_g('bl-lines').children;
    var row=rows[rows.length-1];
    var srch=row.querySelector('.tp-search'), qty=row.querySelector('.tp-qty'),
        rate=row.querySelector('.tp-rate'), amt=row.querySelector('.tp-amt'), range=row.querySelector('.tp-range');
    var c=catItem(td.therapy_type);
    srch.value=td.therapy_type;
    qty.value=td.no_of_sessions||1;
    rate.value=td.rate||(c?c.rec:0);
    BILL.lines[i]={therapy:td.therapy_type, qty:parseFloat(qty.value||0), rate:parseFloat(rate.value||0)};
    /* the template's own rate is the package rate — record it so the
       min/max clamp and auto-adjust treat it as intentional */
    BILL.lines[i].pkg_rate=parseFloat(rate.value||0);
    amt.value=(BILL.lines[i].qty*BILL.lines[i].rate).toFixed(0);
    // show category as a small tag above the row
    var lbl=row.querySelector('.f-lbl');
    if(lbl && td.category){ lbl.innerHTML='Therapy <span style="color:var(--g2);font-weight:800">· '+esc(td.category)+'</span>'; }
    setRowCat(row, td.category || (c?c.category:''));
    if(c)range.innerHTML='<b>'+fmtM(c.min)+'</b> – '+fmtM(c.max);
    offerCheckRow(row,i);
  });
  recalc();
  /* Package pricing — mirrors the live "Auto Prices for GLP / Therapy
     Plan Items" Sales Invoice script: item rates are NOT changed; instead
     a Net Total discount is applied so Net Total = the package price.
     LIFErise packages have fixed prices; other templates use offer_price. */
  var pkgPrice = LIFERISE_PACKAGES[tpl] ? LIFERISE_PACKAGES[tpl].price
                                        : parseFloat(t.offer_price||0);
  var note=_g('bl-target-note');
  if(pkgPrice>0){
    BILL.pkg_price=pkgPrice;
    BILL.pkg_name=t.plan_name||tpl;
    if(LIFERISE_PACKAGES[tpl]) BILL.pkg_tc=LIFERISE_PACKAGES[tpl].tc;
    recalc();
    if(note) note.innerHTML='📦 <b>'+esc(BILL.pkg_name)+'</b> is a fixed package — Net Total '+
      fmtM(pkgPrice)+' + GST. Item rates stay as listed; the difference is booked as a package discount.';
    alertMsg('Loaded '+dets.length+' line(s) · package price '+fmtM(pkgPrice)+' + GST applied.','green');
  } else {
    BILL.pkg_price=0; BILL.pkg_name=''; BILL.pkg_tc='';
    if(note) note.innerHTML='';
    alertMsg('Loaded '+dets.length+' therapy line(s) from '+(t.plan_name||tpl)+'.','green');
  }
}

function addCompLine(){
  BILL.comps=BILL.comps||[];

  BILL.comps.push({item_code:'',item_name:'',qty:1,comp_price:0,max_qty_allowed:0});
  var wrap=_g('bl-comp-lines');
  var row=document.createElement('div'); row.className='split-line'; row.style.gridTemplateColumns='2.2fr 1.4fr .8fr 30px'; row.dataset.i=i;
  row.innerHTML=
    '<div style="position:relative"><label class="f-lbl">Complimentary session</label>'+
      '<input class="f-inp comp-code" placeholder="Type to search…" autocomplete="off">'+
      '<div class="tp-dd comp-dd"></div></div>'+
    '<div><label class="f-lbl">Value ₹ / max qty</label><div class="comp-info" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--txt3);padding-top:9px">—</div></div>'+
    '<div><label class="f-lbl">Qty</label><input class="f-inp comp-qty" type="number" min="1" value="1"></div>'+

      dd=row.querySelector('.comp-dd'), info=row.querySelector('.comp-info');

  function sync(){
    var picked=null;
    (COMP_ITEMS||[]).forEach(function(c){ if(c.item_code===code.value.trim() || c.item_name===code.value.trim()) picked=c; });
    BILL.comps[i]={
      item_code:picked?picked.item_code:'',
      item_name:picked?picked.item_name:'',
      qty:picked?Math.max(1,parseInt(qty.value||1)):0,
      comp_price:picked?parseFloat(picked.rate||0):0,
      max_qty_allowed:picked?parseInt(picked.max_qty||0):0
    };
    if(picked){
      info.innerHTML=fmtM(picked.rate)+(picked.max_qty?(' · max '+picked.max_qty+'/bill'):'');
      if(picked.max_qty && parseInt(qty.value||0)>picked.max_qty){
        qty.value=picked.max_qty;
        BILL.comps[i].qty=picked.max_qty;
        alertMsg(picked.item_name+': maximum '+picked.max_qty+' per bill — adjusted.','amber');
      }
    } else { info.innerHTML='—'; }
    try{ updateCompSlab(); }catch(e){}
  }
  function renderDd(q){
    q=(q||'').trim().toLowerCase();
    if(!COMP_ITEMS || !COMP_ITEMS.length){
      dd.innerHTML='<div class="tp-dd-item" style="color:var(--red)">No complimentary items found (item group "Complimentary Sessions").</div>';
      dd.classList.add('show'); return;
    }
    var hits=q.length
      ? COMP_ITEMS.filter(function(c){ return (c.item_name+' '+c.item_code).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1; })
      : COMP_ITEMS.slice();
    hits=hits.slice(0,50);
    dd.innerHTML=hits.map(function(c){
      return '<div class="tp-dd-item" data-c="'+esc(c.item_code)+'">'+
        '<span>'+esc(c.item_name)+'<span style="display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--txt3)">'+esc(c.item_code)+
        (c.max_qty?(' · max '+c.max_qty):'')+'</span></span>'+
        '<span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--txt3)">'+fmtM(c.rate)+'</span></div>';
    }).join('')||'<div class="tp-dd-item">No match for "'+esc(q)+'"</div>';
    dd.classList.add('show');
    dd.querySelectorAll('[data-c]').forEach(function(el){ el.onclick=function(){
      var cc=this.getAttribute('data-c'), picked=null;
      (COMP_ITEMS||[]).forEach(function(c){ if(c.item_code===cc) picked=c; });
      if(picked) code.value=picked.item_name;
      dd.classList.remove('show');
      sync();
    };});
  }
  code.oninput=function(){
    BILL.comps[i]={item_code:'',item_name:'',qty:0,comp_price:0,max_qty_allowed:0};
    info.innerHTML='Select an item from the list';
    renderDd(this.value);
    try{updateCompSlab();}catch(e){}

  },180);};
  qty.oninput=function(){
    if(!BILL.comps[i]||!BILL.comps[i].item_code){
      qty.value=1; alertMsg('Select a complimentary session first.','amber'); return;
    }
    sync();
  };
  row.querySelector('.del-btn').onclick=function(){ BILL.comps[i]=null; row.remove(); try{updateCompSlab();}catch(e){} };
}
function currentComps(){ return (BILL.comps||[]).filter(function(c){return c&&c.item_code&&c.qty>0;}); }

/* Complimentary slab rules — mirrors the live Sales Invoice client script.
   Eligible when subtotal > 25000. Slab by subtotal; the bill is created as
   a draft and collected afterwards, so the balance is always outstanding at
   this point → the reduced "due" rate always applies. */
var COMP_SLABS=[
  {label:'S1',min:25001,max:100000,full:0.08,due:0.04},
  {label:'S2',min:100001,max:200000,full:0.15,due:0.075},
  {label:'S3',min:200001,max:400000,full:0.20,due:0.10}
];
function compSlab(subtotal){
  for(var i=0;i<COMP_SLABS.length;i++){ var s=COMP_SLABS[i]; if(subtotal>=s.min && subtotal<=s.max) return s; }
  if(subtotal>COMP_SLABS[COMP_SLABS.length-1].max) return COMP_SLABS[COMP_SLABS.length-1];
  return null;
}
function updateCompSlab(){
  var box=_g('bl-comp-slab'); if(!box)return;
  var t=BILL._totals||{sub:0,total:0};
  var sub=t.sub||0;
  var slab=compSlab(sub);
  var sec=_g('bl-comp-sec');
  var eligible = !!slab && sub>25000;
  /* the whole section is hidden unless the bill qualifies — comp rules
     only apply above 25,000 */
  if(sec) sec.style.display = eligible ? '' : 'none';
  if(!eligible){
    BILL._compLimit=0; BILL._compSlab='';
    BILL.comps=[]; var cl=_g('bl-comp-lines'); if(cl)cl.innerHTML='';
    var tg=_g('bl-comp-on'); if(tg)tg.checked=false;
    var cb=_g('bl-comp-body'); if(cb)cb.classList.remove('show');
    box.innerHTML='Not eligible — subtotal must exceed ₹25,000 (currently '+fmtM(sub)+').';
    box.style.background='var(--gbg2)';
    return;
  }
  var pct=slab.due;
  var limit=Math.round(sub*pct*100)/100;
  var used=(currentComps()).reduce(function(s,c){return s+(c.comp_price||0)*(c.qty||0);},0);
  var remaining=limit-used;
  BILL._compLimit=limit; BILL._compSlab=slab.label; BILL._compUsed=used;
  box.innerHTML='Slab <b>'+slab.label+'</b> · rate <b>'+(pct*100)+'%</b> (reduced — balance pending)'+
    ' · limit <b>'+fmtM(limit)+'</b> · used '+fmtM(used)+' · remaining <b style="color:'+(remaining<0?'var(--red)':'var(--g1)')+'">'+fmtM(remaining)+'</b>';
  box.style.background=remaining<0?'var(--red-bg)':'#F0FDF4';
}

/* Open the real Frappe print format for an invoice in a new tab. */
var PRINT_FORMAT='Consultaion Patient Sales Invoice';
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BILL PREVIEW DRAWER
   Opens the print format inside an iframe in a modal drawer.
   The Frappe print-view toolbar (Print / Get PDF) lives in the
   OUTER print-view document and cannot be reached from inside
   the print format, so we cover it with an opaque strip.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function viewBill(inv, fmt){
  if(!inv) return;

  var f = fmt || PRINT_FORMAT;

  /* Build a cache-busting suffix so re-opening the same bill
     does not reuse a stale iframe. */
  var url = '/printview?doctype=Sales%20Invoice' +
            '&name=' + encodeURIComponent(inv) +
            '&format=' + encodeURIComponent(f) +
            '&no_letterhead=0&_lang=en&_t=' + Date.now();

  closeBillPreview();   // close any previously opened preview first

  var ov = document.createElement('div');
  ov.id = 'life-bill-preview-ov';
  ov.className = 'modal-ov show';
  ov.style.zIndex = 9500;

  ov.innerHTML =
    '<div class="modal wide" style="width:min(1280px,96vw)">' +
      '<div class="m-hdr">' +
        '<span class="m-title">👁 Bill Preview — ' + esc(inv) + '</span>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center">' +
          '<span id="life-bill-preview-note" style="font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);font-weight:600">' +
            'Read-only preview' +
          '</span>' +
          '<button class="m-x" id="life-bill-preview-close" title="Close">✕</button>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="m-body" style="padding:0;position:relative;height:80vh;background:#f2faf6">' +
        '<div id="life-bill-preview-toolbar-cover" ' +
             'style="position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:240px;height:46px;' +
                    'background:#f2faf6;z-index:6;pointer-events:auto"></div>' +
        '<iframe id="life-bill-preview-frame" ' +
                'src="' + esc(url) + '" ' +
                'style="width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:#fff" ' +
                'referrerpolicy="same-origin"></iframe>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';

  document.body.appendChild(ov);
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

  /* Close button */
  var btn = document.getElementById('life-bill-preview-close');
  if(btn) btn.onclick = closeBillPreview;

  /* Clicking the dim backdrop closes the preview */
  ov.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e){
    if(e.target === ov) closeBillPreview();
  });

  /* ESC closes the preview */
  document.addEventListener('keydown', billPreviewEscHandler);

  /* Optional: after the iframe loads, re-apply the cover in case
     the browser repainted it. Also scroll the print view to the
     top so the user always starts at the invoice header. */
  var frame = document.getElementById('life-bill-preview-frame');
  if(frame){
    frame.addEventListener('load', function(){
      try{
        /* Same-origin — safe to reach inside */
        var idoc = frame.contentDocument || frame.contentWindow.document;
        if(idoc && idoc.body){
          idoc.body.scrollTop = 0;

          /* Hide any leftover Frappe wrapper chrome. We cannot
             reach the outer page, but we can neutralise anything
             that leaks inside the iframe. */
          var kill = idoc.querySelectorAll('.action-banner, .print-hide');
          for(var i = 0; i < kill.length; i++){
            kill[i].style.setProperty('display','none','important');
          }
        }
      }catch(e){
        /* Cross-origin should not happen here, but if it does
           the opaque cover strip above still does the job. */
      }
    });
  }
}

var BILL_DOC=null, BILL_REQS=[];

function billErr(msg){
  var b=_g('bill-err'); if(b){b.innerHTML='⚠️ '+esc(msg);b.style.display='block';} toast(msg,'red');
}
function lifeLoadInvoiceDiscountRequests(inv){

  if(!inv){
    return Promise.resolve([]);
  }

  /*
   * APPROVAL RENDER RESET
   * ------------------------------------------------------------
   * Restore the earlier Billing behaviour first:
   * read Discount Approval Request directly using the same getList()
   * path that the old drawer used.
   *
   * Then, when the current bootstrap Server Script also exposes
   * discount_requests, merge those server-side rows into the same
   * result. This preserves the old working rendering immediately,
   * while still allowing hidden sibling L1/L2/L3/L4 rows to appear
   * after the bootstrap backend is upgraded.
   * ------------------------------------------------------------
   */

  var fields=[
    'name',
    'selected_approver',
    'requested_by',
    'requested_discount_pct',
    'requested_final_amount',
    'bill_total',
    'approval_level',
    'status',
    'approved_discount_pct',
    'approved_final_amount',
    'approved_by',
    'approved_at',
    'rejection_reason',
    'reason',
    'branch',
    'creation',
    'modified',
    'linked_invoice'
  ];

  var directPromise=
    getList(
      'Discount Approval Request',
      [
        ['linked_invoice','=',inv]
      ],
      fields,
      {
        limit:0,
        order_by:'creation asc'
      }
    )
    .catch(function(error){

      console.warn(
        '[LIFE Billing] Direct approval history load failed',
        inv,
        error
      );

      return [];
    });


  var bootstrapPromise=
    call(
      'lifescc.billing.bootstrap',
      {
        invoice_name:inv
      }
    )
    .then(function(res){

      res=res||{};

      if(
        Array.isArray(
          res.discount_requests
        )
      ){
        return res.discount_requests;
      }

      /*
       * The current live bootstrap may still be the older version.
       * That is NOT an error for the drawer anymore.
       */
      return [];
    })
    .catch(function(error){

      console.warn(
        '[LIFE Billing] Bootstrap approval history unavailable',
        inv,
        error
      );

      return [];
    });


  return Promise.all([
    directPromise,
    bootstrapPromise
  ])

  .then(function(result){

    var directRows=result[0]||[];
    var serverRows=result[1]||[];

    /*
     * Merge by Discount Approval Request name.
     * Prefer the server-side row when both sources contain the same
     * request because it can contain the most complete audit values.
     */
    var map={};
    var order=[];

    directRows.forEach(function(row){

      if(!row || !row.name){
        return;
      }

      if(!map[row.name]){
        order.push(row.name);
      }

      map[row.name]=row;
    });

    serverRows.forEach(function(row){

      if(!row || !row.name){
        return;
      }

      if(!map[row.name]){
        order.push(row.name);
      }

      map[row.name]=Object.assign(
        {},
        map[row.name]||{},
        row
      );
    });

    var rows=order.map(function(name){
      return map[name];
    });

    rows.sort(function(a,b){

      var ac=String(
        (a&&a.creation)||''
      );

      var bc=String(
        (b&&b.creation)||''
      );

      if(ac===bc){

        return String(
          (a&&a.approval_level)||''
        ).localeCompare(
          String(
            (b&&b.approval_level)||''
          )
        );
      }

      return ac.localeCompare(bc);
    });

    console.debug(
      '[LIFE Billing] Approval workflow rendered',
      {
        invoice:inv,
        direct:directRows.length,
        bootstrap:serverRows.length,
        total:rows.length
      }
    );

    return rows;
  });
}

function refreshOpenBill(){

  var inv =
    BILL_DOC &&
    BILL_DOC.name;

  if(!inv){
    alertMsg(
      'No bill is currently open.',
      'amber'
    );
    return;
  }

  var btn=_g('bill-refresh-btn');
  var oldHtml='';

  if(btn){
    oldHtml=btn.innerHTML;
    btn.disabled=true;
    btn.innerHTML='⏳ Refreshing…';
  }

  Promise.all([

    getDoc(
      'Sales Invoice',
      inv
    ),

    lifeLoadInvoiceDiscountRequests(
      inv
    )

  ])

  .then(function(res){

    BILL_DOC=res[0];
    BILL_REQS=res[1] || [];

    renderBillDrawer();

    alertMsg(
      'Bill refreshed with the latest approval values.',
      'green'
    );

  })

  .catch(function(e){

    alertMsg(
      'Refresh failed: '+
      serverErr(e),
      'red'
    );

  })

  .finally(function(){

    var b=_g('bill-refresh-btn');

    if(b){
      b.disabled=false;
      b.innerHTML=
        oldHtml || '🔄 Refresh';
    }

  });

}

function openBill(inv){

  if(!inv)return;

  var eb=_g('bill-err');

  if(eb){
    eb.style.display='none';
  }

  _s(
    'bill-body',
    '<div class="empty">Loading bill details…</div>'
  );

  _s('bill-actions','');

  /*
   * New bill: approval history is loading.
   * null prevents a false "No discount requested" flash.
   */
  BILL_REQS=null;

  _t(
    'bill-title',
    '🧾 '+inv
  );

  openM('m-bill');


  /* ============================================================
     DO NOT show global blocking loader here.
     The drawer itself already shows Loading…
     ============================================================ */


  var invoicePromise =
    getDoc(
      'Sales Invoice',
      inv
    );


  /*
   * Load complete sibling L1/L2/L3/L4 approval rows through
   * the existing Billing bootstrap API.
   *
   * Do NOT use direct getList('Discount Approval Request', ...)
   * here because branch/user permissions can hide rows such as L2.
   */
  var approvalPromise =
    lifeLoadInvoiceDiscountRequests(
      inv
    );


  /* ============================================================
     LOAD INVOICE FIRST
     ============================================================ */

  invoicePromise

    .then(function(si){

      BILL_DOC=si;

      /*
       * Render immediately.
       * Approval rows may still be loading.
       */
      /*
       * Keep BILL_REQS === null while approval history is still loading.
       */
      renderBillDrawer();

    })

    .catch(function(e){

      _s(
        'bill-body',
        '<div class="empty">'+
        'Could not load this bill.'+
        '</div>'
      );

      billErr(
        serverErr(e)
      );

    });


  /* ============================================================
     LOAD APPROVALS SEPARATELY
     ============================================================ */

  approvalPromise

    .then(function(rows){

      BILL_REQS=
        rows || [];

      /*
       * Re-render when approvals arrive.
       */
      if(
        BILL_DOC &&
        BILL_DOC.name===inv
      ){

        renderBillDrawer();

      }

    })

    .catch(function(e){

      console.warn(
        '[Billing] Approval history load failed',
        e
      );

    });

}
function statusPill(s){
  if(s==='Approved') return '<span class="badge bg-green">✅ Approved</span>';
  if(s==='Pending')  return '<span class="badge bg-amber">⏳ Pending</span>';
  if(s==='Rejected') return '<span class="badge bg-red">✕ Rejected</span>';
  return '<span class="badge">—</span>';
}
function renderBillDrawer(){
  var si=BILL_DOC; if(!si)return;

  var orig=parseFloat(
    si.original_bill_total ||
    si.total ||
    si.net_total ||
    0
  );

  var rawNet=parseFloat(si.net_total||0);
  var rawTax=parseFloat(si.total_taxes_and_charges||0);
  var taxRate=0;

  if(rawNet>0 && rawTax>=0){
    taxRate=rawTax/rawNet;
  }

  if(taxRate>0.049 && taxRate<0.051){
    taxRate=0.05;
  }

  if(!(taxRate>=0)) taxRate=0;

  var taxFactor=1+taxRate;
  var running=0;
  var runningPct=0;
  var netTaxable=orig;
  var netPayable=Math.round((orig*taxFactor)*100)/100;
  var anyPending=false;
  var lastApprovedWasL4=false;

  var rows=(BILL_REQS||[]).map(function(r){

    var lvl=r.approval_level||'L1';
    var info=LEVEL_INFO[lvl]||{label:lvl,max:null};
    var isL4=(lvl==='L4') || parseFloat(r.requested_final_amount||0)>0;

    var maxCell=isL4
      ? 'Unlimited'
      : (fmtM(orig*(info.max||5)/100)+' ('+(info.max||5)+'%)');

    var approvedCell='—';
    var runCell='—';
    var netCell='—';

    if(r.status==='Approved'){

      if(isL4){
        var finalGrand=parseFloat(
          r.approved_final_amount ||
          r.requested_final_amount ||
          0
        );

        if(finalGrand>0){
          netTaxable = taxFactor>0
            ? Math.round((finalGrand/taxFactor)*100)/100
            : finalGrand;

          running=Math.round((orig-netTaxable)*100)/100;
          if(running<0) running=0;

          runningPct=orig>0
            ? Math.round((running/orig)*10000)/100
            : 0;

          netPayable=Math.round(finalGrand*100)/100;
          approvedCell='Final '+fmtM(finalGrand);
          runCell='-'+fmtM(running);
          netCell=fmtM(netPayable);
          lastApprovedWasL4=true;
        }

      }else{
        var pct=parseFloat(
          r.requested_discount_pct ||
          r.approved_discount_pct ||
          0
        );

        var thisDisc=Math.round(orig*pct)/100;
        runningPct=Math.round((runningPct+pct)*100)/100;
        running=Math.round(orig*runningPct)/100;
        netTaxable=Math.round((orig-running)*100)/100;
        netPayable=Math.round((netTaxable*taxFactor)*100)/100;

        approvedCell=fmtM(thisDisc);
        runCell='-'+fmtM(running);
        netCell=fmtM(netPayable);
        lastApprovedWasL4=false;
      }

    }else if(r.status==='Pending'){
      anyPending=true;
      approvedCell=isL4
        ? ('Req final incl GST: '+fmtM(r.requested_final_amount))
        : ('Req: '+(parseFloat(r.requested_discount_pct)||0)+'%');
    }

    var act='';
    if(r.status==='Pending'){
      if(canApprove(r)){
        act='<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:5px">'+
          '<button class="btn btn-green btn-sm" onclick="billApprove(\''+esc(r.name)+'\')">'+
          (isL4?'⚡ Set & Approve':'✅ Approve')+'</button>'+
          '<button class="btn btn-white btn-sm" style="color:var(--red);border-color:var(--red-bd)" onclick="billReject(\''+esc(r.name)+'\')">✕ Reject</button>'+
          '</div>';
      }else{
        act='<div style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--txt3);font-style:italic;margin-top:4px">Waiting for '+esc(r.selected_approver||'approver')+'</div>';
      }
    }

    return '<tr>'+
      '<td class="life-level-action-cell"><b>'+esc(lvl)+'</b><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--txt3)">'+esc(info.label)+'</div>'+act+'</td>'+
      '<td><b>'+esc(r.approved_by||r.selected_approver||'—')+'</b>'+
        (r.status==='Approved' && r.approved_by
          ? '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--g1);font-weight:700">approved'+(r.approved_at?' · '+esc(lifeFmtApprovalDateTime(r.approved_at)):'')+'</div>'
          : '')+
        (r.status==='Pending'?'<div style="font-size:11px;color:#B45309">awaiting response</div>':'')+
        (r.status==='Rejected'?'<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--red)">rejected'+(r.rejection_reason?' · '+esc(r.rejection_reason):'')+'</div>':'')+
        '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--txt3)">requested by '+esc(r.requested_by||'')+'</div></td>'+
      '<td class="money">'+fmtM(orig)+'</td>'+

      '<td class="money">'+esc(approvedCell)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="money" style="color:var(--red)">'+esc(runCell)+'</td>'+

    '</tr>';

  var hasApproved=(BILL_REQS||[]).some(function(r){return r.status==='Approved';});
  var displayDiscount=hasApproved ? running : parseFloat(si.discount_amount||0);
  var displayNet=hasApproved ? netTaxable : parseFloat(si.net_total||0);
  var displayTax=hasApproved ? Math.round((displayNet*taxRate)*100)/100 : parseFloat(si.total_taxes_and_charges||0);
  var displayGrand=hasApproved ? Math.round((displayNet+displayTax)*100)/100 : parseFloat(si.rounded_total||si.grand_total||0);

  if(lastApprovedWasL4){
    displayGrand=netPayable;
    displayNet=taxFactor>0 ? Math.round((displayGrand/taxFactor)*100)/100 : displayGrand;
    displayTax=Math.round((displayGrand-displayNet)*100)/100;
    displayDiscount=Math.round((orig-displayNet)*100)/100;
  }

  var totalPct=orig>0 ? Math.round((displayDiscount/orig)*10000)/100 : 0;

  var head='<div style="background:var(--gbg2);border:1px solid var(--border2);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:14px">'+
    '<div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px">'+
      '<div><div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:900;color:var(--g0)">'+esc(si.patient_name||si.customer||'')+'</div>'+
      '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--txt2);margin-top:3px">'+esc(si.name)+' · '+esc(si.branch||'')+' · '+fmtD(si.posting_date)+'</div></div>'+
      '<button id="bill-refresh-btn" class="btn btn-white btn-sm" onclick="refreshOpenBill()" style="flex-shrink:0;background:#fff;border-color:var(--border2);color:var(--g1);font-weight:800" title="Refresh latest invoice and approval values">🔄 Refresh</button>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<div style="display:flex;gap:22px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap">'+
      '<div><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--txt3)">GRAND TOTAL</div><div style="font-weight:900">'+fmtM(displayGrand)+'</div></div>'+
      '<div><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--txt3)">GST</div><div style="font-weight:900">'+fmtM(displayTax)+'</div></div>'+
      '<div><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--txt3)">STATUS</div><div style="font-weight:900">'+esc(si.docstatus===1?(si.status||'Submitted'):'Draft')+'</div></div>'+
      '<div><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--txt3)">APPROVED DISCOUNT</div><div style="font-weight:900">'+(totalPct||0)+'%</div></div>'+
    '</div>'+
  '</div>';

  /* Remarks for Office Use — amber card under the header */
  var remarksHtml='';
  if(si.custom_remarks_for_office_use && String(si.custom_remarks_for_office_use).trim()){
    remarksHtml =
      '<div style="margin:0 0 14px;padding:11px 14px;'+
                  'background:#FFFBF0;border:1.5px solid #FDE68A;'+
                  'border-radius:10px">'+
        '<div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:#92400E;'+
                    'text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;'+
                    'margin-bottom:5px">'+
          '📝 Remarks for Office Use'+
        '</div>'+
        '<div style="font-size:13px;color:#4B3A12;white-space:pre-wrap;'+
                    'line-height:1.55">'+
          esc(si.custom_remarks_for_office_use)+
        '</div>'+
      '</div>';
  }

  var items=(si.items||[]);
  var itemsHtml='';
  if(items.length){
    var itemRows=items.map(function(it){
      var std=0, cat=null;
      (CATALOG||[]).forEach(function(c){if(c.item===it.item_code)cat=c;});
      if(cat)std=cat.rec||0;
      var rate=parseFloat(it.rate||0);
      var offered=std>0 && rate<std-0.5;
      return '<tr><td><b>'+esc(it.item_name||it.item_code)+'</b>'+
        (cat&&cat.category?'<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--txt3)">'+esc(cat.category)+'</div>':'')+'</td>'+
        '<td style="text-align:center">'+(it.qty||0)+'</td>'+
        '<td class="money">'+fmtM(rate)+'</td>'+
        '<td class="money">'+fmtM(it.amount)+'</td>'+
        '<td>'+(offered?'<span class="badge bg-amber">🏷️ Offer · was '+fmtM(std)+'</span>':'<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--txt3)">Standard rate</span>')+'</td></tr>';
    }).join('');

    itemsHtml='<div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:var(--g0);margin:4px 0 8px">Therapies on this bill</div>'+
      '<div style="overflow-x:auto;margin-bottom:16px"><table class="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Therapy</th><th style="text-align:center">Sessions</th><th>Rate</th><th>Amount</th><th>Pricing</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+itemRows+
      '<tr style="background:var(--gbg2);font-weight:800"><td colspan="3">Subtotal</td><td class="money">'+fmtM(orig)+'</td><td></td></tr>'+
      (displayDiscount>0?'<tr><td colspan="3">Discount (Grand Total including GST)</td><td class="money" style="color:var(--red)">− '+fmtM(displayDiscount)+'</td><td></td></tr>':'')+
      '<tr><td colspan="3">Net total</td><td class="money">'+fmtM(displayNet)+'</td><td></td></tr>'+
      '<tr><td colspan="3">GST</td><td class="money">'+fmtM(displayTax)+'</td><td></td></tr>'+

  }else if(parseFloat(si.outstanding_amount||0)>0){
    acts+='<button class="btn btn-green btn-sm" style="margin-left:auto" onclick="closeM(\'m-bill\');openCollect(\''+esc(si.name)+'\')">💰 Collect payment</button>';
  }else{
    acts+='<span style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--g1);font-weight:800;margin-left:auto;align-self:center">✅ Bill submitted & fully paid — no further action.</span>';
  }

  _s('bill-actions',acts);
}
/* approve / reject straight from the bill drawer */
function billApprove(reqName){

  var r=null;

  (BILL_REQS||[]).forEach(function(x){
    if(x.name===reqName){
      r=x;
    }
  });

  if(!r){
    alertMsg(
      'Discount approval request could not be identified.',
      'red'
    );
    return;
  }

  var inv=
    r.linked_invoice ||
    (
      BILL_DOC &&
      BILL_DOC.name
    );

  if(!inv){
    alertMsg(
      'Sales Invoice could not be identified.',
      'red'
    );
    return;
  }

  var lvl=
    r.approval_level || 'L1';

  var isL4=
    lvl==='L4' ||
    parseFloat(
      r.requested_final_amount || 0
    )>0;

  var bt=parseFloat(
    r.bill_total ||
    (
      BILL_DOC &&
      BILL_DOC.grand_total
    ) ||
    (
      BILL_DOC &&
      BILL_DOC.rounded_total
    ) ||
    0
  );

  if(!(bt>0)){
    alertMsg(
      'Original Grand Total including GST could not be identified.',
      'red'
    );
    return;
  }

  var currentGrand=parseFloat(
    (
      BILL_DOC &&
      BILL_DOC.grand_total
    ) ||
    0
  );

  var approvalPromise;

  /* ============================================================
     L4 / MD
     ENTERED AMOUNT = FINAL INVOICE GRAND TOTAL INCLUDING GST
     ============================================================ */

  if(isL4){

    var suggested=
      parseFloat(
        r.requested_final_amount || 0
      );

    approvalPromise=
      uiDialog({

        title:
          '⚡ L4 / MD — Approve final invoice amount',

        subtitle:
          'Enter the exact final amount the customer has to pay. This amount already includes GST.',

        info:
          '<b>'+
          esc(inv)+
          '</b>'+
          '<br>Original Grand Total including GST: <b>'+
          fmtM(bt)+
          '</b>'+
          (
            currentGrand>0
              ? (
                  '<br>Current invoice total including GST: <b>'+
                  fmtM(currentGrand)+
                  '</b>'
                )
              : ''
          )+
          '<br>Requested final invoice amount including GST: '+
          '<b style="color:var(--g1)">'+
          fmtM(suggested)+
          '</b>',

        fields:[
          {
            name:'amt',
            label:
              'Final invoice amount including GST ₹',
            type:'number',
            value:
              suggested || '',
            required:true
          }
        ],

        okLabel:
          'Confirm & apply',

        validate:function(v){

          var a=
            parseFloat(
              v.amt || 0
            );

          if(!(a>0)){
            return (
              'Enter a valid final invoice amount including GST.'
            );
          }

          /*
           * Compare against the CURRENT GRAND TOTAL, not against
           * original Grand Total including GST. L4 amount itself includes GST.
           */
          if(
            currentGrand>0 &&
            a>=currentGrand
          ){
            return (
              'Final invoice amount must be less than the current invoice total '+
              fmtM(currentGrand)+
              '.'
            );
          }

          return '';
        }

      })

      .then(function(v){

        return {
          request_name:reqName,
          invoice_name:inv,
          approved_amount:
            parseFloat(
              v.amt
            )
        };

      });

  }

  /* ============================================================
     L1 / L2 / L3
     ============================================================ */

  else{

    var pct=
      parseFloat(
        r.requested_discount_pct || 0
      );

    if(!(pct>0)){
      alertMsg(
        'Requested discount percentage is invalid.',
        'red'
      );
      return;
    }

    var disc=
      Math.round(
        bt*pct
      )/100;

    var after=
      Math.round(
        (
          bt-disc
        )*100
      )/100;

    approvalPromise=
      uiConfirm(

        '✅ Approve discount',

        lvl+
        ' — '+
        (
          (
            LEVEL_INFO[lvl] ||
            {}
          ).label ||
          ''
        ),

        '<b>'+
        esc(inv)+
        '</b>'+
        '<br>Original Grand Total including GST: <b>'+
        fmtM(bt)+
        '</b>'+
        '<br>This approval: '+
        '<b style="color:var(--red)">'+
        pct+
        '% = −'+
        fmtM(disc)+
        '</b>'+
        '<br>Payable including GST after this approval: '+
        '<b style="color:var(--g1)">'+
        fmtM(after)+
        '</b>',

        'Approve'

      )

      .then(function(){
        return {
          request_name:reqName,
          invoice_name:inv
        };
      });

  }

  /* ============================================================
     APPLY APPROVAL
     ============================================================ */

  approvalPromise

  .then(function(args){

    var approveBtn=null;

    try{

      /*
       * Search the whole webpage because approval buttons can exist
       * inside the workflow table, not only #bill-actions.
       */
      var buttons=
        ROOT.querySelectorAll(
          'button'
        );

      Array.prototype.forEach.call(
        buttons,
        function(b){

          var oc=
            b.getAttribute('onclick') || '';

          if(
            oc.indexOf('billApprove')>=0 &&
            oc.indexOf(reqName)>=0
          ){
            approveBtn=b;
          }

        }
      );

    }catch(_){}

    var restoreApprove=
      btnBusy(
        approveBtn,
        'Applying…'
      );

    /*
     * WEBPAGE TEST FLOW ONLY.
     * Do not route this approval through the Sales Invoice
     * Client Script or old APIs.
     */
    return call(
      'apply_invoice_discount_NET_FINAL_V2',
      args
    )

    .then(function(res){

      if(restoreApprove){
        restoreApprove();
        restoreApprove=null;
      }

      res=res||{};

      var finalText='';

      if(isL4){

        var g=parseFloat(
          res.grand_total ||
          res.target_grand_total ||
          args.approved_amount ||
          0
        );

        finalText=
          g>0
            ? (
                ' Final invoice total: '+
                fmtM(g)+
                ' including GST.'
              )
            : '';

      }

      alertMsg(
        'Discount approved and applied to '+
        inv+
        '.'+
        finalText,
        'green'
      );

      /* Keep the same bill drawer open after L1/L2/L3/L4 approval and refresh
         its totals/workflow in place. */
      openBill(inv);
      refreshBillLists();

      return res;
    })

    .catch(function(e){

      if(restoreApprove){
        restoreApprove();
        restoreApprove=null;
      }

      throw e;
    });

  })

  .catch(function(e){

    if(
      e &&
      e.message==='cancelled'
    ){
      return;
    }

    alertMsg(
      'Approve failed: '+
      serverErr(e),
      'red'
    );

  });

}

/* ════════════════ ALERTS (replace fast toasts) ════════════════ */
function alertMsg(msg,kind,sticky){
  var st=_g('alert-stack'); if(!st){ console.log(msg); return; }
  kind=kind||'green';
  var ic = kind==='red'?'⚠️' : kind==='amber'?'⚡' : '✅';
  var el=document.createElement('div');
  el.className='alert '+kind;
  el.innerHTML='<span class="alert-ic">'+ic+'</span><span class="alert-msg">'+esc(msg)+'</span>'+
               '<button class="alert-x" title="Dismiss">✕</button>';
  el.querySelector('.alert-x').onclick=function(){ el.remove(); };
  st.appendChild(el);
  /* All notifications expire automatically; manual close remains available. */
  var life=sticky?8000:(kind==='red'?8000:(kind==='amber'?6500:4500));
  setTimeout(function(){
    if(!el.parentNode)return;
    el.classList.add('life-alert-out');
    setTimeout(function(){if(el.parentNode)el.remove();},220);
  },life);
  while(st.children.length>5){ st.removeChild(st.firstChild); }
}
/* keep the old name working, routed to the new alerts */
function toast(msg,kind){ alertMsg(msg,kind==='red'?'red':(kind==='amber'?'amber':'green')); }

/* ════════════════ STYLED DIALOG (replaces prompt/confirm) ════════ */
function uiDialog(opts){
  return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
    opts=opts||{};
    var ov=_g('dlg-ov'), fw=_g('dlg-fields'), er=_g('dlg-err');
    _t('dlg-title',opts.title||'Confirm');
    _s('dlg-sub',opts.subtitle||'');
    if(er){er.style.display='none';er.textContent='';}
    var fields=opts.fields||[];
    var html=(opts.info?'<div class="dlg-info">'+opts.info+'</div>':'');
    fields.forEach(function(f,i){
      var id='dlgf-'+i;
      html+='<div style="margin-bottom:12px"><label class="f-lbl">'+esc(f.label||f.name)+
            (f.required?' <span class="req">*</span>':'')+'</label>';
      if(f.type==='select'){
        html+='<select class="f-sel" id="'+id+'">'+(f.options||[]).map(function(o){
          var v=(typeof o==='string')?o:o.value, t=(typeof o==='string')?o:o.label;
          return '<option value="'+esc(v)+'"'+(String(f.value)===String(v)?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(t)+'</option>';
        }).join('')+'</select>';
      } else if(f.type==='textarea'){
        html+='<textarea class="f-inp" id="'+id+'" rows="3" style="resize:vertical">'+esc(f.value||'')+'</textarea>';
      } else {
        html+='<input class="f-inp" id="'+id+'" type="'+(f.type||'text')+'" value="'+esc(f.value==null?'':f.value)+'"'+
              (f.placeholder?' placeholder="'+esc(f.placeholder)+'"':'')+'>';
      }
      if(f.hint) html+='<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--txt3);margin-top:3px">'+f.hint+'</div>';
      if(f.live) html+='<div id="'+id+'-live" style="display:none;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;background:#FFFBEB;border:1.5px solid #FDE68A;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 11px;margin-top:6px"></div>';
      html+='</div>';
    });
    fw.innerHTML=html;
    /* live preview / clamping handlers */
    fields.forEach(function(f,i){
      if(!f.live) return;
      var el=_g('dlgf-'+i), box=_g('dlgf-'+i+'-live');
      if(!el||!box) return;
      function run(){
        var out=null;
        try{ out=f.live(el.value, el); }catch(e){}
        if(out){ box.innerHTML=out; box.style.display='block'; }
        else { box.style.display='none'; }
      }
      el.oninput=run; el.onchange=run; run();
    });
    var ok=_g('dlg-ok'), cancel=_g('dlg-cancel');
    ok.textContent=opts.okLabel||'Confirm';
    function close(){ ov.classList.remove('show'); ok.onclick=null; cancel.onclick=null; ov.onclick=null; }
    ok.onclick=function(){
      var vals={}, bad='';
      fields.forEach(function(f,i){
        var el=_g('dlgf-'+i); var v=el?el.value:'';
        if(typeof v==='string') v=v.trim();
        if(f.required && !v && !bad) bad=(f.label||f.name)+' is required';
        vals[f.name]=v;
      });
      if(bad){ if(er){er.textContent='⚠️ '+bad;er.style.display='block';} return; }
      if(opts.validate){
        var msg=opts.validate(vals);
        if(msg){ if(er){er.textContent='⚠️ '+msg;er.style.display='block';} return; }
      }
      close(); resolve(vals);
    };
    cancel.onclick=function(){ close(); reject(new Error('cancelled')); };
    ov.onclick=function(e){ if(e.target===ov){ close(); reject(new Error('cancelled')); } };
    ov.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(function(){ var f0=_g('dlgf-0'); if(f0)f0.focus(); },80);
  });
}
function uiConfirm(title,subtitle,info,okLabel){
  return uiDialog({title:title,subtitle:subtitle,info:info,fields:[],okLabel:okLabel||'Confirm'});
}

/* ── global busy indicator ── */
var _busyN=0;
function busy(msg){
  _busyN++;
  var ov=_g('busy-ov'); if(ov){ _t('busy-txt',msg||'Working…'); ov.classList.add('show'); }
}

  _busyN=Math.max(0,_busyN-1);
  if(_busyN===0){ var ov=_g('busy-ov'); if(ov)ov.classList.remove('show'); }
}

/* put a spinner inside a button while an action runs */
function btnBusy(btn,label){
  if(!btn)return null;
  var old={html:btn.innerHTML, dis:btn.disabled};
  btn.disabled=true;
  btn.innerHTML='<span class="btn-spin"></span>'+esc(label||'Working…');
  return function(){ btn.disabled=old.dis; btn.innerHTML=old.html; };
}

/* ── AUTO-ADJUST ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function autoAdjust(){
  var grandTarget=parseFloat(_v('bl-target')||0);
  var note=_g('bl-target-note');
  if(!(grandTarget>0)){ alertMsg('Enter the target grand total first.','amber'); return; }
  var dPct=parseFloat(_v('bl-disc-pct')||0); if(dPct>5)dPct=5;
  var target=grandTarget/(1+GST);
  if(dPct>0) target=target/(1-dPct/100);
  target=Math.round(target*100)/100;
  var rows=[];
  (BILL.lines||[]).forEach(function(l,idx){
    if(!l || !l.therapy) return;
    var c=catItem(l.therapy); if(!c) return;
    var q=parseFloat(l.qty||0); if(!(q>0)) return;
    var cur=parseFloat(l.rate||c.rec||0);
    /* A line with an APPLIED OFFER still participates in auto-adjust, but its
       band runs from the offer price (as the floor) up to the therapy's own
       maximum — so the offer stays a genuine discount while the target can be
       met by raising the offer line too. */
    var hasOffer = !!(l.offer_rule || l.use_offer);
    var lo = hasOffer ? Math.min(cur, parseFloat(c.min||0)) : parseFloat(c.min||0);
    var hi = parseFloat(c.max||0);
    if(hasOffer && hi < cur) hi = cur;
    rows.push({idx:idx, qty:q, name:c.n, rate:cur, pinned:false,
               min: lo, max: hi, offer:hasOffer});
  });
  if(!rows.length){ alertMsg('Add at least one therapy line first.','amber'); return; }

  var loMin=0, hiMax=0;
  rows.forEach(function(r){ loMin+=r.min*r.qty; hiMax+=r.max*r.qty; });
  var offerCount=rows.filter(function(r){return r.offer;}).length;
  if(target<loMin-0.5){
    var loGrand=loMin*(1-dPct/100)*(1+GST);
    alertMsg('Target '+fmtM(grandTarget)+' is below the lowest possible grand total '+fmtM(loGrand)+' for these therapies.','red');
    if(note)note.innerHTML='Lowest allowed grand total: <b>'+fmtM(loGrand)+'</b>';
    return;
  }
  if(target>hiMax+0.5){
    var hiGrand=hiMax*(1-dPct/100)*(1+GST);
    alertMsg('Target '+fmtM(grandTarget)+' is above the highest possible grand total '+fmtM(hiGrand)+' for these therapies.','red');
    if(note)note.innerHTML='Highest allowed grand total: <b>'+fmtM(hiGrand)+'</b>';
    return;
  }

  for(var pass=0; pass<12; pass++){
    var pinnedTotal=0, freeTotal=0;
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      if(r.pinned) pinnedTotal+=r.rate*r.qty;
      else freeTotal+=r.rate*r.qty;
    });
    var need=target-pinnedTotal;
    if(freeTotal<=0) break;
    var f=need/freeTotal;
    var changed=false;
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      if(r.pinned) return;
      var nr=r.rate*f;
      if(nr<r.min){ nr=r.min; r.pinned=true; changed=true; }
      else if(nr>r.max){ nr=r.max; r.pinned=true; changed=true; }
      r.rate=nr;
    });
    var tot0=0; rows.forEach(function(r){ tot0+=r.rate*r.qty; });
    if(Math.abs(tot0-target)<0.5 && !changed) break;
    if(!changed) break;
  }

  rows.forEach(function(r){ r.rate=Math.round(r.rate); });
  var tot=0; rows.forEach(function(r){ tot+=r.rate*r.qty; });
  var drift=Math.round(target-tot);
  if(drift!==0){
    for(var k=0;k<rows.length && drift!==0;k++){
      var r=rows[k]; if(!(r.qty>0)) continue;
      var per=Math.round(drift/r.qty);
      if(!per) continue;
      var nr=r.rate+per;
      if(nr>=r.min && nr<=r.max){ r.rate=nr; drift-=per*r.qty; }
    }
  }

  var wrap=_g('bl-lines'); if(!wrap)return;
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    var ln=BILL.lines[r.idx];
    ln.rate=r.rate;
    /* Auto-adjust keeps an APPLIED OFFER applied — it just moves the price
       within the offer's band. Update the stored offer rate so the badge,
       preview and the invoice payload all bill the adjusted amount. */
    if(r.offer && ln.offer){
      ln.offer.rate=r.rate;
      ln.base_rate=undefined;
    }
    var el=wrap.children[r.idx];
    if(el){
      var ri=el.querySelector('.tp-rate'), ai=el.querySelector('.tp-amt');
      if(ri){
        ri.value=r.rate;
        /* offer lines stay locked (offer still applied); free lines editable */
        ri.disabled = !!(ln.use_offer||ln.offer);
      }
      if(ai)ai.value=(r.rate*r.qty).toFixed(0);
      var w=el.querySelector('.tp-ratewarn'); if(w){w.style.display='none';w.innerHTML='';}
      if(ri)ri.classList.remove('rate-warn');
      /* refresh the offer strip so it shows the adjusted rate, without
         re-deriving from the pricing rule (which would reset the price) */
      try{ offerCheckRow(el, r.idx); }catch(_){}
    }
  });
  recalc();
  var newSub=(BILL._totals&&BILL._totals.sub)||0;
  var newGrand=(BILL._totals&&BILL._totals.total)||0;
  var pinnedCount=rows.filter(function(r){return r.pinned;}).length;
  if(note){
    note.innerHTML='Grand total now <b>'+fmtM(newGrand)+'</b> (subtotal '+fmtM(newSub)+')'+
      (pinnedCount?(' · '+pinnedCount+' line(s) capped at their min/max'):'')+
      ' · allowed range '+fmtM(loMin)+' – '+fmtM(hiMax);
  }
  alertMsg('Prices adjusted — grand total is now '+fmtM(newGrand)+' (all lines within their min–max limits).','green');
}
/* put every line back on its standard rate */
function resetRates(){
  var wrap=_g('bl-lines'); if(!wrap)return;
  (BILL.lines||[]).forEach(function(l,idx){
    if(!l||!l.therapy)return;
    var c=catItem(l.therapy); if(!c)return;
    l.rate=c.rec;
    var el=wrap.children[idx];
    if(el){
      var ri=el.querySelector('.tp-rate'), ai=el.querySelector('.tp-amt');
      if(ri){ri.value=c.rec;ri.classList.remove('rate-warn');}
      if(ai)ai.value=(c.rec*(parseFloat(l.qty)||0)).toFixed(0);
      var w=el.querySelector('.tp-ratewarn'); if(w){w.style.display='none';w.innerHTML='';}
    }
  });
  recalc();
  var n=_g('bl-target-note'); if(n)n.innerHTML='';
  alertMsg('Rates reset to the standard price for each therapy.','green');
}

/* SAME-DAY CALL CENTER LOCK
   If this client already has a bill TODAY whose Therapy Plan media is
   Call Center, the next bill today is also Call Center (source locked). */
function lifeSameDayCallCenterLock(){
  var t=today();
  var plans=[];
  (CUR_INVS||[]).forEach(function(i){
    if(String(i.posting_date||'').slice(0,10)===t && i.custom_therapy_plan && i.status!=='Cancelled'){
      plans.push(i.custom_therapy_plan);
    }
  });
  if(!plans.length) return;
  getListSilent('Therapy Plan',[['name','in',plans],['media','=','Call Center']],['name','media'],{limit:0})
    .then(function(rows){
      if(!rows || !rows.length) return;
      var ms=_g('bl-media'), note=_g('bl-media-note');
      if(!ms) return;
      ms.value='Call Center';
      ms.disabled=true;
      try{ onMediaChange(); }catch(e){}
      if(note) note.innerHTML='Earlier bill today was Call Center - source locked to <b>Call Center</b>.';
    }).catch(function(){});
}
function onMediaChange(){
  var m=_v('bl-media'), w=_g('bl-ref-wrap');
  var on=(m==='Reference');
  if(w)w.style.display=on?'block':'none';
  if(!on){
    REF_CLIENT=null;
    ['bl-ref-isclient','bl-ref-isemp'].forEach(function(id){ var el=_g(id); if(el)el.checked=false; });
    try{ refSrcChange(); }catch(e){}
  }
}

/* ════════════════ PAYMENT RECEIPT / WHATSAPP ════════════════ */
var RC=null;
function normWa(mob){
  var d=String(mob||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
  if(d.length===10) d='91'+d;
  if(d.length===12 && d.slice(0,2)==='91') return d;
  return d;
}
function receiptText(r){
  var L=[];
  L.push('*LIFE Slimming & Cosmetic Clinics*');
  L.push('Payment received — thank you!');
  L.push('');
  L.push('Client: '+r.client);
  L.push('Bill: '+r.invoice);
  L.push('Date: '+fmtD(r.date));
  if(r.branch) L.push('Branch: '+r.branch);
  L.push('');
  r.rows.forEach(function(p){
    L.push('• '+p.mode+': '+fmtM(p.amount)+(p.ref?(' (Ref '+p.ref+')'):''));
  });
  L.push('');
  L.push('Amount paid: '+fmtM(r.paid));
  L.push(r.outstanding>0 ? ('Balance due: '+fmtM(r.outstanding)) : 'Bill fully paid ✅');
  L.push('');
  L.push('For any query please contact your branch.');
  return L.join('\n');
}
function openReceipt(r){
  RC=r;
  _s('rc-body',
    '<div style="text-align:center;padding:24px 12px 16px">'+
      '<div style="width:64px;height:64px;margin:0 auto 12px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#E7F8EF;color:var(--g1);font-size:34px">✓</div>'+ 
      '<div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:var(--g0)">Payment recorded</div>'+ 
      '<div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--txt2);margin-top:7px">'+esc(r.invoice)+' · '+fmtM(r.paid)+'</div>'+ 
      '<div id="rc-wa-status" style="margin-top:14px;padding:11px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--gbg2);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--g1)">Sending the bill via WhatsApp…</div>'+ 
      '<div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--txt3);margin-top:14px">Thank you. This popup will close automatically in <b><span id="rc-countdown">10</span> seconds</b>.</div>'+ 
    '</div>');
  _s(
    'rc-actions',
    '<button class="btn btn-white" onclick="sendWhatsApp()">💬 Send WhatsApp</button>'+
    '<button class="btn btn-green" style="margin-left:auto" onclick="closeM(\'m-receipt\')">Close</button>'
  );
  openM('m-receipt');
  autoSendReceiptWati(r);
  if(window.RC_AUTO_TIMER)clearInterval(window.RC_AUTO_TIMER);
  var left=10;
  window.RC_AUTO_TIMER=setInterval(function(){
    left--;
    var n=_g('rc-countdown'); if(n)n.textContent=Math.max(0,left);
    if(left<=0){clearInterval(window.RC_AUTO_TIMER);window.RC_AUTO_TIMER=null;closeM('m-receipt');}
  },1000);
}
function autoSendReceiptWati(r){

  var status=_g('rc-wa-status');

  /*
   * The old code called:
   *     lifescc.billing.send_wati
   *
   * That dotted Python method does not exist on this site and Frappe
   * interprets "lifescc" as an installed app, producing HTTP 417.
   *
   * Do not call a nonexistent server method. Keep payment completion
   * successful and let the user send the prepared receipt through the
   * explicit WhatsApp button below.
   */
  if(status){
    status.textContent=
      'Payment recorded successfully. Use “Send WhatsApp” below to send the receipt.';
    status.style.color='var(--g1)';
  }
}
function copyReceipt(){
  var t=_g('rc-msg'); if(!t)return;
  t.select(); t.setSelectionRange(0,99999);
  var ok=false;
  try{ ok=document.execCommand('copy'); }catch(e){}
  if(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(t.value).then(function(){ alertMsg('Message copied.','green'); }).catch(function(){});
  } else {
    alertMsg(ok?'Message copied.':'Select the text and copy it manually.', ok?'green':'amber');
  }
}
function sendWhatsApp(){
  var mob=normWa(_v('rc-mobile'));
  if(mob.length!==12){ alertMsg('Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number to send on WhatsApp.','red'); return; }
  var msg=_v('rc-msg')||'';
  openWaLink(mob,msg);
}
function openWaLink(mob,msg){
  window.open('https://wa.me/'+mob+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(msg),'_blank');
}
/* Send through WATI using the clinic's business number. */
function sendWati(){

  if(!RC){
    return;
  }

  var mob=
    normWa(
      _v('rc-mobile')
    );

  if(mob.length!==12){
    alertMsg(
      'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.',
      'red'
    );
    return;
  }

  /*
   * WATI backend endpoint is not configured on this installation.
   * Use WhatsApp Web/App directly instead of generating an HTTP 417.
   */
  var msg=
    _v('rc-msg') || '';

  openWaLink(
    mob,
    msg
  );

  alertMsg(
    'WhatsApp opened with the receipt message ready to send.',
    'green'
  );
}

/* ── Replace Frappe's default "Message" dialog ── */
var MSGPRINT_PATCHED=false;
function patchMsgprint(){
  if(MSGPRINT_PATCHED) return;
  if(typeof frappe==='undefined') return;
  MSGPRINT_PATCHED=true;
  try{
    var origMsg=frappe.msgprint;
    frappe.msgprint=function(opts,title){
      var raw='';
      try{
        if(typeof opts==='string') raw=opts;
        else if(opts&&typeof opts==='object') raw=opts.message||opts.msg||'';
        if(raw&&typeof raw==='object') raw=raw.message||'';
      }catch(e){}
      var txt=String(raw||'').replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi,' ').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'').trim();
      if(!txt){ return; }
      var ind=(opts&&opts.indicator)||'';
      var kind='green';
      if(ind==='red'||/error|failed|not permitted|cannot/i.test(txt)) kind='red';
      else if(ind==='orange'||ind==='yellow'||/warning|pending/i.test(txt)) kind='amber';
      try{ alertMsg(txt,kind); }catch(e){ if(origMsg) origMsg.apply(frappe,arguments); }
      return {hide:function(){}, $wrapper:null};
    };
    if(frappe.show_alert){
      frappe.show_alert=function(opts){
        var t='';
        try{ t=(typeof opts==='string')?opts:(opts&&(opts.message||opts.msg))||''; }catch(e){}
        t=String(t||'').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'').trim();
        if(!t) return;
        var k=(opts&&opts.indicator==='red')?'red':((opts&&opts.indicator==='orange')?'amber':'green');
        try{ alertMsg(t,k); }catch(e){}
      };
    }
  }catch(e){}
}

  var pw=_g('bl-disc-pct-wrap'), fw=_g('bl-disc-final-wrap');
  if(!sel)return;
  var lvl = (sel.selectedOptions && sel.selectedOptions[0])
              ? (sel.selectedOptions[0].getAttribute('data-level')||'') : '';
  var isL4 = (lvl==='L4');
  if(pw) pw.style.display = (sel.value && !isL4) ? 'block' : 'none';
  if(fw) fw.style.display = (sel.value && isL4)  ? 'block' : 'none';
  if(!sel.value){
    if(st) st.innerHTML='';
    var pi=_g('bl-disc-pct'); if(pi)pi.value=0;
    var fi=_g('bl-disc-final'); if(fi)fi.value='';
    var cb=_g('bl-disc-calc'); if(cb)cb.style.display='none';
    recalc(); return;
  }
  if(st){
    if(isL4){
      st.innerHTML='👑 <b>'+esc(sel.value)+'</b> (L4 · MD) — enter the final amount the customer pays. No percentage cap.';
      st.style.color='var(--txt2)';
    } else if(sel.value===CURRENT_USER){
      st.innerHTML='You are the approver (L1 · Branch Level) — the draft is created, then you press <b>Approve</b> on the bill screen.';
      st.style.color='var(--g1)';

      st.innerHTML='🔐 Request goes to <b>'+esc(sel.value)+'</b> ('+esc(lvl)+'). The bill stays a draft until they approve.';
      st.style.color='var(--txt2)';
    }
  }
  if(isL4){ discFinalChange(); } else { discPctChange(); }
}
/* % path (L1-L3): live rupee preview, hard-capped at 5% */
function discPctChange(){
  var inp=_g('bl-disc-pct');
  if(!inp)return;

  var pct=parseFloat(inp.value||0);
  if(pct>5){
    pct=5;
    inp.value=5;
    alertMsg('One approval level can give at most 5% — use the next level for more.','amber');
  }
  if(pct<0){
    pct=0;
    inp.value=0;
  }

  var grand=(BILL._totals&&BILL._totals.total)||0;
  var maxStaff=Math.max(0,Math.round((15-COUPON_PCT)*100)/100);
  if(pct>maxStaff){
    pct=maxStaff;
    inp.value=maxStaff;
  }

  var box=_g('bl-disc-calc');
  if(box){
    if(grand>0 && pct>0){
      var discount=Math.round(grand*pct)/100;
      var finalTotal=Math.round((grand-discount)*100)/100;
      box.innerHTML=
        '<div><b>'+pct+'%</b> of Grand Total including GST '+fmtM(grand)+
        ' = <b style="color:var(--red)">− '+fmtM(discount)+'</b></div>'+
        '<div style="margin-top:5px">Final payable including GST: '+
        '<b style="color:var(--g1);font-size:15px">'+fmtM(finalTotal)+'</b></div>'+
        '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--txt3);margin-top:4px">'+
        'Maximum at this level is 5% = '+fmtM(Math.round(grand*5)/100)+'</div>';
      box.style.display='block';
    }else if(grand>0){
      box.innerHTML='Enter a % up to 5. 5% of Grand Total including GST '+fmtM(grand)+
        ' = <b>'+fmtM(Math.round(grand*5)/100)+'</b>.';
      box.style.display='block';
    }else{
      box.style.display='none';
    }
  }
  recalc();
}
/* L4/MD path: a direct amount, never more than the grand total */
function discFinalChange(){
  var inp=_g('bl-disc-final'); if(!inp)return;
  var grand=(BILL._totals&&BILL._totals.total)||0;
  var fa=parseFloat(inp.value||0);
  if(grand>0 && fa>grand){
    fa=grand; inp.value=Math.round(grand*100)/100;
    alertMsg('The MD amount cannot be more than the grand total '+fmtM(grand)+' — set to the grand total.','amber');
  }
  if(fa<0){ fa=0; inp.value=0; }
  var box=_g('bl-disc-calc');
  if(box){
    if(grand>0 && fa>0){
      var d=grand-fa;
      box.innerHTML='Customer pays <b style="color:var(--g1)">'+fmtM(fa)+'</b> instead of '+fmtM(grand)+
        ' · discount <b style="color:var(--red)">− '+fmtM(d)+'</b> ('+(grand>0?(Math.round(d/grand*10000)/100):0)+'%)'+
        '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--txt3);margin-top:3px">Maximum allowed is the grand total '+fmtM(grand)+'</div>';
      box.style.display='block';
    } else if(grand>0){
      box.innerHTML='Enter the amount the customer will pay — anything up to '+fmtM(grand)+'.';
      box.style.display='block';
    } else { box.style.display='none'; }
  }
}

/* The company month runs 6th → 5th of the next month. */
function cycleRange(dateStr){
  var d = dateStr ? new Date(dateStr+'T00:00:00') : new Date();
  var y=d.getFullYear(), m=d.getMonth(), day=d.getDate();
  var start,end;
  if(day>=6){ start=new Date(y,m,6); end=new Date(y,m+1,5); }
  else      { start=new Date(y,m-1,6); end=new Date(y,m,5); }
  function iso(x){ function p(n){return n<10?('0'+n):(''+n);} return x.getFullYear()+'-'+p(x.getMonth()+1)+'-'+p(x.getDate()); }
  return {from:iso(start), to:iso(end), label:fmtD(iso(start))+' → '+fmtD(iso(end))};
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REMARKS FOR OFFICE USE — 400 WORD LIMIT (not 400 characters)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   • Live word counter (0 / 400).
   • Trims to 400 words without cutting the last word mid-way.
   • Caret is only reset when a trim actually happens.
   • Paste of a huge blob is clamped, not rejected.
   • Model kept on BILL.office_remarks so billPayload() is never stale.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

var REMARKS_MAX_WORDS = 400;

function lifeCountWords(str){
  var s = String(str == null ? '' : str).trim();
  if(!s) return 0;
  return s.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
}

/* Trim to at most N words WITHOUT cutting the last word mid-way. */
function lifeTrimToWords(str, max){
  var s = String(str == null ? '' : str);
  if(lifeCountWords(s) <= max) return s;

  var out = [], i = 0, n = s.length, buf = '';
  for(; i < n; i++){
    var ch = s.charAt(i);
    if(/\s/.test(ch)){
      if(buf){ out.push(buf); buf = ''; }
      if(out.length >= max){
        /* skip the rest of this whitespace run, then stop */
        while(i + 1 < n && /\s/.test(s.charAt(i+1))) i++;
        return out.join(' ');
      }
    } else {
      buf += ch;
    }
  }
  if(buf && out.length < max) out.push(buf);
  return out.join(' ');
}

function lifeRemarksInput(el){
  if(!el) return;

  var raw   = el.value || '';
  var words = lifeCountWords(raw);
  var overflowed = false;

  if(words > REMARKS_MAX_WORDS){
    var trimmed = lifeTrimToWords(raw, REMARKS_MAX_WORDS);
    if(trimmed !== raw){
      el.value = trimmed;
      overflowed = true;
      try{ el.setSelectionRange(trimmed.length, trimmed.length); }catch(e){}
    }
    words = REMARKS_MAX_WORDS;
  }

  /* Keep the model in sync so billPayload() never sees a stale value. */
  if(typeof BILL !== 'undefined' && BILL){
    BILL.office_remarks = el.value;
  }

  var counter = _g('bl-remarks-count');
  if(counter){
    counter.textContent = words + ' / ' + REMARKS_MAX_WORDS;
    counter.style.color =
      (words >= REMARKS_MAX_WORDS - 20) ? 'var(--red)' :
      (words >= REMARKS_MAX_WORDS - 60) ? 'var(--amber)' :
      'var(--txt3)';
  }

  if(overflowed && typeof alertMsg === 'function'){
    alertMsg('Remarks for office use cannot exceed ' +
             REMARKS_MAX_WORDS + ' words.', 'amber');
  }
}
window.lifeRemarksInput = lifeRemarksInput;

/* Paste handler: strip + clamp so a 5,000-word paste lands as 400 words —
   not truncated mid-word and not rejected outright. */
function lifeRemarksPaste(el, event){
  if(!el || !event) return;
  var cd = event.clipboardData || window.clipboardData;
  if(!cd) return;

  var pasted = cd.getData('text');
  if(!pasted) return;

  event.preventDefault();

  var start = el.selectionStart != null ? el.selectionStart : el.value.length;
  var end   = el.selectionEnd   != null ? el.selectionEnd   : el.value.length;

  var before = el.value.slice(0, start);
  var after  = el.value.slice(end);

  var combined = before + pasted + after;
  var trimmed  = lifeTrimToWords(combined, REMARKS_MAX_WORDS);

  el.value = trimmed;

  var newCaret = (before + pasted).length;
  if(newCaret > trimmed.length) newCaret = trimmed.length;
  try{ el.setSelectionRange(newCaret, newCaret); }catch(e){}

  lifeRemarksInput(el);

  if(trimmed.length < combined.length && typeof alertMsg === 'function'){
    alertMsg('Pasted text was trimmed to the ' +
             REMARKS_MAX_WORDS + '-word limit for remarks.', 'amber');
  }
}
window.lifeRemarksPaste = lifeRemarksPaste;

/* Read the current remarks value safely — DOM first, model second. */
function lifeRemarksValue(){
  var el = _g('bl-remarks');
  var raw = el ? (el.value || '') : (BILL && BILL.office_remarks) || '';
  return lifeTrimToWords(String(raw), REMARKS_MAX_WORDS);
}
window.lifeRemarksValue = lifeRemarksValue;

/* Client name: letters only, Title Cased as they type. */
function nameInput(el){
  if(!el)return;
  var raw=el.value||'';
  var hadDigit=/\d/.test(raw);
  var clean=raw.replace(/[^A-Za-z .'\-]/g,'');
  clean=clean.replace(/\s{2,}/g,' ');
  clean=clean.replace(/[A-Za-z]+/g, function(w){
    return w.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+w.slice(1).toLowerCase();
  });
  if(clean!==raw){
    var pos=el.selectionStart;
    el.value=clean;
    try{ el.setSelectionRange(pos,pos); }catch(e){}
  }
  var note=_g('rg-name-note');
  if(note){
    if(hadDigit){ note.innerHTML='⚠️ Numbers are not allowed in a client name.'; note.style.display='block'; }
    else { note.style.display='none'; }
  }
}
/* Mobile: live feedback on the 10-digit / 6-9 rule. */
function mobileCheck(){
  var el=_g('rg-mobile'), note=_g('rg-mob-note');
  if(!el||!note) return true;
  var d=normMobile(el.value);
  if(!d){ note.style.display='none'; return false; }
  if(d.length<10){ note.innerHTML='⚠️ '+d.length+' of 10 digits'; note.style.color='var(--red)'; note.style.display='block'; return false; }
  if(d.length>10){ note.innerHTML='⚠️ Too many digits'; note.style.color='var(--red)'; note.style.display='block'; return false; }
  if(!/^[6-9]/.test(d)){ note.innerHTML='⚠️ An Indian mobile starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9.'; note.style.color='var(--red)'; note.style.display='block'; return false; }
  note.innerHTML='✔ Valid mobile'; note.style.color='var(--g1)'; note.style.display='block';
  return true;
}
/* DOB sanity check */
function dobCheck(){
  var el=_g('rg-dob'), note=_g('rg-dob-note');
  if(!el||!note)return true;
  var v=(el.value||'').trim();
  if(!v){ note.style.display='none'; return true; }
  var m=/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(v);
  if(!m){ note.innerHTML='⚠️ Enter the date using the calendar picker.'; note.style.color='var(--red)'; note.style.display='block'; return false; }
  var y=parseInt(m[1],10);
  var d=new Date(v+'T00:00:00');
  var t0=new Date(); t0.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  if(isNaN(d.getTime())){ note.innerHTML='⚠️ That date is not valid.'; note.style.color='var(--red)'; note.style.display='block'; return false; }
  if(y<1900){ note.innerHTML='⚠️ Year looks wrong ('+y+'). Use the calendar picker.'; note.style.color='var(--red)'; note.style.display='block'; return false; }
  if(d>t0){ note.innerHTML='⚠️ Date of birth cannot be in the future.'; note.style.color='var(--red)'; note.style.display='block'; return false; }
  var age=Math.floor((t0-d)/(365.25*24*3600*1000));
  if(age>120){ note.innerHTML='⚠️ That would make the client '+age+' years old.'; note.style.color='var(--red)'; note.style.display='block'; return false; }
  note.innerHTML='Age '+age+' years'; note.style.color='var(--txt3)'; note.style.display='block';

}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PACKAGE-ONLY THERAPIES — billable only inside a package / template
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var PACKAGE_ONLY_PREFIXES = [
  'LIFErise',     // LIFErise P1/P2/P3 components + LIFErise Online items
  'IH'            // "IH — …" / "IH - …" in-house package components
];
var PACKAGE_ONLY_SUFFIXES = ['-SLE','-AAGE'];
var PACKAGE_ONLY_THERAPIES = [
  // exact therapy names, e.g. 'Diet Counselling',
];
function isPackageOnly(name){
  if(!name) return false;
  var n=String(name).trim().toLowerCase();
  for(var p=0;p<PACKAGE_ONLY_PREFIXES.length;p++){
    var pre=String(PACKAGE_ONLY_PREFIXES[p]).trim().toLowerCase();
    if(pre && (n===pre || n.indexOf(pre+' ')===0 || n.indexOf(pre+'-')===0 ||
               n.indexOf(pre+' —')===0 || n.indexOf(pre+' -')===0)) return true;
  }
  for(var sfx=0;sfx<PACKAGE_ONLY_SUFFIXES.length;sfx++){
    var suf=String(PACKAGE_ONLY_SUFFIXES[sfx]).trim().toLowerCase();
    if(suf && n.length>=suf.length && n.slice(-suf.length)===suf) return true;
  }
  for(var i=0;i<PACKAGE_ONLY_THERAPIES.length;i++){
    if(String(PACKAGE_ONLY_THERAPIES[i]).trim().toLowerCase()===n) return true;
  }
  for(var c=0;c<CATALOG.length;c++){
    if(CATALOG[c].n && CATALOG[c].n.toLowerCase()===n) return CATALOG[c].pkg_only===1;
  }
  return false;
}
