/* ================================================================
   FIXED CASCADING DISCOUNT
   L1 / L2 / L3 percentages are ALWAYS based on ORIGINAL BILL BASE.
   5% + 5% + 5% = exactly 15%.
   ================================================================ */

var CASCADE_CAP_PCT = 15;

function requestNextApproval(inv){

  if(!inv){
    return;
  }


  var _si=null;
  var _reqs=[];


  /* ============================================================
     LOAD INVOICE
     ============================================================ */

  getDoc(
    'Sales Invoice',
    inv
  )

  .then(function(si){


    if(!si){

      throw new Error(
        'Sales Invoice could not be loaded.'
      );

    }


    if(si.docstatus!==0){

      alertMsg(
        'This bill is already submitted. '+
        'Discount can only be requested while Draft.',
        'red'
      );

      return Promise.reject({
        message:'cancelled'
      });

    }


    _si=si;


    return getList(

      'Discount Approval Request',

      [
        ['linked_invoice','=',inv]
      ],

      [
        'name',
        'selected_approver',
        'requested_by',
        'status',
        'approval_level',
        'bill_total',
        'requested_discount_pct',
        'approved_discount_pct',
        'requested_final_amount',
        'approved_final_amount',
        'approved_by',
        'approved_at',
        'creation',
        'linked_invoice'
      ],

      {
        limit:0,
        order_by:'creation asc'
      }

    );

  })


  /* ============================================================
     EXISTING APPROVALS
     ============================================================ */

  .then(function(reqs){


    _reqs=reqs||[];


    var anyPending=
      _reqs.some(function(r){
        return r.status==='Pending';
      });


    if(anyPending){

      alertMsg(
        'A discount request is already Pending. '+
        'Approve or reject it first.',
        'red'
      );

      return Promise.reject({
        message:'cancelled'
      });

    }


    /* ==========================================================
       USED LEVELS
       ========================================================== */

    var usedLevels={};
    var usedApprovers={};


    _reqs.forEach(function(r){

      if(
        r.status==='Pending' ||
        r.status==='Approved'
      ){

        if(r.approval_level){

          usedLevels[
            r.approval_level
          ]=true;

        }


        if(r.selected_approver){

          usedApprovers[
            r.selected_approver
          ]=true;

        }

      }

    });


    /* ==========================================================
       FIXED ORIGINAL GRAND TOTAL INCLUDING GST

       Never use the invoice's current grand_total after an approval because
       that value is already discounted. The first approval request stores
       the permanent GST-inclusive base in bill_total.
       ========================================================== */

    var orig=0;

    _reqs.forEach(function(r){
      if(!(orig>0)){
        var stored=parseFloat(r.bill_total||0);
        if(stored>0)orig=stored;
      }
    });

    /* Fallback only for an invoice that has no earlier approval request. */
    if(!(orig>0)){
      orig=parseFloat(
        _si.grand_total ||
        _si.rounded_total ||
        0
      );
    }


    if(!(orig>0)){

      alertMsg(
        'Original Grand Total including GST could not be identified.',
        'red'
      );

      return Promise.reject({
        message:'cancelled'
      });

    }


    /*
     * L4 amount includes GST, so its upper limit is the current
     * invoice GRAND TOTAL, not the original Grand Total including GST.
     */
    var currentGrand=parseFloat(
      _si.grand_total ||
      0
    );


    /* ==========================================================
       APPROVED NORMAL %
       ========================================================== */

    var approvedPct=0;


    _reqs.forEach(function(r){

      if(r.status!=='Approved'){
        return;
      }


      var lvl=
        r.approval_level || 'L1';


      if(lvl==='L4'){
        return;
      }


      var p=parseFloat(

        r.requested_discount_pct ||

        r.approved_discount_pct ||

        0

      );


      if(p>0){
        approvedPct+=p;
      }

    });


    approvedPct=
      Math.round(
        approvedPct*100
      )/100;


    var siPct=parseFloat(
      _si.total_approver_discount_pct || 0
    );


    if(
      siPct>approvedPct &&
      siPct<=CASCADE_CAP_PCT
    ){

      approvedPct=siPct;

    }


    var approvedAmount=
      Math.round(
        orig*approvedPct
      )/100;


    var currentTaxable=
      Math.round(
        (
          orig-approvedAmount
        )*100
      )/100;


    var avail=
      Math.round(
        (
          CASCADE_CAP_PCT-approvedPct
        )*100
      )/100;


    if(avail<0){
      avail=0;
    }


    /* ==========================================================
       APPROVER OPTIONS
       ========================================================== */

    var opts=[];


    if(
      !usedLevels.L1 &&
      !usedApprovers[CURRENT_USER] &&
      avail>0
    ){

      opts.push({

        value:
          CURRENT_USER,

        label:
          CURRENT_USER+
          ' · L1 · Branch Level'

      });

    }


    (APPROVERS||[]).forEach(function(a){


      if(
        !a ||
        !a.user
      ){
        return;
      }


      if(a.user===CURRENT_USER){
        return;
      }


      var lvl=
        a.approval_level || 'L1';


      /*
       * One approval per LEVEL.
       */
      if(usedLevels[lvl]){
        return;
      }


      if(usedApprovers[a.user]){
        return;
      }


      /*
       * After 15% only L4.
       */
      if(
        avail<=0 &&
        lvl!=='L4'
      ){
        return;
      }


      opts.push({

        value:
          a.user,

        label:
          (
            a.full_name ||
            a.user
          )+
          ' · '+
          lvl+
          (
            a.designation
              ? ' · '+a.designation
              : ''
          )

      });

    });


    if(!opts.length){

      alertMsg(
        'No further discount approval level is available.',
        'amber'
      );

      return Promise.reject({
        message:'cancelled'
      });

    }


    opts.unshift({

      value:'',
      label:'— Select approver —'

    });


    /* ==========================================================
       DIALOG
       ========================================================== */

    return uiDialog({

      title:
        '🔐 Request Discount Approval',

      subtitle:
        'L1 / L2 / L3 can approve up to 5% each. '+
        'All percentages are based on the original Grand Total including GST.',

      info:

        '<b>'+esc(inv)+'</b>'+

        '<br>Original Grand Total including GST: <b>'+
        fmtM(orig)+
        '</b>'+

        '<br>Already approved: <b>'+
        approvedPct+
        '%</b> = '+
        '<b style="color:var(--red)">− '+
        fmtM(approvedAmount)+
        '</b>'+

        '<br>Current payable including GST: '+
        '<b style="color:var(--g1)">'+
        fmtM(currentTaxable)+
        '</b>'+

        '<br>Normal approval remaining: <b>'+
        avail+
        '%</b>',


      fields:[


        /* APPROVER */

        {

          name:'approver',
          label:'Approver',
          type:'select',
          options:opts,
          required:true,


          live:function(val){


            var lvl='';


            if(val===CURRENT_USER){
              lvl='L1';
            }


            (APPROVERS||[]).forEach(function(a){

              if(a.user===val){

                lvl=
                  a.approval_level ||
                  'L1';

              }

            });


            var pctInput=
              _g('dlgf-1');

            var finalInput=
              _g('dlgf-2');


            var pctWrap=
              pctInput
                ? pctInput.parentElement
                : null;


            var finalWrap=
              finalInput
                ? finalInput.parentElement
                : null;


            if(!val){

              if(pctWrap){
                pctWrap.style.display='none';
              }

              if(finalWrap){
                finalWrap.style.display='none';
              }

              if(pctInput){
                pctInput.value='';
              }

              if(finalInput){
                finalInput.value='';
              }

              return '';
            }


            if(lvl==='L4'){

              if(pctWrap){
                pctWrap.style.display='none';
              }

              if(finalWrap){
                finalWrap.style.display='';
              }

              if(pctInput){
                pctInput.value='';
              }

            }

            else{

              if(pctWrap){
                pctWrap.style.display='';
              }

              if(finalWrap){
                finalWrap.style.display='none';
              }

              if(finalInput){
                finalInput.value='';
              }

            }


            return '';

          }

        },


        /* PERCENTAGE */

        {

          name:'pct',
          label:'Discount %',
          type:'number',
          placeholder:'e.g. 5',

          hint:
            'Calculated from original Grand Total including GST '+
            fmtM(orig)+'.',


          live:function(val,el){


            var p=
              parseFloat(
                val || 0
              );


            var cap=
              Math.min(
                5,
                avail
              );


            if(p>cap){

              p=cap;
              el.value=cap;

            }


            if(p<0){

              p=0;
              el.value=0;

            }


            if(!(p>0)){

              return (
                'Enter up to <b>'+
                cap+
                '%</b>.'
              );

            }


            var thisDisc=
              Math.round(
                orig*p
              )/100;


            var totalPct=
              Math.round(
                (
                  approvedPct+p
                )*100
              )/100;


            var totalDisc=
              Math.round(
                orig*totalPct
              )/100;


            var after=
              Math.round(
                (
                  orig-totalDisc
                )*100
              )/100;


            return (

              '<b>'+
              p+
              '%</b> = '+
              '<b style="color:var(--red)">− '+
              fmtM(thisDisc)+
              '</b>'+

              '<br>Total approved: <b>'+
              totalPct+
              '%</b> = '+
              '<b style="color:var(--red)">− '+
              fmtM(totalDisc)+
              '</b>'+

              '<br>Payable including GST after discount: '+
              '<b style="color:var(--g1)">'+
              fmtM(after)+
              '</b>'

            );

          }

        },


        /* L4 */

        {

          name:'final_amount',

          label:
            'Final invoice amount including GST — L4 / MD only ₹',

          type:'number',

          placeholder:
            'Final invoice amount including GST approved by MD'

        },


        /* REASON */

        {

          name:'reason',
          label:'Reason',
          type:'textarea',
          required:true

        }

      ],


      okLabel:
        'Send for approval',


      validate:function(v){


        var lvl='L1';


        if(v.approver===CURRENT_USER){
          lvl='L1';
        }


        (APPROVERS||[]).forEach(function(a){

          if(a.user===v.approver){

            lvl=
              a.approval_level ||
              'L1';

          }

        });


        if(usedLevels[lvl]){

          return (
            lvl+
            ' approval is already used for this bill.'
          );

        }


        var p=
          parseFloat(
            v.pct || 0
          );


        var fa=
          parseFloat(
            v.final_amount || 0
          );


        if(lvl==='L4'){

          if(!(fa>0)){

            return (
              'L4 / MD must enter the final invoice amount including GST.'
            );

          }


          if(
            currentGrand>0 &&
            fa>=currentGrand
          ){

            return (
              'Final invoice amount must be less than the current invoice total '+
              fmtM(currentGrand)+
              '.'
            );

          }

        }

        else{

          if(!(p>0)){

            return (
              'Enter a discount percentage.'
            );

          }


          if(avail<=0){

            return (
              'Normal 15% approval limit is exhausted. '+
              'Use L4 / MD.'
            );

          }


          var cap=
            Math.min(
              (
                LEVEL_INFO[lvl] ||
                {}
              ).max || 5,
              avail
            );


          if(p>cap){

            return (
              lvl+
              ' can approve at most '+
              cap+
              '%.'
            );

          }

        }


        return '';

      }

    })

    .then(function(v){

      return {
        values:v,
        orig:orig
      };

    });

  })


  /* ============================================================
     SEND REQUEST
     ============================================================ */

  .then(function(ctx){


    if(!ctx){
      return;
    }


    var v=ctx.values;
    var orig=ctx.orig;


    var lvl='L1';


    if(v.approver===CURRENT_USER){
      lvl='L1';
    }


    (APPROVERS||[]).forEach(function(a){

      if(a.user===v.approver){

        lvl=
          a.approval_level ||
          'L1';

      }

    });


    var isL4=
      lvl==='L4';


    var normalPct=
      isL4
        ? 0
        : parseFloat(
            v.pct || 0
          );


    var finalAmount=
      isL4
        ? parseFloat(
            v.final_amount || 0
          )
        : 0;


    /* ----------------------------------------------------------
       Find underlying Request Discount button.
       Dialog is closed now, so user sees spinner there.
       ---------------------------------------------------------- */

    var requestBtn=null;


    try{

      var buttons=
        ROOT.querySelectorAll(
          '#bill-actions button'
        );


      Array.prototype.forEach.call(
        buttons,
        function(b){

          var oc=
            b.getAttribute('onclick') || '';

          if(
            oc.indexOf(
              'requestNextApproval'
            )>=0
          ){

            requestBtn=b;

          }

        }
      );

    }catch(_){}


    var restoreRequest=
      btnBusy(
        requestBtn,
        'Sending…'
      );


    return call(

      'create_discount_approval_request',

      {

        invoice_name:
          inv,

        selected_approver:
          v.approver,

        approval_level:
          lvl,

        requested_discount_pct:
          normalPct,

        requested_final_amount:
          finalAmount,

        reason:
          v.reason

      }

    )

    .then(function(data){


      if(restoreRequest){
        restoreRequest();
        restoreRequest=null;
      }


      data=data||{};


      BILL_REQS=
        BILL_REQS || [];


      var requestedPct=
        normalPct;


      if(isL4){

        requestedPct=
          orig>0
            ? Math.round(
                (
                  (
                    orig-finalAmount
                  ) /
                  orig *
                  100
                ) *
                100
              ) / 100
            : 0;

      }


      BILL_REQS.push({

        name:
          data.request_name || '',

        linked_invoice:
          inv,

        requested_by:
          CURRENT_USER,

        selected_approver:
          v.approver,

        bill_total:
          orig,

        approval_level:
          lvl,

        status:
          'Pending',

        requested_discount_pct:
          requestedPct,

        requested_final_amount:
          isL4
            ? finalAmount
            : 0,

        approved_discount_pct:
          0,

        approved_final_amount:
          0,

        approved_by:
          '',

        approved_at:
          '',

        creation:
          new Date().toISOString()

      });


      if(BILL_DOC){

        BILL_DOC.discount_locked=1;

        BILL_DOC.approval_workflow_status=
          'Pending Approval';

        BILL_DOC.original_bill_total=
          orig;

      }


      renderBillDrawer();


      alertMsg(

        v.approver===CURRENT_USER

          ? 'Request raised — approve it from this bill.'

          : (
              'Approval request sent to '+
              v.approver+
              '.'
            ),

        'green'

      );


      try{
        updateApprBadge();
      }catch(_){}


      try{
        renderApprovals();
      }catch(_){}


      return data;

    })

    .catch(function(e){


      if(restoreRequest){
        restoreRequest();
        restoreRequest=null;
      }


      throw e;

    });

  })


  /* ============================================================
     ERROR
     ============================================================ */

  .catch(function(e){


    if(
      e &&
      e.message==='cancelled'
    ){
      return;
    }


    alertMsg(
      'Discount request failed: '+
      serverErr(e),
      'red'
    );

  });

}

function nowStamp(){
  try{ if(typeof frappe!=='undefined' && frappe.datetime && frappe.datetime.now_datetime) return frappe.datetime.now_datetime(); }catch(e){}
  var d=new Date();
  function p(n){return n<10?'0'+n:''+n;}
  return d.getFullYear()+'-'+p(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+p(d.getDate())+' '+p(d.getHours())+':'+p(d.getMinutes())+':'+p(d.getSeconds());
}

function lifeUpdateGlpSessionMessage(row){

/* offer detection + apply per therapy line. */
function offerCheckRow(row,i){
  var slot=row.querySelector('.tp-offer'); if(!slot)return;
  var ln=BILL.lines[i]; if(!ln||!ln.therapy){ slot.innerHTML=''; return; }
  var c=catItem(ln.therapy); if(!c||!c.item){ slot.innerHTML=''; return; }
  var qty=parseFloat(row.querySelector('.tp-qty').value||0);
  var offs=offersFor(c.item, qty);
  if(!offs.length){ slot.innerHTML=''; ln.use_offer=false; ln.offer=null; return; }
  var o=offs[0];
  var oRate=offerRate(o, c.rec);
  var applied = !!(ln.use_offer || ln.offer);
  /* If the offer is applied and its rate was auto-adjusted, show the actual
     applied rate (and flag it), not the pricing-rule rate. */
  var shownRate = oRate;
  var adjusted = false;
  if(applied && ln.offer && ln.offer.rate!==undefined){
    shownRate = parseFloat(ln.offer.rate);
    if(Math.abs(shownRate-oRate) > 0.5) adjusted = true;
  }
  slot.innerHTML=
    '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#FFF7ED;border:1px solid var(--amber-bd);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px;flex-wrap:wrap">'+
      '<span style="font-size:12px;color:#92400E">🏷️ Offer: <b>'+esc(o.title||o.name)+'</b> → rate '+fmtM(shownRate)+'/session'+(adjusted?' <span style="color:var(--g1);font-weight:700">(adjusted)</span>':'')+(o.min_qty?' (min qty '+o.min_qty+')':'')+'</span>'+
      '<label class="toggle" style="margin-left:auto"><input type="checkbox" class="offtg"'+(applied?' checked':'')+'><span class="tg-slider"></span></label>'+
      '<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--txt3)">'+(applied?'Applied':'Apply offer')+'</span>'+
    '</div>';
  var tg=slot.querySelector('.offtg');
  tg.onchange=function(){
    ln.use_offer=this.checked;
    ln.offer=this.checked?{name:o.name, rate:oRate, item_code:c.item}:null;
    var rateInp=row.querySelector('.tp-rate'), amtInp=row.querySelector('.tp-amt');
    if(this.checked){
      if(ln.base_rate===undefined) ln.base_rate=parseFloat(ln.rate||c.rec||0);
      ln.rate=oRate; rateInp.value=oRate; rateInp.disabled=true;
    } else {
      var back = (ln.base_rate!==undefined && ln.base_rate>0) ? ln.base_rate : c.rec;
      ln.rate=back; rateInp.value=back; rateInp.disabled=false;
      ln.base_rate=undefined;
    }
    ln.qty=parseFloat(row.querySelector('.tp-qty').value||0);
    amtInp.value=(ln.qty*ln.rate).toFixed(0);
    recalc();
    offerCheckRow(row,i);
  };
}

function currentLines(){ return BILL.lines.filter(function(l){return l&&l.therapy&&l.qty>0;}); }
function recalc(){
  var lines=currentLines();
  var subRaw=lines.reduce(function(s,l){return s+l.qty*l.rate;},0);
  /* OPTION A: coupon is a fixed rupee reduction shown as its own line.
     Coupon % is computed from the FULL bill for the 15% cap. */
  var couponAmt = 0;
  if(COUPON_AMOUNT>0){ couponAmt = Math.min(COUPON_AMOUNT, subRaw); }
  else if(COUPON_PCT>0){ couponAmt = Math.round(subRaw*COUPON_PCT)/100; }
  if(subRaw>0 && couponAmt>0){ COUPON_PCT = Math.round((couponAmt*100/subRaw)*100)/100; }
  var pct=parseFloat(_v('bl-disc-pct')||0); if(pct>5)pct=5;
  /* staff % applies on the full bill (same base as coupon), both within 15% */
  var disc=Math.round(subRaw*pct/100);
  var sub = subRaw;
  /* Fixed package price: item rates stay, the gap is a Net Total discount. */
  var pkg=parseFloat(BILL.pkg_price||0), pkgDisc=0;
  if(pkg>0 && sub>pkg){ pkgDisc=Math.round((sub-pkg)*100)/100; }
  var net=subRaw-couponAmt-disc-pkgDisc;
  if(net<0)net=0;
  var gst=Math.round(net*GST*100)/100, total=Math.round((net+gst)*100)/100;
  BILL.disc={pct:pct,amt:disc,by:_v('bl-disc-by')};
  _s('bl-brk',
    '<div class="brk-row"><span>Subtotal</span><b class="money">'+fmtM(subRaw)+'</b></div>'+
    (couponAmt>0?'<div class="brk-row"><span>Coupon '+(COUPON_APPLIED?esc(COUPON_APPLIED):'')+' ('+COUPON_PCT+'%)</span><b class="money" style="color:var(--red)">− '+fmtM(couponAmt)+'</b></div>':'')+
    (pkgDisc>0?'<div class="brk-row"><span>Package price ('+esc(BILL.pkg_name||'fixed')+')</span><b class="money" style="color:var(--red)">− '+fmtM(pkgDisc)+'</b></div>':'')+
    (disc>0?'<div class="brk-row"><span>Discount ('+pct+'%)</span><b class="money" style="color:var(--red)">− '+fmtM(disc)+'</b></div>':'')+
    (pkgDisc>0?'<div class="brk-row"><span>Net Total</span><b class="money">'+fmtM(net)+'</b></div>':'')+
    '<div class="brk-row"><span>GST 5%</span><b class="money">'+fmtM(gst)+'</b></div>'+
    '<div class="brk-row brk-total"><span>Grand Total</span><b class="money">'+fmtM(total)+'</b></div>');
  var gen=_g('bl-generate'); if(gen)gen.classList.toggle('ready', lines.length>0);
  BILL._totals={sub:sub,subRaw:subRaw,couponAmt:couponAmt,disc:disc,gst:gst,total:total,pkg_disc:pkgDisc,net:net};
  var sb=_g('bl-sub-big'); if(sb)sb.textContent=Math.round(sub).toLocaleString('en-IN');
  var sw=_g('bl-sub-words'); if(sw)sw.textContent=sub>0?numWords(Math.round(sub)):'';
  try{ updateCompSlab(); }catch(e){}
  try{ updatePlanCatNote(); }catch(e){}
  try{ updateDiscountVisibility(); }catch(e){}
  return BILL._totals;
}

var COUPON_APPLIED = "";
var COUPON_PCT = 0;
var COUPON_AMOUNT = 0;
var COUPON_TYPE = "";

function applyCoupon(){
  var codeEl = _g('bl-coupon-code');
  var statusEl = _g('bl-coupon-status');
  var code = codeEl ? (codeEl.value||'').trim() : '';
  var mob = (BILL && BILL.client && BILL.client.mobile) ? BILL.client.mobile : '';
  var args = {};
  if(code){ args.coupon_code = code; } else { args.mobile = mob; }
  if(statusEl){ statusEl.style.color='var(--txt4)'; statusEl.textContent='Checking…'; }
  call('validate_coupon', args).then(function(res){
    if(res && res.valid===1){
      COUPON_APPLIED = res.coupon_code;
      COUPON_TYPE = res.discount_type;
      if(res.discount_type==='Fixed Amount'){
        COUPON_AMOUNT = res.discount_value;
        var subNow=(BILL._totals&&BILL._totals.subRaw)||0;
        COUPON_PCT = subNow>0 ? Math.round((COUPON_AMOUNT*100/subNow)*100)/100 : 0;
      } else {
        COUPON_PCT = res.discount_value;
        COUPON_AMOUNT = 0;
      }
      if(codeEl){ codeEl.value = res.coupon_code; }
      if(statusEl){
        statusEl.style.color='#1a8a3a';
        var lbl = (res.discount_type==='Fixed Amount') ? ('\u20b9'+res.discount_value+' off') : (res.discount_value+'% off');
        statusEl.textContent='\u2713 '+lbl+' coupon applied for '+(res.client_name||'client')+' (valid till '+(res.valid_until||'')+')';
      }
      try{ if(typeof recalc==='function') recalc(); }catch(e){}
      try{ if(typeof discPctChange==='function') discPctChange(); }catch(e){}
    } else {
      COUPON_APPLIED = ""; COUPON_PCT = 0;
      if(statusEl){ statusEl.style.color='#c0392b'; statusEl.textContent='\u2717 '+((res&&res.error)||'Coupon not valid'); }
    }
  });
}

function showGenErr(msg){

function confirmGenerate(){

  var lines=currentLines();

  if(!lines.length){
    showGenErr('Add at least one therapy line');
    return;
  }


  var payload=billPayload();

  var wantDisc=
    payload.draft_only===1;


  /*
   * Always create invoice as Draft.
   */
  payload.draft_only=1;


  var eb=_g('pv-err');

  if(eb){
    eb.innerHTML='';
    eb.style.display='none';
  }


  /* ============================================================
     PACKAGE VALIDATION
     ============================================================ */

  if(BILL_MODE!=='package'){

    var blocked=lines.filter(function(l){
      return isPackageOnly(l.therapy);
    });

    if(blocked.length){

      showGenErr(
        blocked[0].therapy+
        ' can only be billed as part of a package — '+
        'switch to Package / Template.'
      );

      return;
    }
  }


  /* ============================================================
     SOURCE VALIDATION
     ============================================================ */

  if(!payload.plan_media){

    showGenErr(
      'Select the Source / Media '+
      '(Call Center / Reference / Direct Walk-in / Existing Customer)'
    );

    return;
  }


  if(payload.plan_media==='Reference'){

    var rc=_g('bl-ref-isclient');
    var re=_g('bl-ref-isemp');

    var anyRef=
      (rc&&rc.checked) ||
      (re&&re.checked);


    if(!anyRef){

      showGenErr(
        'Source is Reference — tick whether it came '+
        'from a client or an employee'
      );

      return;
    }


    if(
      rc &&
      rc.checked &&
      !payload.reference_client
    ){

      showGenErr(
        'Pick the referring client from the search list'
      );

      return;
    }


    if(
      re &&
      re.checked &&
      !payload.reference_employee
    ){

      showGenErr(
        'Select the referring employee'
      );

      return;
    }

  }


  /* ============================================================
     INCENTIVE VALIDATION
     ============================================================ */

  if(
    payload.sharing_incentive &&
    !payload.incentive_employee
  ){

    showGenErr(
      'Sharing Incentive is ticked — select the incentive employee'
    );

    return;
  }


  /* ============================================================
     DISCOUNT VALIDATION
     ============================================================ */

  if(wantDisc){

    if(!payload.discount_approver){

      showGenErr(
        'Select an approver for the discount'
      );

      return;
    }


    if(!payload.discount_reason){

      showGenErr(
        'Enter a reason for the discount'
      );

      return;
    }


    if(
      !(payload.discount_pct>0) &&
      !(payload.discount_final_amount>0)
    ){

      showGenErr(
        'Enter a discount % or an L4 final amount'
      );

      return;
    }


    if(
      payload.discount_approver===CURRENT_USER &&
      payload.discount_pct>5
    ){

      showGenErr(
        'You can self-approve up to 5% only — '+
        'choose a higher approver for '+
        payload.discount_pct+
        '%'
      );

      return;
    }

  }


  /* ============================================================
     BUTTONS
     ============================================================ */

  var gen=_g('bl-generate');

  var pvBtn=
    _q('#m-preview .btn-green');


  var mainBtn=
    pvBtn || gen;


  /*
   * Mild button spinner only.
   */
  var restoreCreate=
    btnBusy(
      mainBtn,
      wantDisc
        ? 'Creating draft…'
        : 'Generating…'
    );


  if(gen && gen!==mainBtn){
    gen.disabled=true;
  }


  /* ============================================================
     CREATE PLAN + INVOICE
     ============================================================ */

  call(
    'lifescc.billing.create_plan_and_invoice_TEST',
    payload
  )

  .then(function(res){


    if(restoreCreate){
      restoreCreate();
      restoreCreate=null;
    }


    if(gen){
      gen.disabled=false;
    }


    if(
      !res ||
      !res.sales_invoice
    ){

      showGenErr(
        (
          res &&
          res.error
        )
        ||
        'Generation failed — check therapy rates / permissions'
      );

      return;
    }


    /* ==========================================================
       WITHOUT DISCOUNT
       ========================================================== */

    if(!wantDisc){

      finishGenerate(
        res,
        gen,
        pvBtn
      );

      return;
    }


    /* ==========================================================
       DISCOUNT FLOW
       ========================================================== */

    var inv=
      res.sales_invoice;


    var bt=parseFloat(
      res.subtotal ||
      res.total ||
      res.grand_total ||
      0
    );

    /*
     * L4 input means FINAL GRAND TOTAL INCLUDING GST.
     * Keep the invoice grand total separately from taxable base.
     */
    var originalGrand=parseFloat(
      res.grand_total ||
      0
    );


    if(!(bt>0)){

      showGenErr(
        'Draft '+inv+
        ' was created, but original Grand Total including GST '+
        'could not be identified.'
      );

      openBill(inv);

      return;
    }


    /* ==========================================================
       APPROVAL LEVEL
       ========================================================== */

    var appLevel='';

    var sel=
      _g('bl-disc-approver');


    if(
      sel &&
      sel.selectedOptions &&
      sel.selectedOptions[0]
    ){

      appLevel=
        sel.selectedOptions[0]
          .getAttribute('data-level')
        || '';

    }


    /*
     * Fallback from loaded Approver Master.
     */
    if(!appLevel){

      (APPROVERS||[]).forEach(function(a){

        if(
          a.user===
          payload.discount_approver
        ){

          appLevel=
            a.approval_level ||
            'L1';

        }

      });

    }


    if(
      payload.discount_approver===
      CURRENT_USER &&
      !appLevel
    ){

      appLevel='L1';

    }


    if(
      ['L1','L2','L3','L4']
        .indexOf(appLevel)<0
    ){

      appLevel='L1';

    }


    var isL4=
      appLevel==='L4';


    var pct=
      parseFloat(
        payload.discount_pct || 0
      );


    var finalAmount=
      parseFloat(
        payload.discount_final_amount || 0
      );


    /* ==========================================================
       L4 VALIDATION
       ========================================================== */

    if(isL4){

      if(!(finalAmount>0)){

        showGenErr(
          'L4 / MD must enter the final invoice amount including GST.'
        );

        return;
      }


      if(
        originalGrand>0 &&
        finalAmount>=originalGrand
      ){

        showGenErr(
          'L4 final invoice amount must be less than the current invoice total '+
          fmtM(originalGrand)+
          '.'
        );

        return;
      }

    }


    /* ==========================================================
       MILD SECOND STAGE LOADER
       ========================================================== */

    var restoreApproval=
      btnBusy(
        mainBtn,
        'Sending approval…'
      );


    if(gen && gen!==mainBtn){
      gen.disabled=true;
    }


    /* ==========================================================
       SINGLE APPROVAL CREATION API
       ========================================================== */

    return call(

      'create_discount_approval_request',

      {

        invoice_name:
          inv,

        selected_approver:
          payload.discount_approver,

        approval_level:
          appLevel,

        requested_discount_pct:
          isL4
            ? 0
            : pct,

        requested_final_amount:
          isL4
            ? finalAmount
            : 0,

        reason:
          payload.discount_reason

      }

    )

    .then(function(apprRes){


      if(restoreApproval){
        restoreApproval();
        restoreApproval=null;
      }


      if(gen){
        gen.disabled=false;
      }


      closeM(
        'm-preview'
      );


      var approvalText='';


      if(
        payload.discount_approver===
        CURRENT_USER
      ){

        approvalText=
          isL4
            ? (
                'L4 approval request created. '+
                'Approve it from the bill below.'
              )
            : (
                'Approve the '+
                pct+
                '% discount from the bill below.'
              );

      }

      else{

        approvalText=
          'Discount request sent to '+
          payload.discount_approver+
          ' — the bill stays locked until approval.';

      }


      alertMsg(

        'Draft '+
        inv+
        ' created. '+
        approvalText,

        'green',
        true

      );


      try{
        renderKPIs();
      }catch(_){}


      try{
        updatePendBadge();
      }catch(_){}


      try{
        updateApprBadge();
      }catch(_){}


      openBill(inv);


      return apprRes;

    })

    .catch(function(e){


      if(restoreApproval){
        restoreApproval();
        restoreApproval=null;
      }


      if(gen){
        gen.disabled=false;
      }


      showGenErr(

        'Draft '+
        inv+
        ' was created, but the discount request failed: '+
        serverErr(e)+
        ' — you can raise it from the bill screen.'

      );


      openBill(inv);

    });

  })


  /* ============================================================
     GENERATION ERROR
     ============================================================ */

  .catch(function(e){


    if(restoreCreate){
      restoreCreate();
      restoreCreate=null;
    }


    if(gen){
      gen.disabled=false;
    }


    showGenErr(
      'Generate failed: '+
      serverErr(e)
    );

  });

}
function finishGenerate(res,gen,pvBtn){
  [gen,pvBtn].forEach(function(b){ if(b){b.disabled=false;} });
  if(pvBtn)pvBtn.textContent='✅ Confirm & Generate Invoice';
  closeM('m-preview');
  alertMsg('Draft bill '+res.sales_invoice+' created for '+(BILL.client.patient_name||'')+
           ' — '+fmtM(res.grand_total)+'. Submit it, then collect the payment.','green',true);
  renderKPIs(); updatePendBadge();
  openBill(res.sales_invoice);
}

var REC_PAGE=1;
var REC_PER_PAGE=20;
function recentShiftDate(value,days){
  var d=new Date(String(value)+'T00:00:00');
  d.setDate(d.getDate()+days);
  return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
}
function lifeRecentDateFieldChange(){
  try{
    var sel=_g('rec-datefield');
    if(sel && (sel.value==='posting_date' || sel.value==='modified')){
      localStorage.setItem(REC_DATE_FIELD_KEY, sel.value);
    }
  }catch(_){}
  renderRecent(1);
}
function setRecentPreset(preset){
  var from=today(),to=today();
  if(preset==='yesterday'){
    from=recentShiftDate(today(),-1);to=from;
  }else if(preset==='this_month'){
    var currentCycle=cycleRange(today());
    from=currentCycle.from;to=currentCycle.to>today()?today():currentCycle.to;
  }else if(preset==='last_month'){
    var thisCycle=cycleRange(today());
    var previousCycle=cycleRange(recentShiftDate(thisCycle.from,-1));
    from=previousCycle.from;to=previousCycle.to;
  }
  var fromEl=_g('rec-from'),toEl=_g('rec-to');
  if(fromEl)fromEl.value=from;
  if(toEl)toEl.value=to;
  renderRecent(1);
}
function renderRecent(page){
  if(page!==undefined&&page!==null)REC_PAGE=Math.max(1,parseInt(page,10)||1);
    try{ wireRecentSearchDebounce(); }catch(_){}
    /* Make sure the date-field <select> reflects the saved preference
     on every render, in case boot raced ahead of the localStorage
     restore. This is idempotent. */
  try{
    var sel=_g('rec-datefield');
    if(sel){
      var saved=localStorage.getItem(REC_DATE_FIELD_KEY);
      /* Valid saved value: use it. No saved value: default to 'modified'. */
      if(saved==='posting_date' || saved==='modified'){
        if(sel.value!==saved) sel.value=saved;
      } else {
        if(sel.value!=='modified') sel.value='modified';
      }
    }
  }catch(_){}
  _t('rec-scope-badge',scopeName());
  _s('rec-list','<div class="card"><div class="empty"><div class="empty-ic">⏳</div>Loading recent bills…</div></div>');
  var q=(_v('rec-q')||'').trim(), st=_v('rec-status'), f=_v('rec-from'), t=_v('rec-to');
  /* include DRAFTS as well as submitted bills (0 = draft, 1 = submitted) */
  var filters=[['docstatus','in',[0,1]]].concat(scopeFilter('branch'));
  if(st)filters.push(['status','=',st]);
      /* Filter on posting_date OR modified, depending on #rec-datefield */
    var dateField = _v('rec-datefield') || 'modified';
    if(dateField !== 'posting_date' && dateField !== 'modified'){
      dateField = 'modified';
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------
       Frappe treats "modified" (a Datetime column) as a string when
       a date-only value is supplied to the filter. A row modified on
       20-Sep-2026 carries "2026-09-20 11:00:00", which is lexically
       GREATER than "2026-09-20", so the <= bound silently rejects it.
       For Datetime columns the bound must include the full day.
       Posting Date is a Date column and needs no such expansion.
       ------------------------------------------------------------ */
    if(f)filters.push([dateField,'>=', dateField==='modified' ? (f+' 00:00:00') : f]);
    if(t)filters.push([dateField,'<=', dateField==='modified' ? (t+' 23:59:59') : t]);
  getList('Sales Invoice',filters,
  ['name','patient','patient_name','posting_date','modified','branch','grand_total','outstanding_amount',
   'status','docstatus','owner','custom_referring_name','ref_practitioner',

  {limit:0, order_by:dateField==='modified' ? 'modified desc, creation desc' : 'posting_date desc, creation desc'})
  .then(function(list){

      .then(function(rows){

        return {list:list,mobileMap:mobileMap};
      })
      .catch(function(){return {list:list,mobileMap:{}};});
  })
  .then(function(ctx){
    var list=ctx.list||[];
        if(q){
      var needle=q.toLowerCase();
      var digits=q.replace(/\D/g,'');
      /* Also allow the user to type a date fragment (e.g. 21-Sep, 2026-09)
         which matches the date column currently being shown. */

    var first=totalRecords?start+1:0;

        '<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--txt3);font-weight:700">Page '+REC_PAGE+' of '+totalPages+'</span></div>';

        var dateHeader = (dateField==='modified') ? 'Last Updated On' : 'Posting Date';
    _s('rec-list',

/* ============================================================
   LIFE BILLING — STOCK RECEIPT WARNING
   Warning-only reminder for overdue stock receipts.
   Billing is NEVER blocked by this feature.
   Master toggle:
     true  = show warning
     false = do not check/show warning
   ============================================================ */

var LIFE_STOCK_RECEIPT_BILLING_BLOCK_ENABLED = true;

/*
 * Receipt enforcement starts from 01-Aug-2026.
 * The server remains the source of truth, but this client-side cutoff
 * prevents an old pre-August receipt from locking Billing if an older
 * server response is ever returned.
 */
var LIFE_STOCK_RECEIPT_RULE_START_DATE = "2026-08-01T00:00:00";

var LIFE_STOCK_RECEIPT_GATE_RESULT = null;
var LIFE_STOCK_RECEIPT_GATE_TIMER = null;

function lifeNormalizeBillingReceiptGate(result){
  result=result||{};

  var rows=Array.isArray(result.overdue_receipts)
    ? result.overdue_receipts.slice()
    : [];

  var cutoff=new Date(LIFE_STOCK_RECEIPT_RULE_START_DATE).getTime();

  rows=rows.filter(function(row){
    var raw=row&&row.release_date
      ? String(row.release_date)
      : "";

    if(!raw)return false;

    /*
     * ERPNext normally returns YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.
     * Replace the first space so browsers parse it consistently.
     */
    var parsed=new Date(raw.replace(" ","T")).getTime();

    /*
     * If a returned date cannot be parsed, keep the row so validation
     * fails safely instead of silently granting Billing access.
     */
    if(isNaN(parsed))return true;

    return parsed>=cutoff;
  });

  result.overdue_receipts=rows;
  result.overdue_count=rows.length;
  result.blocked=rows.length>0;

  return result;
}

function lifeCheckBillingReceiptGate(){
  if(!LIFE_STOCK_RECEIPT_BILLING_BLOCK_ENABLED){
    return Promise.resolve({
      ok:true,
      applies:false,
      blocked:false,
      disabled:true,
      overdue_count:0,
      overdue_receipts:[]
    });
  }

  return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
    frappe.call({
      method:"life_stock_fast_requests",
      type:"POST",
      args:{
        action:"billing_receipt_gate",
        payload:"{}"
      },
      callback:function(r){
        var result=(r&&r.message)?r.message:{};
        if(result.ok!==true){
          reject(new Error(
            result.message ||
            "Unable to validate pending stock receipts."
          ));
          return;
        }
        resolve(
          lifeNormalizeBillingReceiptGate(result)
        );
      },
      error:function(err){
        reject(err);
      }
    });
  });
}

function lifeStockReceiptPrimaryRow(result){
  var rows=result&&Array.isArray(result.overdue_receipts)
    ? result.overdue_receipts
    : [];
  if(!rows.length)return null;

  rows=rows.slice().sort(function(a,b){
    return String(a.release_date||"").localeCompare(
      String(b.release_date||"")
    );
  });

  return rows[0]||null;
}

function lifeStockReceiptEscape(value){
  return String(value===null||value===undefined?"":value)
    .replace(/&/g,"&")
    .replace(/</g,"<")
    .replace(/>/g,">")
    .replace(/"/g,""");
}

      '</div>'+

  var closeButton=document.getElementById("life-stock-warning-close-btn");

    closeButton.style.cursor="not-allowed";

  LIFE_STOCK_RECEIPT_GATE_TIMER=setInterval(function(){
    secondsLeft-=1;

    if(countdown){
      countdown.textContent=String(Math.max(0,secondsLeft));

    if(closeButton){
      closeButton.textContent=
        secondsLeft>0
          ? "Close ("+secondsLeft+")"

    if(secondsLeft<=0){
      clearInterval(LIFE_STOCK_RECEIPT_GATE_TIMER);
      LIFE_STOCK_RECEIPT_GATE_TIMER=null;

      /*
       * Do NOT auto-close.

        closeButton.disabled=false;
        closeButton.style.cursor="pointer";
        closeButton.style.opacity="1";
        closeButton.style.background="#fff";
        closeButton.style.color="#344054";

  },1000);

/* ════════════════ INIT ════════════════ */
function startBillingModule(){
  if(!(ROOT.getElementById && ROOT.getElementById('app')) && document.getElementById('app')) ROOT=document;

  closeAllModals();

  if(typeof frappe==='undefined' || typeof frappe.call!=='function'){
    var s=_g('stage');
    if(s){
      s.innerHTML='<div class="card"><div class="empty">⚠️ Waiting for the Frappe client API…</div></div>';
    }
    return;
  }

  boot()
    .then(function(){
      initScope();

      if(BOOT_ERR){
        var hero=_q('.hero');

        if(hero){
          var bn=document.createElement('div');
          bn.style.cssText='max-width:760px;margin:12px auto 0;background:#FEF2F2;border:1.5px solid #FCA5A5;color:#991B1B;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;position:relative;z-index:2';
          bn.innerHTML='⚠️ '+esc(BOOT_ERR);
          hero.appendChild(bn);
        }
      }

      return lifeCheckBillingReceiptGate();
    })
    .then(function(gate){
      LIFE_STOCK_RECEIPT_GATE_RESULT=gate||{};

      /*
       * Billing is NEVER blocked by stock receipt status.
       * Start Billing first, then show a 10-second reminder
       * when an overdue receipt exists.
       */
      lifeContinueBillingStartup();

      if(
        LIFE_STOCK_RECEIPT_BILLING_BLOCK_ENABLED &&
        gate &&
        gate.applies !== false &&
        gate.blocked === true
      ){
        setTimeout(function(){
          lifeShowBillingReceiptBlocked(gate);
        },250);
      }
    })
    .catch(function(e){
      /*
       * Receipt verification failure must not stop Billing.
       * Keep the error only in the console for troubleshooting.
       */
      console.warn(
        '[LIFE Billing] Stock receipt warning check failed; Billing remains available.',
        e
      );

      lifeContinueBillingStartup();
    });
}

/* ── Debounce the Recent Bills search box (2 s after last keystroke) ── */
function wireRecentSearchDebounce(){
  var q=_g('rec-q');
  if(!q || q.getAttribute('data-life-debounced')==='1') return;

  q.setAttribute('data-life-debounced','1');

  var debounced=lifeDebounce(function(){
    renderRecent(1);
  }, 1500);   /* 2 seconds */

  q.addEventListener('input', debounced);

  /* Optional: pressing Enter searches immediately */
    q.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if(e.key==='Enter'){
      e.preventDefault();
      /* bypass debounce: search immediately, and cancel the pending one */
      if(debounced && debounced.cancel) debounced.cancel();
      renderRecent(1);
    }
  });
}


/* ── Robust launcher for Frappe WEB PAGES ── */
(function(){
  var started=false;
  function go(){
    if(started) return;
    if(typeof frappe==='undefined' || typeof frappe.call!=='function') return false;
    started=true;
    patchMsgprint();
    startBillingModule();
    return true;
  }
  try{ if(typeof frappe!=='undefined' && typeof frappe.ready==='function'){ frappe.ready(function(){ go(); }); } }catch(e){}
  if(document.readyState==='loading'){ document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){ go(); }); }
  var tries=0;
  var iv=setInterval(function(){
    tries++;
    if(go() || tries>150){ clearInterval(iv); }
  },200);
  go();
})();

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var OTP_SEND_METHOD = 'life_slimming.user_wise_roles.send_client_whatsapp_otp';
  var OTP_VERIFY_METHOD = 'life_slimming.user_wise_roles.verify_client_otp';
  var otpState = { mobile: '', verified: false, busy: false, resolve: null };

  function el(id) {
    if (typeof _g === 'function') return _g(id);
    return document.getElementById(id);
  }

  function value(id) {
    var node = el(id);
    return node ? String(node.value || '').trim() : '';
  }

  function cleanMobile(raw) {
    var digits = String(raw || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (digits.length === 12 && digits.slice(0, 2) === '91') digits = digits.slice(2);
    if (digits.length === 11 && digits.charAt(0) === '0') digits = digits.slice(1);
    return digits;
  }

  function api(method, args) {
    if (typeof call === 'function') return call(method, args || {});
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      frappe.call({
        method: method,
        args: args || {},
        callback: function (r) { resolve(r ? r.message : null); },
        error: reject
      });
    });
  }

  function message(text, colour) {
    if (typeof alertMsg === 'function') alertMsg(text, colour || 'green');
    else if (window.frappe && frappe.show_alert) {
      frappe.show_alert({ message: text, indicator: colour || 'green' }, 5);
    }
  }

  function registrationError(text, focusId) {
    if (typeof regErr === 'function') regErr(text);
    else message(text, 'red');
    var node = focusId ? el(focusId) : null;
    if (node) node.focus();
  }

  function setRegistrationBusy(label) {
    var button = document.querySelector('#m-register .btn-green');
    var restore = null;
    if (button && typeof btnBusy === 'function') restore = btnBusy(button, label);
    if (typeof busy === 'function') busy(label);
    return function () {
      if (typeof busyDone === 'function') busyDone();
      if (restore) restore();
    };
  }

  function ensureOtpDialog() {
    if (document.getElementById('life-client-otp')) return;
    var host = document.createElement('div');
    host.id = 'life-client-otp';
    host.className = 'life-otp-ov';
    host.innerHTML =
      '<div class="life-otp-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="life-otp-title">' +
        '<div class="life-otp-head">' +
          '<div class="life-otp-title" id="life-otp-title">Verify WhatsApp OTP</div>' +
          '<div class="life-otp-sub" id="life-otp-sub">Enter the 6-digit code sent to the client.</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="life-otp-body">' +
          '<div class="life-otp-inputs" id="life-otp-inputs">' +
            '<input class="life-otp-digit" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="OTP digit 1">' +
            '<input class="life-otp-digit" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="OTP digit 2">' +
            '<input class="life-otp-digit" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="OTP digit 3">' +
            '<input class="life-otp-digit" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="OTP digit 4">' +
            '<input class="life-otp-digit" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="OTP digit 5">' +
            '<input class="life-otp-digit" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="OTP digit 6">' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div style="text-align:center;font-size:12.5px;color:#5f8272">' +
            'Did not receive it? <button type="button" id="life-otp-resend" style="border:0;background:none;color:#0b6b4a;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer">Resend OTP</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="life-otp-error" id="life-otp-error"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="life-otp-actions">' +
          '<button type="button" class="btn btn-white" id="life-otp-cancel">Cancel</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="btn btn-green" id="life-otp-verify">Verify & Continue</button>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    var billingHost = document.getElementById('life-billing-app') ||
      document.getElementById('v-billing') ||
      document.querySelector('.page_content .web-page-content') ||
      document.querySelector('.web-page-content') ||
      document.body;
    billingHost.appendChild(host);

    var digits = host.querySelectorAll('.life-otp-digit');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(digits, function (input, index) {
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        this.value = this.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 1);
        if (this.value && digits[index + 1]) digits[index + 1].focus();
      });
      input.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
        if (event.key === 'Backspace' && !this.value && digits[index - 1]) digits[index - 1].focus();
        if (event.key === 'Enter') verifyOtp();
      });
      input.addEventListener('paste', function (event) {
        var pasted = (event.clipboardData || window.clipboardData).getData('text').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6);
        if (!pasted) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(digits, function (box, i) { box.value = pasted.charAt(i) || ''; });
        digits[Math.min(pasted.length, 6) - 1].focus();
      });
    });

    document.getElementById('life-otp-cancel').onclick = function () { closeOtp(false); };
    document.getElementById('life-otp-verify').onclick = verifyOtp;
    document.getElementById('life-otp-resend').onclick = resendOtp;
  }

  function otpError(text) {
    var box = document.getElementById('life-otp-error');
    if (!box) return;
    box.textContent = text;
    box.style.display = 'block';
  }

  function clearOtpInputs() {
    var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('#life-client-otp .life-otp-digit');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(boxes, function (box) { box.value = ''; });
    var error = document.getElementById('life-otp-error');
    if (error) { error.textContent = ''; error.style.display = 'none'; }
    if (boxes[0]) setTimeout(function () { boxes[0].focus(); }, 80);
  }

  function closeOtp(result) {
    var dialog = document.getElementById('life-client-otp');
    if (dialog) {
      dialog.classList.remove('show');
      dialog.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      setTimeout(function () {
        if (dialog && dialog.parentNode) dialog.parentNode.removeChild(dialog);
      }, 180);
    }
    document.body.classList.remove('life-otp-open');
    otpState.busy = false;
    var done = otpState.resolve;
    otpState.resolve = null;
    if (done) done(Boolean(result));
  }

  function sendOtp(mobile) {
    otpState.mobile = mobile;
    otpState.verified = false;
    return api(OTP_SEND_METHOD, { mobile: mobile }).then(function (result) {
      if (result === false || result === null || (result && result.error)) {
        throw new Error((result && result.error) || 'OTP service did not confirm sending');
      }
      return result;
    });
  }

  function requestOtpVerification(mobile) {
    ensureOtpDialog();
    clearOtpInputs();
    document.getElementById('life-otp-sub').textContent =
      'Enter the 6-digit code sent on WhatsApp to +91 ' + mobile.slice(0, 3) + '••••' + mobile.slice(-3) + '.';
    document.getElementById('life-client-otp').classList.add('show');
    document.getElementById('life-client-otp').setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    document.body.classList.add('life-otp-open');
    return new Promise(function (resolve) { otpState.resolve = resolve; });
  }

  function verifyOtp() {
    if (otpState.busy) return;
    var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('#life-client-otp .life-otp-digit');
    var code = Array.prototype.map.call(boxes, function (box) { return box.value; }).join('');
    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(code)) { otpError('Please enter the complete 6-digit OTP.'); return; }

    otpState.busy = true;
    var button = document.getElementById('life-otp-verify');
    var oldText = button.textContent;
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Verifying…';
    api(OTP_VERIFY_METHOD, { otp: code, mobile: otpState.mobile }).then(function (result) {
      var verified = result === 'verified' || result === true || (result && (result.verified === true || result.status === 'verified'));
      if (!verified) throw new Error((result && result.error) || 'Invalid or expired OTP');
      otpState.verified = true;
      closeOtp(true);
    }).catch(function (error) {
      otpState.busy = false;
      otpError(error && error.message ? error.message : 'OTP verification failed. Please try again.');
    }).finally(function () {
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = oldText;
    });
  }

  function resendOtp() {
    if (otpState.busy) return;
    otpState.busy = true;
    var button = document.getElementById('life-otp-resend');
    var oldText = button.textContent;
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Sending…';
    sendOtp(otpState.mobile).then(function () {
      clearOtpInputs();
      message('OTP sent again on WhatsApp', 'green');
    }).catch(function (error) {
      otpError(error && error.message ? error.message : 'Could not resend OTP.');
    }).finally(function () {
      otpState.busy = false;
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = oldText;
    });
  }

  function validateRegistration() {
    var name = value('rg-name');
    var mobile = cleanMobile(value('rg-mobile'));
    var lettersOnly = name.replace(/[^A-Za-z]/g, '');
    var pdFile = el('rg-pd-file');

    if (!name) return registrationError('Full name is required', 'rg-name');
    if (/\d/.test(name)) return registrationError('Client name cannot contain numbers', 'rg-name');
    if (lettersOnly.length < 2) return registrationError('Client name must contain at least 2 letters', 'rg-name');
    if (!/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(mobile)) return registrationError('Mobile must be 10 digits starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9', 'rg-mobile');
    if (!value('rg-sex')) return registrationError('Gender is required', 'rg-sex');
    if (!value('rg-branch')) return registrationError('Branch is required', 'rg-branch');
    if (!value('rg-emp')) return registrationError('Consultation Employee is required', 'rg-emp');
    if (!value('rg-for')) return registrationError('Visited For is required', 'rg-for');
    if (!value('rg-decision')) return registrationError('Booked / Not-Booked is required', 'rg-decision');
    if (!value('rg-treat')) return registrationError('Treatment Category is required', 'rg-treat');
    if (typeof dobCheck === 'function' && !dobCheck()) return registrationError('Check the date of birth — use the calendar picker', 'rg-dob');
    if (!value('rg-pd-number')) return registrationError('PD Form Number is required', 'rg-pd-number');
    if (!pdFile || !pdFile.files || !pdFile.files.length) return registrationError('PD Form attachment is required', 'rg-pd-file');

    return {
      patient_name: name,
      mobile: mobile,
      sex: value('rg-sex'),
      dob: value('rg-dob'),
      branch: value('rg-branch'),
      media: value('rg-source'),
      visited_for: value('rg-for'),
      consultation_employee: value('rg-emp'),
      final_decision: value('rg-decision'),
      treatment_category: value('rg-treat'),
      pd_form_number: value('rg-pd-number'),
      pdFile: pdFile.files[0]
    };
  }

  function findExistingPatient(mobile) {
    if (typeof getList !== 'function') return Promise.resolve(null);
    return getList('Patient', [['mobile', '=', mobile]], ['name', 'patient_name', 'mobile'], { limit: 1 })
      .then(function (rows) { return rows && rows.length ? rows[0] : null; });
  }

  function persistOtpFlag(patientName) {
    return api('frappe.client.set_value', {
      doctype: 'Patient',
      name: patientName,
      fieldname: 'custom_otp_verified',
      value: 1
    }).catch(function () {
      /* OTP was already verified before creation; do not fail the completed registration. */
      return null;
    });
  }

  /* Complete replacement for the live saveRegister(). */
  window.saveRegister = function () {
    var data = validateRegistration();
    if (!data) return;
    var errorBox = el('rg-err');
    if (errorBox) errorBox.style.display = 'none';

    var stopBusy = setRegistrationBusy('Checking mobile number…');
    findExistingPatient(data.mobile).then(function (existing) {
      stopBusy();
      if (existing) {
        registrationError('This mobile is already registered as ' + existing.name + ' (' + (existing.patient_name || 'Client') + ').', 'rg-mobile');
        return false;
      }

      var stopSend = setRegistrationBusy('Sending WhatsApp OTP…');
      return sendOtp(data.mobile).then(function () {
        stopSend();
        return requestOtpVerification(data.mobile);
      }).catch(function (error) {
        stopSend();
        throw error;
      });
    }).then(function (verified) {
      if (!verified) return null;
      if (cleanMobile(value('rg-mobile')) !== data.mobile) {
        throw new Error('Mobile number changed after OTP. Please verify the new number.');
      }

      var stopUpload = setRegistrationBusy('Uploading PD form…');
      return uploadFile(data.pdFile, 'Patient', null).then(function (fileUrl) {
        var status = el('rg-pd-status');
        if (status) {
          status.innerHTML = 'PD form uploaded ✓ <a href="' + fileUrl + '" target="_blank" style="color:var(--g1);font-weight:800">view</a>';
          status.style.color = 'var(--g1)';
        }

        if (typeof busy === 'function') busy('Registering the client…');
        var payload = {
          patient_name: data.patient_name,
          mobile: data.mobile,
          sex: data.sex,
          dob: data.dob,
          branch: data.branch,
          media: data.media,
          visited_for: data.visited_for,
          consultation_employee: data.consultation_employee,
          final_decision: data.final_decision,
          treatment_category: data.treatment_category,
          pd_form_number: data.pd_form_number,
          pd_form_file: fileUrl
        };
        if (window.REG_LEAD && REG_LEAD.lead) payload.lead = REG_LEAD.lead;

        return api('lifescc.billing.create_client', payload).then(function (result) {
          stopUpload();
          return result;
        }, function (error) {
          stopUpload();
          throw error;
        });
      });
    }).then(function (result) {
      if (!result) return;
      if (result.name && !result.error) {
        return persistOtpFlag(result.name).then(function () {
          if (typeof resetRegisterForm === 'function') resetRegisterForm();
          if (typeof closeM === 'function') closeM('m-register');
          message(data.patient_name + ' registered as ' + result.name + ' — mobile verified', 'green');
          if (typeof openSummary === 'function') openSummary(result.name);
        });
      }
      if (result.duplicate && result.name) {
        registrationError((result.error || 'Mobile already registered') + ' — opening that client.');
        setTimeout(function () {
          if (typeof closeM === 'function') closeM('m-register');
          if (typeof openSummary === 'function') openSummary(result.name);
        }, 1200);
        return;
      }
      throw new Error(result.error || 'Could not register client');
    }).catch(function (error) {
      if (typeof busyDone === 'function') busyDone();
      registrationError('Registration failed: ' + (error && error.message ? error.message : 'Unknown server error'));
    });
  };

  /* Changing the mobile always invalidates the previous verification. */
  document.addEventListener('input', function (event) {
    if (event.target && event.target.id === 'rg-mobile') {
      var current = cleanMobile(event.target.value);
      if (otpState.mobile && current !== otpState.mobile) otpState.verified = false;
    }
  });
})();


/* LIFE Billing v21 — simultaneous L1/L2/L3 request support. */
(function(){
  var LIFE_V21_MULTI=[];
  var lifeV21OriginalCall=call;
  var lifeV21OriginalRender=renderBillWorkspace;
  var lifeV21OriginalPayload=billPayload;

  function approversFor(level){
    var out=[];
    if(level==='L1')out.push({user:CURRENT_USER,full_name:CURRENT_USER,approval_level:'L1',designation:'Self'});
    (APPROVERS||[]).forEach(function(a){
      if(a&&a.user&&(a.approval_level||'L1')===level&&a.user!==CURRENT_USER)out.push(a);
    });
    return out;
  }
  function approvalOptions(level){
    return '<option value="">— Select '+level+' approver —</option>'+
      approversFor(level).map(function(a){
        return '<option value="'+esc(a.user)+'">'+esc(a.full_name||a.user)+' · '+esc(level)+(a.designation?' · '+esc(a.designation):'')+'</option>';
      }).join('');
  }
  function multiRow(level,label){
    return '<div class="v21-appr-row" data-level="'+level+'" style="border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 12px;margin-bottom:9px;background:#fff">'+
      '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:900;color:var(--g0);cursor:pointer">'+
        '<input type="checkbox" id="v21-on-'+level+'" style="width:17px;height:17px" onchange="lifeV21ToggleRow(\''+level+'\')">'+level+' · '+label+
      '</label>'+
      '<div id="v21-body-'+level+'" style="display:none;margin-top:10px"><div class="grid2">'+
        '<div><label class="f-lbl">Approver <span class="req">*</span></label><select class="f-sel" id="v21-user-'+level+'">'+approvalOptions(level)+'</select></div>'+
        '<div><label class="f-lbl">Discount % <span class="req">*</span> <small>(max 5%)</small></label><input class="f-inp" id="v21-pct-'+level+'" type="number" min="0.5" max="5" step="0.5" value="5" oninput="lifeV21UpdateSummary()"></div>'+
      '</div></div></div>';
  }
  window.lifeV21ToggleRow=function(level){
    var on=_g('v21-on-'+level),body=_g('v21-body-'+level);
    if(body)body.style.display=on&&on.checked?'block':'none';
    lifeV21UpdateSummary();
  };
  window.lifeV21UpdateSummary=function(){
    var total=0,count=0;
    ['L1','L2','L3'].forEach(function(level){
      var on=_g('v21-on-'+level);
      if(on&&on.checked){total+=parseFloat(_v('v21-pct-'+level)||0);count++;}
    });
    var box=_g('v21-summary');
    if(box){
      box.innerHTML=count?'<b>'+count+' approval request'+(count===1?'':'s')+'</b> will be sent together · Total requested: <b>'+total+'%</b> of original Grand Total including GST.':'Select one or more approval levels.';
      box.style.color=total>15?'var(--red)':'var(--g1)';
    }
  };
  function installMultiUI(){
    var body=_g('bl-disc-body'); if(!body)return;
    body.innerHTML=
      '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--txt3);margin-bottom:10px">Select L1, L2 and L3 together. All selected requests are created at the same time—no need to wait for the previous approval. Each level can approve up to 5%; combined maximum is 15%.</div>'+
      multiRow('L1','Branch Level')+multiRow('L2','Cluster Level')+multiRow('L3','Corporate Level')+
      '<div id="v21-summary" style="padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--gbg2);border:1px solid var(--border2);font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:10px">Select one or more approval levels.</div>'+
      '<div><label class="f-lbl">Common reason for all selected approvals <span class="req">*</span></label><input class="f-inp" id="v21-reason" placeholder="Why is this discount needed?"></div>'+
      '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--txt3);margin-top:8px">L4 / MD exact-final-amount approval remains available separately from the bill.</div>'+
      '<select id="bl-disc-approver" style="display:none"><option value=""></option></select>'+
      '<input id="bl-disc-pct" type="hidden" value="0"><input id="bl-disc-final" type="hidden" value="0"><input id="bl-disc-reason" type="hidden" value="">';
  }
  function collectMultiRequests(){
    var rows=[],reason=(_v('v21-reason')||'').trim(),total=0;
    ['L1','L2','L3'].forEach(function(level){
      var on=_g('v21-on-'+level);
      if(on&&on.checked){
        var user=(_v('v21-user-'+level)||'').trim();
        var pct=parseFloat(_v('v21-pct-'+level)||0);
        rows.push({approval_level:level,selected_approver:user,requested_discount_pct:pct,reason:reason});
        total+=pct||0;
      }
    });
    if(!rows.length)throw new Error('Select at least one approval level.');
    for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
      if(!rows[i].selected_approver)throw new Error('Select an approver for '+rows[i].approval_level+'.');
      if(!(rows[i].requested_discount_pct>0)||rows[i].requested_discount_pct>5)throw new Error(rows[i].approval_level+' must be between 0.5% and 5%.');
    }
    if(total>15)throw new Error('L1 + L2 + L3 combined discount cannot exceed 15%.');
    if(!reason)throw new Error('Enter the discount reason.');
    return rows;
  }
  renderBillWorkspace=function(){
    lifeV21OriginalRender.apply(this,arguments);
    installMultiUI();
  };
  billPayload=function(){
    var payload=lifeV21OriginalPayload.apply(this,arguments);
    if(_g('bl-disc-on')&&_g('bl-disc-on').checked){
      try{
        LIFE_V21_MULTI=collectMultiRequests();
        var first=LIFE_V21_MULTI[0];
        payload.discount_approver=first.selected_approver;
        payload.discount_pct=first.requested_discount_pct;
        payload.discount_final_amount=0;
        payload.discount_reason=first.reason;
      }catch(e){
        LIFE_V21_MULTI=[];
        payload.discount_approver='';
        payload.discount_pct=0;
        payload.discount_reason='';
        showGenErr(e.message);
      }
    }else LIFE_V21_MULTI=[];
    return payload;
  };
  call=function(method,args){
    if(method==='create_discount_approval_request'&&LIFE_V21_MULTI.length){
      var batch=LIFE_V21_MULTI.slice();
      LIFE_V21_MULTI=[];
      return lifeV21OriginalCall('create_multiple_discount_approval_requests_v2',{
        invoice_name:args.invoice_name,
        requests:JSON.stringify(batch)
      }).then(function(res){
        res=res||{};
        res.request_name=res.requests&&res.requests[0]?res.requests[0].name:'';
        return res;
      });
    }
    return lifeV21OriginalCall(method,args);
  };
})();

        if(restore)restore();
        return bad(
          'Select at least one available approval level.'
        );
      }


      for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){

        if(!rows[i].selected_approver){
          if(restore)restore();
          return bad(
            'Select the '+
            rows[i].approval_level+
            ' approver.'
          );
        }

        if(
          !(rows[i].requested_discount_pct>=0.5) ||
          rows[i].requested_discount_pct>5
        ){
          if(restore)restore();
          return bad(
            rows[i].approval_level+
            ' must be between 0.5% and 5%.'
          );
        }
      }


      if(!reason){
        if(restore)restore();
        return bad(
          'Enter the discount reason.'
        );
      }


      /*
       * Do not trust only the state captured when the modal opened.
       * Reload the complete approval chain immediately before creating
       * requests. This prevents L2/L3 duplicates when another approver
       * has acted, or when browser permissions hide sibling rows.
       */
      promise=
        lifeLoadInvoiceDiscountRequests(
          inv
        )

        .then(function(latestRows){

          latestRows=
            latestRows||[];

          var used={};
          var approvedLatest=0;

          latestRows.forEach(
            function(r){

              var level=
                String(
                  r.approval_level||''
                ).trim();

              if(
                level &&
                (
                  r.status==='Pending' ||
                  r.status==='Approved'
                )
              ){
                used[level]=true;
              }

              if(
                r.status==='Approved' &&
                (
                  level==='L1' ||
                  level==='L2' ||
                  level==='L3'
                )
              ){
                approvedLatest+=
                  parseFloat(
                    r.approved_discount_pct ||
                    r.requested_discount_pct ||
                    0
                  ) || 0;
              }
            }
          );


          /*
           * Every selected level must still be unused.
           */
          for(
            var j=0;
            j<rows.length;
            j++
          ){

            var selectedLevel=
              rows[j].approval_level;

            if(used[selectedLevel]){

              throw new Error(
                selectedLevel+
                ' already has a Pending or Approved discount request. '+
                'Refresh the bill and choose only an available level.'
              );
            }
          }


          /*
           * L1 + L2 + L3 cumulative hard cap = 15%.
           * Existing approved percentage + this new batch may not exceed 15%.
           */
          var combined=
            approvedLatest+
            total;

          if(combined>15.000001){

            throw new Error(
              'Combined L1 + L2 + L3 discount cannot exceed 15%. '+
              'Already approved: '+
              approvedLatest.toFixed(2).replace(/\.00$/,'')+
              '%. New request: '+
              total.toFixed(2).replace(/\.00$/,'')+
              '%.'
            );
          }


          return call(
            'create_multiple_discount_approval_requests_v2',
            {
              invoice_name:inv,
              requests:JSON.stringify(
                rows
              )
            }
          );
        });
    }
    promise.then(function(res){
      if(restore)restore();
      v22Close();
      alertMsg(mode==='l4'?'L4 discount request sent successfully.':((res&&res.count)||'Selected')+' discount requests sent successfully.','green',true);
      updateApprBadge();renderApprovals();openBill(inv);
    }).catch(function(e){if(restore)restore();bad(serverErr(e));});
  };

  window.requestNextApproval=function(inv){

    if(!inv){
      return;
    }

    /*
     * IMPORTANT:
     * Use the exact same complete approval loader as the Bill drawer.
     * A direct browser-side getList can hide L2/L3 rows for branch users,
     * which previously made already-approved levels selectable again.
     */
    Promise.all([
      getDoc(
        'Sales Invoice',
        inv
      ),
      lifeLoadInvoiceDiscountRequests(
        inv
      )
    ])

    .then(function(all){

      var si=all[0];
      var reqs=all[1]||[];

      if(!si || si.docstatus!==0){
        alertMsg(
          'Discount can only be requested while the invoice is Draft.',
          'red'
        );
        return;
      }

      v22Open(
        inv,
        si,
        reqs
      );
    })

    .catch(function(e){
      alertMsg(
        'Could not open discount request: '+
        serverErr(e),
        'red'
      );
    });
  };
})();


/* LIFE Billing v23 — fixes skipped approval creation and adds live calculations */
(function(){
  var v23PreviousPayload=billPayload;

  billPayload=function(){
    var payload=v23PreviousPayload.apply(this,arguments);
    var discountOn=_g('bl-disc-on')&&_g('bl-disc-on').checked;
    var selected=false;
    ['L1','L2','L3'].forEach(function(level){
      var on=_g('v21-on-'+level);
      if(on&&on.checked)selected=true;
    });
    if(discountOn&&selected){
      /* Critical v23 fix: confirmGenerate() checks this value before deciding
         whether it should call the multiple-request API. */
      payload.draft_only=1;
    }
    return payload;
  };

  window.lifeV21UpdateSummary=function(){
    var totalPct=0,count=0;
    ['L1','L2','L3'].forEach(function(level){
      var on=_g('v21-on-'+level);
      if(on&&on.checked){
        var pct=parseFloat(_v('v21-pct-'+level)||0);
        if(pct>0){totalPct+=pct;count++;}
      }
    });

    var totals=(BILL&&BILL._totals)||{};
    var subtotal=parseFloat(totals.sub||0);
    var gst=parseFloat(totals.gst||0);
    var grand=parseFloat(totals.total||0);
    if(!(grand>0)){
      grand=Math.round((subtotal+gst)*100)/100;
    }

    /* All approval percentages are calculated on Grand Total including GST. */
    var discount=Math.round(grand*totalPct)/100;
    var finalPayable=Math.round((grand-discount)*100)/100;
    var valid=totalPct<=15;

    var box=_g('v21-summary');
    if(box){
      box.innerHTML=
        '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:8px">'+
          '<div style="padding:9px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px"><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--txt3);font-weight:800">ORIGINAL INCL GST</div><b style="font-size:16px">'+fmtM(grand)+'</b></div>'+
          '<div style="padding:9px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px"><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--txt3);font-weight:800">SELECTED</div><b style="font-size:16px">'+count+' level'+(count===1?'':'s')+' · '+totalPct+'%</b></div>'+
          '<div style="padding:9px;background:var(--red-bg);border:1px solid var(--red-bd);border-radius:8px"><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--red);font-weight:800">DISCOUNT AMOUNT</div><b style="font-size:16px;color:var(--red)">− '+fmtM(discount)+'</b></div>'+
          '<div style="padding:9px;background:#ECFDF5;border:1px solid #A7E3C4;border-radius:8px"><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--g1);font-weight:800">FINAL PAYABLE INCL GST</div><b style="font-size:16px;color:var(--g1)">'+fmtM(finalPayable)+'</b></div>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<div style="font-size:11.5px;margin-top:7px;color:'+(valid?'var(--g1)':'var(--red)')+'">'+
          (valid
            ? count+' approval request'+(count===1?'':'s')+' will be created together. Each percentage uses the original GST-inclusive total.'
            : 'Combined L1 + L2 + L3 discount cannot exceed 15%.')+
        '</div>';
    }

    var brk=_g('bl-brk');
    if(brk){
      var preview=_g('v23-disc-preview');
      if(!preview){
        preview=document.createElement('div');
        preview.id='v23-disc-preview';
        brk.parentNode.insertBefore(preview,brk.nextSibling);
      }
      /*
       * Keep the empty discount hint extremely compact so the action
       * buttons remain visible beside the subtotal card.
       * Once a level is selected, restore the normal calculation box.
       */
      if(count){
        preview.style.cssText=
          'margin:6px 0;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:9px;background:#fff;'+
          'border:1.5px solid '+(valid?'#A7E3C4':'var(--red-bd)')+';font-size:12px';

        preview.innerHTML=
          '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:4px">'+
            '<span>Requested discount ('+totalPct+'%)</span>'+
            '<b style="color:var(--red)">− '+fmtM(discount)+'</b>'+
          '</div>'+
          '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:13px">'+
            '<b>Final payable incl GST</b>'+
            '<b style="color:var(--g1)">'+fmtM(finalPayable)+'</b>'+
          '</div>';
      }else{
        preview.style.cssText=
          'margin:2px 0 3px;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;'+
          'border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.25;'+
          'color:var(--txt3);';

        preview.innerHTML=
          'Select L1, L2 or L3 to see the discount calculation.';
      }
    }
  };

  /* Repaint whenever the page recalculates therapy totals, without causing a
     recalc loop. */
  var v23PreviousRecalc=recalc;
  recalc=function(){
    var result=v23PreviousRecalc.apply(this,arguments);
    setTimeout(function(){try{lifeV21UpdateSummary();}catch(e){}},0);
    return result;
  };
})();


/* LIFE Billing v24 — live recording + existing video upload */
(function () {
  var MAX_LOAN_VIDEO_BYTES = 100 * 1024 * 1024;
  var MAX_LOAN_VIDEO_SECONDS = 120;

  function loanVideoSourceLabel(video) {
    return video && video.source === "upload"
      ? "Video uploaded & verified"
      : "Video recorded & verified";
  }

  loanVideoRowHtml = function (i) {
    var video = LOAN_VIDEO[i];

    if (video && video.url) {
