      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">' +
        '<button type="button" class="btn btn-green btn-sm" onclick="startLoanVideo(' + i + ')">🎥 Record Live Video</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="btn btn-white btn-sm" onclick="lifeChooseLoanVideo(' + i + ')">⬆ Upload Video</button>' +
        '<input type="file" id="life-loan-upload-' + i + '" accept="video/mp4,video/webm,video/quicktime,video/x-m4v,.mp4,.webm,.mov,.m4v" style="display:none" onchange="lifeSelectLoanVideo(' + i + ',this)">' +
        '<span style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--txt3)">Maximum 2 minutes · MP4, WebM, MOV or M4V</span>' +
      '</div>';
  };

  onLoanVideoSaved = function (i, url, source) {
    LOAN_VIDEO[i] = {
      url: url,
      verified: true,
      source: source || "record"
    };
    refreshLoanVideoRow(i);
  };

  window.lifeChooseLoanVideo = function (i) {
    var input = _g("life-loan-upload-" + i);
    if (!input) {
      refreshLoanVideoRow(i);
      input = _g("life-loan-upload-" + i);
    }
    if (input) {
      input.value = "";
      input.click();
    }
  };

  window.lifeRemoveLoanVideo = function (i) {
    if (!LOAN_VIDEO[i]) return;

    if (window.frappe && frappe.confirm) {
      frappe.confirm(
        "Remove this loan declaration video?",
        function () {
          delete LOAN_VIDEO[i];
          refreshLoanVideoRow(i);
          frappe.show_alert({
            message: "Loan declaration video removed.",
            indicator: "orange"
          }, 4);
        }
      );
      return;
    }

    if (window.confirm("Remove this loan declaration video?")) {
      delete LOAN_VIDEO[i];
      refreshLoanVideoRow(i);
    }
  };

  window.lifeSelectLoanVideo = function (i, input) {
    var file = input && input.files && input.files[0];
    if (!file) return;

    var fileName = String(file.name || "");
    var allowedExtension = /\.(mp4|webm|mov|m4v)$/i.test(fileName);
    var allowedMime = !file.type || /^video\//i.test(file.type);

    if (!allowedExtension || !allowedMime) {
      input.value = "";
      alertMsg("Select an MP4, WebM, MOV or M4V video file.", "red");
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > MAX_LOAN_VIDEO_BYTES) {
      input.value = "";
      alertMsg("Video must not exceed 100 MB.", "red");
      return;
    }

    var objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    var probe = document.createElement("video");
    probe.preload = "metadata";
    probe.muted = true;
    probe.playsInline = true;

    var finished = false;
    function cleanupProbe() {
      if (finished) return;
      finished = true;
      probe.removeAttribute("src");
      try { probe.load(); } catch (e) {}
    }

    probe.onloadedmetadata = function () {
      var duration = Number(probe.duration || 0);
      cleanupProbe();

      if (!duration || !isFinite(duration)) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
        input.value = "";
        alertMsg("Could not read this video. Please use MP4 or WebM.", "red");
        return;
      }

      if (duration > MAX_LOAN_VIDEO_SECONDS + 0.5) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
        input.value = "";
        alertMsg("Loan declaration video must be 2 minutes or shorter.", "red");
        return;
      }

      lifeShowUploadedVideoReview(i, file, objectUrl, duration, input);
    };

    probe.onerror = function () {
      cleanupProbe();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
      input.value = "";
      alertMsg("This video cannot be previewed. Please upload MP4 or WebM.", "red");
    };

    probe.src = objectUrl;
  };

  window.lifeShowUploadedVideoReview = function (i, file, objectUrl, duration, input) {
    var modalId = "life-upload-video-review";
    $("#" + modalId).remove();

    var mins = Math.floor(duration / 60);
    var secs = Math.round(duration % 60);
    var durationText = mins + ":" + String(secs).padStart(2, "0");
    var sizeText = (file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1) + " MB";

    $("body").append(
      '<div id="' + modalId + '" style="position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.82);z-index:100000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px">' +
        '<div style="background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:20px;width:620px;max-width:96vw;max-height:94vh;overflow:auto;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35)">' +
          '<div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px">' +
            '<div><div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:var(--g0)">⬆ Verify Uploaded Loan Video</div>' +
            '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--txt3);margin-top:3px">' + esc(file.name) + ' · ' + durationText + ' · ' + sizeText + '</div></div>' +
            '<button type="button" id="life-upload-close" style="margin-left:auto;border:0;background:#eef2ef;border-radius:50%;width:32px;height:32px">✕</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<video controls playsinline preload="metadata" src="' + esc(objectUrl) + '" style="display:block;width:100%;max-height:360px;background:#111;border-radius:10px"></video>' +
          '<label style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin-top:14px;padding:12px;border:1.5px solid #A7E3C4;background:#ECFDF5;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer">' +
            '<input type="checkbox" id="life-upload-confirmed" style="width:18px;height:18px;margin-top:1px">' +
            '<span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--g0);font-weight:700">I watched and verified that the client is visible and clearly gives the loan declaration.</span>' +
          '</label>' +
          '<div id="life-upload-error" style="display:none;margin-top:10px;color:var(--red);font-size:12px;font-weight:700"></div>' +
          '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:15px">' +
            '<button type="button" id="life-upload-cancel" class="btn btn-white">Cancel</button>' +
            '<button type="button" id="life-upload-save" class="btn btn-green">Verify & Upload</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>'
    );

    function closeReview() {
      $("#" + modalId).remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
    }

    $("#life-upload-close,#life-upload-cancel").on("click", function () {
      input.value = "";
      closeReview();
    });

    $("#life-upload-save").on("click", function () {
      if (!_g("life-upload-confirmed").checked) {
        var error = _g("life-upload-error");
        error.style.display = "block";
        error.textContent = "Watch the video and confirm the client declaration before uploading.";
        return;
      }

      var button = this;
      button.disabled = true;
      button.textContent = "Uploading…";
      lifeUploadExistingLoanVideo(i, file)
        .then(function (fileUrl) {
          closeReview();
          onLoanVideoSaved(i, fileUrl, "upload");
          frappe.show_alert({
            message: "✅ Loan declaration video uploaded and verified.",
            indicator: "green"
          }, 6);
        })
        .catch(function (error) {
          button.disabled = false;
          button.textContent = "Verify & Upload";
          var errorBox = _g("life-upload-error");
          errorBox.style.display = "block";
          errorBox.textContent = serverErr(error) || "Video upload failed. Please retry.";
        });
    });
  };

  window.lifeUploadExistingLoanVideo = function (rowIndex, file) {
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var originalName = String(file.name || "loan_video.mp4");
      var extensionMatch = originalName.match(/\.([a-z0-9]+)$/i);
      var extension = extensionMatch ? extensionMatch[1].toLowerCase() : "mp4";
      var timestamp = frappe.datetime.now_datetime().replace(/[:\s]/g, "_");
      var invoiceName = (COL_INV && COL_INV.name) || "new";
      var filename = "loan_consent_" + invoiceName + "_" + timestamp + "." + extension;

      var formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", file, filename);
      formData.append("is_private", "1");
      formData.append("folder", "Home/Attachments");

      fetch("/api/method/upload_file", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "X-Frappe-CSRF-Token": csrfToken() },
        body: formData
      })
      .then(function (response) {
        return response.json().then(function (data) {
          if (!response.ok || data.exc) {
            throw new Error(serverErr(data) || "Upload failed.");
          }
          return data;
        });
      })
      .then(function (result) {
        var fileUrl = result && result.message && result.message.file_url;
        if (!fileUrl) throw new Error("ERP did not return the uploaded video URL.");
        resolve(fileUrl);
      })
      .catch(reject);
    });
  };
})();


/* LIFE Billing v25 — hard 5% limit per L1/L2/L3 approver */
(function () {
  var LEVEL_IDS = /^(v21|v22)-pct-(L1|L2|L3)$/;

  function clampApprovalPercent(input, showMessage) {
    if (!input || !LEVEL_IDS.test(input.id || "")) return false;
    if (input.value === "") return false;

    var value = Number(input.value);
    if (!isFinite(value)) {
      input.value = "";
      return true;
    }

    if (value > 5) {
      input.value = "5";
      input.setCustomValidity("");
      input.style.borderColor = "var(--red)";
      input.style.boxShadow = "0 0 0 3px rgba(220,38,38,.10)";

      window.setTimeout(function () {
        input.style.borderColor = "";
        input.style.boxShadow = "";
      }, 1200);

      if (showMessage && window.frappe && frappe.show_alert) {
        frappe.show_alert({
          message: "Maximum discount for one approver is 5%. Value changed to 5%.",
          indicator: "orange"
        }, 4);
      }
      return true;
    }

    input.setCustomValidity("");
    return false;
  }

  window.lifeClampApprovalPercent = function (input) {
    var changed = clampApprovalPercent(input, true);

    if (input && /^v21-pct-/.test(input.id || "") && window.lifeV21UpdateSummary) {
      lifeV21UpdateSummary();
    }
    if (input && /^v22-pct-/.test(input.id || "") && window.lifeV22Recalc) {
      lifeV22Recalc();
    }
    return changed;
  };

  document.addEventListener("input", function (event) {
    var input = event.target;
    if (input && LEVEL_IDS.test(input.id || "")) {
      lifeClampApprovalPercent(input);
    }
  }, true);

  document.addEventListener("paste", function (event) {
    var input = event.target;
    if (input && LEVEL_IDS.test(input.id || "")) {
      window.setTimeout(function () {
        lifeClampApprovalPercent(input);
      }, 0);
    }
  }, true);

  document.addEventListener("blur", function (event) {
    var input = event.target;
    if (!input || !LEVEL_IDS.test(input.id || "")) return;

    if (input.value === "") return;
    var value = Number(input.value);

    if (isFinite(value) && value > 0 && value < 0.5) {
      input.value = "0.5";
      if (/^v21-pct-/.test(input.id) && window.lifeV21UpdateSummary) {
        lifeV21UpdateSummary();
      }
      if (/^v22-pct-/.test(input.id) && window.lifeV22Recalc) {
        lifeV22Recalc();
      }
    }
  }, true);

  /* Server-bound safety: clamp every selected level immediately before the
     existing bill payload is collected. The existing multi-request function
     still creates L1, L2 and L3 together in one API call. */
  var previousBillPayloadV25 = billPayload;
  billPayload = function () {
    ["L1", "L2", "L3"].forEach(function (level) {
      clampApprovalPercent(_g("v21-pct-" + level), false);
    });
    return previousBillPayloadV25.apply(this, arguments);
  };

  /* Recalculate the generation-screen summary with per-level validation. */
  var previousSummaryV25 = window.lifeV21UpdateSummary;
  window.lifeV21UpdateSummary = function () {
    var invalidLevel = "";
    var total = 0;
    var count = 0;

    ["L1", "L2", "L3"].forEach(function (level) {
      var selected = _g("v21-on-" + level);
      var input = _g("v21-pct-" + level);

      if (input) clampApprovalPercent(input, false);

      if (selected && selected.checked) {
        var value = Number(input && input.value);
        count += 1;
        if (!(value >= 0.5 && value <= 5)) invalidLevel = level;
        else total += value;
      }
    });

    if (previousSummaryV25) previousSummaryV25();

    var summary = _g("v21-summary");
    if (summary && invalidLevel) {
      summary.style.color = "var(--red)";
      summary.innerHTML =
        "<b>" + invalidLevel + " discount must be between 0.5% and 5%.</b>";
    }

    return {
      count: count,
      total: total,
      valid: !invalidLevel && total <= 15
    };
  };
})();

<script id="life-direct-email-bill-v5-script">

(function () {

    var directStarted = false;
    var directRequest = null;
    var directInvoice = null;
    var directInvoiceDoc = null;


    function getEmailParameters() {

        var searches = [];

        searches.push(
            window.location.search || ""
        );

        try {
            if (
                window.parent &&
                window.parent !== window
            ) {
                searches.push(
                    window.parent.location.search || ""
                );
            }
        } catch (error) {}

        var completeSearch =
            searches.join("&");

        var parameters =
            new URLSearchParams(
                completeSearch.replace(/^\?/, "")
            );

        return {
            invoice:
                parameters.get("invoice") || "",

            request:
                parameters.get("request") || ""
        };
    }


    function removeElement(id) {

        var element =
            document.getElementById(id);

        if (
            element &&
            element.parentNode
        ) {
            element.parentNode.removeChild(
                element
            );
        }
    }


    function showLoader() {

        if (
            document.getElementById(
                "life-email-bill-loader"
            )
        ) {
            return;
        }

        var loader =
            document.createElement("div");

        loader.id =
            "life-email-bill-loader";

        loader.innerHTML =
            '<div class="life-email-loader-card">' +
                '<div class="life-email-spinner"></div>' +
                "<div>Opening approval bill…</div>" +
                '<div style="margin-top:5px;' +
                'color:#789889;font-size:12px">' +
                    "Please wait" +
                "</div>" +
            "</div>";

        document.body.appendChild(loader);
    }


    function showError(message) {

        removeElement(
            "life-email-bill-actions"
        );

        var loader =
            document.getElementById(
                "life-email-bill-loader"
            );

        if (!loader) {
            showLoader();

            loader =
                document.getElementById(
                    "life-email-bill-loader"
                );
        }

        loader.innerHTML =
            '<div class="life-email-result-card">' +
                '<div class="life-email-result-icon">' +
                    "⚠️" +
                "</div>" +
                '<div class="life-email-result-message">' +
                    esc(message) +
                "</div>" +
            "</div>";
    }


    function isAuthorized(request) {

        if (!request) {
            return false;
        }

        var selectedUser = String(
            request.selected_approver || ""
        ).trim().toLowerCase();

        var loggedInUser = String(
            CURRENT_USER || ""
        ).trim().toLowerCase();

        if (
            selectedUser &&
            loggedInUser &&
            loggedInUser !== "guest" &&
            selectedUser === loggedInUser
        ) {
            return true;
        }

        if (
            typeof SUPER_APPROVERS !==
                "undefined" &&

            SUPER_APPROVERS.map(function (user) {
                return String(
                    user || ""
                ).trim().toLowerCase();
            }).indexOf(
                loggedInUser
            ) >= 0
        ) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }


    function requestSummary(request) {

        var level =
            request.approval_level || "L1";

        var requestedFinal =
            parseFloat(
                request.requested_final_amount || 0
            );

        if (
            level === "L4" ||
            requestedFinal > 0
        ) {
            return (
                level +
                " · Final " +
                fmtM(requestedFinal)
            );
        }

        return (
            level +
            " · " +
            parseFloat(
                request.requested_discount_pct || 0
            ) +
            "%"
        );
    }


    function setExactGlobals() {

        BILL_DOC =
    directInvoiceDoc || {
        name:directInvoice
    };

/*
 * Do NOT replace the complete L1/L2/L3/L4 chain
 * with only the request opened from email.
 */
BILL_REQS =
    Array.isArray(BILL_REQS)
        ? BILL_REQS
        : [];

/*
 * Keep/update this exact request only until the complete
 * sibling history is refreshed from the backend.
 */
var directIndex = -1;

for(var i=0;i<BILL_REQS.length;i++){

    if(
        BILL_REQS[i] &&
        BILL_REQS[i].name === directRequest.name
    ){
        directIndex=i;
        break;
    }
}

if(directIndex>=0){

    BILL_REQS[directIndex]=
        directRequest;

}else{

    BILL_REQS.push(
        directRequest
    );
}
    }


    function renderActionBar() {

        removeElement(
            "life-email-bill-actions"
        );

        if (
            !directRequest ||
            !isAuthorized(directRequest)
        ) {
            return;
        }

        var actionBar =
            document.createElement("div");

        actionBar.id =
            "life-email-bill-actions";

        actionBar.innerHTML =
            '<div class="life-email-action-summary">' +
                "<span>" +
                    esc(directInvoice) +
                "</span>" +
                "<span>" +
                    esc(
                        requestSummary(
                            directRequest
                        )
                    ) +
                "</span>" +
            "</div>" +

            '<button type="button" ' +
            'id="life-email-approve" ' +
            'class="life-email-action-button">' +
                "✓ Approve" +
            "</button>" +

            '<button type="button" ' +
            'id="life-email-reject" ' +
            'class="life-email-action-button">' +
                "✕ Reject" +
            "</button>";

        document.body.appendChild(
            actionBar
        );

        document.getElementById(
            "life-email-approve"
        ).onclick = function () {

            setExactGlobals();

            billApprove(
                directRequest.name
            );
        };

        document.getElementById(
            "life-email-reject"
        ).onclick = function () {

            setExactGlobals();

            billReject(
                directRequest.name
            );
        };
    }


    function openExactBill(
        invoiceName,
        requestName
    ) {

        showLoader();

        /*
         * First load the exact approval request.
         */
        /*
         * Resolve the authenticated ERPNext user directly from
         * the server before checking the selected approver.
         */
        call(
            "frappe.auth.get_logged_user",
            {}
        )

        .then(function (authenticatedUser) {

            var resolvedUser = "";

            if (
                typeof authenticatedUser === "string"
            ) {
                resolvedUser =
                    authenticatedUser;
            }

            else if (
                authenticatedUser &&
                authenticatedUser.user
            ) {
                resolvedUser =
                    authenticatedUser.user;
            }

            else if (
                authenticatedUser &&
                authenticatedUser.message
            ) {
                resolvedUser =
                    authenticatedUser.message;
            }

            resolvedUser = String(
                resolvedUser || ""
            ).trim();

            if (
                !resolvedUser ||
                resolvedUser === "Guest"
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Your ERP login session could not be verified. " +
                    "Please sign in again."
                );
            }

            CURRENT_USER =
                resolvedUser;

            return getDoc(
                "Discount Approval Request",
                requestName
            );
        })

        .then(function (request) {

            if (!request) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Approval request was not found."
                );
            }

            if (
                request.linked_invoice !==
                invoiceName
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Approval request and invoice do not match."
                );
            }

            if (
                request.status !== "Pending"
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    "This request is already " +
                    request.status +
                    "."
                );
            }

            if (!isAuthorized(request)) {
                throw new Error(
                    "You are not the selected approver."
                );
            }

            directRequest =
                request;

            return getDoc(
                "Sales Invoice",
                invoiceName
            );
        })

        .then(function (invoiceDocument) {

            directInvoiceDoc =
                invoiceDocument || {
                    name:invoiceName
                };

            setExactGlobals();

            document.documentElement.classList.add(
                "life-email-bill-mode"
            );

            /*
             * Open exact bill directly.
             * Do not open the Discount Approvals list.
             */
            openBill(invoiceName);

            setTimeout(function () {

                /*
                 * openBill loads all approval history.
                 * Reset action variables to exact email request.
                 */
                setExactGlobals();

                removeElement(
                    "life-email-bill-loader"
                );

                renderActionBar();

                var billModal =
                    _g("m-bill");

                if (billModal) {
                    var modalBody =
                        billModal.querySelector(
                            ".m-body"
                        );

                    if (modalBody) {
                        modalBody.scrollTop = 0;
                    }
                }

            }, 900);
        })

        .catch(function (error) {

            document.documentElement.classList.remove(
                "life-email-bill-mode"
            );

            var message =
                error &&
                error.message
                    ? error.message
                    : serverErr(error);

            showError(message);
        });
    }


    function startDirectEmailBill() {

        if (directStarted) {
            return true;
        }

        var parameters =
            getEmailParameters();

        if (
            !parameters.invoice ||
            !parameters.request
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        if (
            typeof getDoc !== "function" ||
            typeof openBill !== "function" ||
            typeof billApprove !== "function" ||
            typeof billReject !== "function" ||
            typeof CURRENT_USER === "undefined" ||
            !CURRENT_USER ||
            CURRENT_USER === "Guest"
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        directStarted = true;

        directInvoice =
            parameters.invoice;

        openExactBill(
            parameters.invoice,
            parameters.request
        );

        return true;
    }


    /*
     * Show loader early when this URL is from an approval email.
     */
    var initialParameters =
        getEmailParameters();

    if (
        initialParameters.invoice &&
        initialParameters.request
    ) {
        if (document.body) {
            showLoader();
        } else {
            document.addEventListener(
                "DOMContentLoaded",
                showLoader
            );
        }
    }


    /*
     * Wait until the Billing module finishes loading.
     */
    var attempts = 0;

    var startTimer =
        setInterval(function () {

            attempts += 1;

            if (startDirectEmailBill()) {
                clearInterval(
                    startTimer
                );
            }

            if (attempts >= 160) {

                clearInterval(
                    startTimer
                );

                if (!directStarted) {
                    removeElement(
                        "life-email-bill-loader"
                    );
                }
            }

        }, 250);

})();

</script>


<script id="life-billing-url-sync-v10-script">

(function () {

    if (window.__lifeBillingUrlSyncV10) {
        return;
    }

    window.__lifeBillingUrlSyncV10 = true;


    function getTargetWindow() {

        try {
            if (
                window.parent &&
                window.parent !== window &&
                window.parent.history &&
                window.parent.location
            ) {
                return window.parent;
            }
        } catch (error) {}

        return window;
    }


    function cleanViewName(viewName) {

        var allowed = [
            "billing",
            "recent",
            "pending",
            "collections",
            "approvals"
        ];

        if (
            allowed.indexOf(viewName) < 0
        ) {
            return "billing";
        }

        return viewName;
    }


    function updatePortalUrl(viewName) {

        viewName =
            cleanViewName(viewName);

        var targetWindow =
            getTargetWindow();

        var targetPath;

        /*
         * Billing inside life-home:
         * update the parent portal URL.
         */
        if (
            targetWindow.location.pathname
                .indexOf("/life-home") >= 0
        ) {
            targetPath =
                "/life-home" +
                "?view=billing" +
                "&billing_view=" +
                encodeURIComponent(viewName);
        }

        /*
         * Direct billing-v2:
         * keep billing-v2 as the route.
         */
        else {
            targetPath =
                "/billing-v2" +
                "?view=" +
                encodeURIComponent(viewName);
        }

        /*
         * invoice and request parameters are intentionally removed.
         */
        targetWindow.history.replaceState(
            {
                lifeBillingView:viewName
            },
            "",
            targetPath
        );
    }


    function currentBillingView() {

        if (
            typeof ACTIVE_VIEW !== "undefined" &&
            ACTIVE_VIEW
        ) {
            return cleanViewName(
                ACTIVE_VIEW
            );
        }

        var activeButton =
            document.querySelector(
                ".nav-pill.active[data-v]"
            );

        if (activeButton) {
            return cleanViewName(
                activeButton.getAttribute(
                    "data-v"
                )
            );
        }

        return "billing";
    }


    function bindTabUrlUpdates() {

        var buttons =
            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".nav-pill[data-v]"
            );

        Array.prototype.forEach.call(
            buttons,
            function (button) {

                if (
                    button.getAttribute(
                        "data-life-url-bound"
                    ) === "1"
                ) {
                    return;
                }

                button.setAttribute(
                    "data-life-url-bound",
                    "1"
                );

                button.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    function () {

                        var selectedView =
                            button.getAttribute(
                                "data-v"
                            ) || "billing";

                        /*
                         * Let the existing showView() finish first.
                         */
                        setTimeout(function () {
                            updatePortalUrl(
                                selectedView
                            );
                        }, 30);
                    }
                );
            }
        );
    }


    function emailParametersExist() {

        var locations = [];

        try {
            locations.push(
                window.location.search || ""
            );
        } catch (error) {}

        try {
            if (
                window.parent &&
                window.parent !== window
            ) {
                locations.push(
                    window.parent.location.search || ""
                );
            }
        } catch (error) {}

        var combined =
            locations.join("&");

        return (
            combined.indexOf("invoice=") >= 0 &&
            combined.indexOf("request=") >= 0
        );
    }


    function cleanUrlAfterBillOpens() {

        if (!emailParametersExist()) {
            return;
        }

        var attempts = 0;

        var modalTimer =
            setInterval(function () {

                attempts += 1;

                var billModal =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "m-bill"
                    );

                var modalOpen = false;

                if (billModal) {
                    modalOpen = (
                        billModal.classList.contains(
                            "show"
                        ) ||
                        window.getComputedStyle(
                            billModal
                        ).display !== "none"
                    );
                }

                if (modalOpen) {

                    clearInterval(
                        modalTimer
                    );

                    /*
                     * The exact bill is already open.
                     * The email parameters are no longer needed.
                     */
                    updatePortalUrl(
                        currentBillingView()
                    );
                }

                if (attempts >= 100) {
                    clearInterval(
                        modalTimer
                    );
                }

            }, 200);
    }


    function startUrlSync() {

        bindTabUrlUpdates();
        cleanUrlAfterBillOpens();

        /*
         * Rebind if the navigation is rendered again.
         */
        var observer =
            new MutationObserver(function () {
                bindTabUrlUpdates();
            });

        observer.observe(
            document.body,
            {
                childList:true,
                subtree:true
            }
        );
    }


    if (document.body) {
        startUrlSync();
    } else {
        document.addEventListener(
            "DOMContentLoaded",
            startUrlSync
        );
    }

})();

</script>

<script id="life-email-recent-level-actions-v11-script">

(function () {

    var parameters =
        new URLSearchParams(
            window.location.search || ""
        );

    var invoiceName =
        parameters.get("invoice") || "";

    var requestName =
        parameters.get("request") || "";

    if (
        !invoiceName ||
        !requestName
    ) {
        return;
    }


    /*
     * Email route always opens Recent Bills first.
     * V5 then opens the particular invoice automatically.
     */
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(
            "life_billing_active_view_v1",
            "recent"
        );
    } catch (error) {}


    /*
     * After the particular invoice opens, remove only the
     * invoice/request parameters. Keep view=recent.
     */
    var attempts = 0;

    var cleanTimer =
        setInterval(function () {

            attempts += 1;

            var modal =
                document.getElementById(
                    "m-bill"
                );

            var modalOpen = false;

            if (modal) {
                modalOpen = (
                    modal.classList.contains("show") ||
                    window.getComputedStyle(
                        modal
                    ).display !== "none"
                );
            }

            if (modalOpen) {

                clearInterval(
                    cleanTimer
                );

                window.history.replaceState(
                    {
                        lifeBillingView:"recent"
                    },
                    "",
                    "/billing-v2?view=recent"
                );
            }

            if (attempts >= 100) {
                clearInterval(
                    cleanTimer
                );
            }

        }, 200);

})();

<script id="life-billing-offer-doctor-v1-script">
(function () {
    if (window.__lifeBillingOfferDoctorV1) return;
    window.__lifeBillingOfferDoctorV1 = true;

    function el(id) {
        return document.getElementById(id);
    }

    function val(id) {
        var node = el(id);
        return node ? String(node.value || "").trim() : "";
    }

    function normalise(value) {
        value = String(value || "")
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase()
            .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");

        if (value === "himayathnagar") return "himayatnagar";
        if (value === "chandhanagar") return "chandanagar";

        return value;
    }

    function isDoctor(practitioner) {
        var designation = String(
            practitioner.designation || ""
        ).toLowerCase();

        return (
            designation.indexOf("doctor") >= 0 ||
            designation.indexOf("dermat") >= 0 ||
            designation.indexOf("physician") >= 0 ||
            designation.indexOf("medical officer") >= 0
        );
    }

    function doctorsForSelectedBranch() {
        var selectedBranch = normalise(val("bl-branch"));

        var doctors = (
            typeof PRACTITIONERS !== "undefined"
                ? PRACTITIONERS
                : []
        ).filter(function (practitioner) {
            /*
             * Strict branch filtering:
             * custom_available_all_branches is intentionally ignored.
             */
            return (
                isDoctor(practitioner) &&
                normalise(practitioner.branch) === selectedBranch
            );
        });

        if (typeof dedupePractitioners === "function") {
            doctors = dedupePractitioners(doctors);
        }

        doctors.sort(function (left, right) {
            return String(
                left.practitioner_name || left.name || ""
            ).localeCompare(
                String(right.practitioner_name || right.name || "")
            );
        });

        return doctors;
    }

    function clearDoctor() {
        if (el("life-doctor-id")) {
            el("life-doctor-id").value = "";
        }

        if (el("life-doctor-name")) {
            el("life-doctor-name").value = "";
        }

        if (el("life-doctor-search")) {
            el("life-doctor-search").value = "";
        }

        if (el("life-doctor-selected")) {
            el("life-doctor-selected").innerHTML = "";
        }

        if (el("life-doctor-dd")) {
            el("life-doctor-dd").classList.remove("show");
        }
    }

    function renderDoctors() {
        var dropdown = el("life-doctor-dd");
        var input = el("life-doctor-search");

        if (!dropdown || !input) return;

        var query = String(input.value || "")
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();

        var doctors = doctorsForSelectedBranch();

        if (query) {
            doctors = doctors.filter(function (doctor) {
                var searchText = (
                    String(doctor.practitioner_name || "") +
                    " " +
                    String(doctor.name || "") +
                    " " +
                    String(doctor.designation || "")
                ).toLowerCase();

                return searchText.indexOf(query) >= 0;
            });
        }

        doctors = doctors.slice(0, 50);

        if (!doctors.length) {
            dropdown.innerHTML =
                '<div class="tp-dd-item">' +
                "No active doctor found for " +
                (typeof esc === "function"
                    ? esc(val("bl-branch"))
                    : val("bl-branch")) +
                "</div>";

            dropdown.classList.add("show");
            return;
        }

        dropdown.innerHTML = doctors.map(function (doctor) {
            var doctorName =
                doctor.practitioner_name || doctor.name;

            return (
                '<div class="tp-dd-item" ' +
                'data-doctor-id="' +
                esc(doctor.name) +
                '" data-doctor-name="' +
                esc(doctorName) +
                '">' +
                "<span><b>" +
                esc(doctorName) +
                "</b>" +
                '<span style="display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--txt3)">' +
                esc(doctor.designation || "Doctor") +
                " · " +
                esc(doctor.branch || "") +
                "</span></span></div>"
            );
        }).join("");

        dropdown.classList.add("show");

        Array.prototype.forEach.call(
            dropdown.querySelectorAll("[data-doctor-id]"),
            function (option) {
                option.onclick = function () {
                    var id = option.getAttribute("data-doctor-id");
                    var name =
                        option.getAttribute("data-doctor-name");

                    el("life-doctor-id").value = id;
                    el("life-doctor-name").value = name;
                    el("life-doctor-search").value = name;
                    el("life-doctor-selected").innerHTML =
                        "✓ " + esc(name);

                    dropdown.classList.remove("show");
                };
            }
        );
    }

    function insertDoctorField() {
        if (el("life-doctor-search")) return;

        var consultantInput = el("bl-prac-search");
        if (!consultantInput || !consultantInput.parentElement) {
            return;
        }

        var wrapper = document.createElement("div");
        wrapper.className = "life-doctor-field";

        wrapper.innerHTML =
            '<label class="f-lbl">' +
            'Doctor Consultant ' +
            '<span style="color:var(--txt4);font-size:10px">' +
            "(Optional)</span></label>" +
            '<input class="f-inp" id="life-doctor-search" ' +
            'placeholder="Search doctor from selected branch…" ' +
            'autocomplete="off">' +
            '<input type="hidden" id="life-doctor-id">' +
            '<input type="hidden" id="life-doctor-name">' +
            '<div class="tp-dd" id="life-doctor-dd"></div>' +
            '<div id="life-doctor-selected"></div>';

        consultantInput.parentElement.insertAdjacentElement(
            "afterend",
            wrapper
        );

        el("life-doctor-search").addEventListener(
            "focus",
            renderDoctors
        );

        el("life-doctor-search").addEventListener(
            "input",
            function () {
                if (el("life-doctor-id")) {
                    el("life-doctor-id").value = "";
                }

                if (el("life-doctor-name")) {
                    el("life-doctor-name").value = "";
                }

                if (el("life-doctor-selected")) {
                    el("life-doctor-selected").innerHTML = "";
                }

                renderDoctors();
            }
        );

        var branch = el("bl-branch");

        if (
            branch &&
            branch.getAttribute("data-life-doctor-bound") !== "1"
        ) {
            branch.setAttribute(
                "data-life-doctor-bound",
                "1"
            );

            branch.addEventListener("change", clearDoctor);
        }
    }

    /*
     * The live bootstrap currently returns only the first child item
     * from PRLE-0389. Expand that same valid rule to Hair PRP and
     * Skin PRP inside this new webpage.
     */
    function fixPrpOffers() {
        if (
            typeof OFFERS === "undefined" ||
            !Array.isArray(OFFERS)
        ) {
            return;
        }

        var prpRule = null;

        OFFERS.forEach(function (offer) {
            if (
                offer.name === "PRLE-0389" ||
                (
                    String(offer.title || "")
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .indexOf("prp special offer") >= 0 &&
                    parseFloat(offer.rate || 0) === 3999
                )
            ) {
                prpRule = offer;
            }
        });

        if (!prpRule) return;

        ["Hair PRP", "Skin PRP"].forEach(function (itemCode) {
            var exists = OFFERS.some(function (offer) {
                return (
                    offer.name === prpRule.name &&
                    String(offer.item_code || "").trim() === itemCode
                );
            });

            if (!exists) {
                var copiedRule = {};

                Object.keys(prpRule).forEach(function (key) {
                    copiedRule[key] = prpRule[key];
                });

                copiedRule.item_code = itemCode;
                copiedRule.apply_on = "Item Code";
                copiedRule.price_or_product_discount = "Price";
                copiedRule.rate = 3999;

                OFFERS.push(copiedRule);
            }
        });
    }

    function connectPayload() {
        if (
            typeof billPayload !== "function" ||
            billPayload.__lifeDoctorConnected
        ) {
            return;
        }

        var originalBillPayload = billPayload;

        billPayload = function () {
            var payload = originalBillPayload.apply(
                this,
                arguments
            );

            payload.doctor_practitioner =
                val("life-doctor-id");

            payload.doctor_name =
                val("life-doctor-name");

            return payload;
        };

        billPayload.__lifeDoctorConnected = true;
    }

    function initialise() {
        fixPrpOffers();
        insertDoctorField();
        connectPayload();

        var observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
            fixPrpOffers();
            insertDoctorField();
            connectPayload();
        });

        observer.observe(document.body, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true
        });

        document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
            if (
                !event.target.closest(".life-doctor-field") &&
                el("life-doctor-dd")
            ) {
                el("life-doctor-dd").classList.remove("show");
            }
        });
    }

    if (document.body) {
        initialise();
    } else {
        document.addEventListener(
            "DOMContentLoaded",
            initialise
        );
    }
})();
</script>

<script id="life-duplicate-offer-v2-script">
(function () {
    if (window.__lifeDuplicateOfferV2) return;
    window.__lifeDuplicateOfferV2 = true;

    var pricingRulesLoaded = false;
    var pricingRulesLoading = false;

    function node(id) {
        return document.getElementById(id);
    }

    function clean(value) {
        return String(value || "")
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase()
            .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    }

    function showMessage(message, colour) {
        if (typeof alertMsg === "function") {
            alertMsg(message, colour || "red");
        } else if (typeof frappe !== "undefined") {
            frappe.msgprint(message);
        }
    }

    function selectedTherapies(excludeRow) {
        var selected = [];

        document.querySelectorAll(
            "#bl-lines .tp-row"
        ).forEach(function (row) {
            if (row === excludeRow) return;

            var input = row.querySelector(".tp-search");
            var therapy = clean(input ? input.value : "");

            if (therapy) selected.push(therapy);
        });

        return selected;
    }

    function therapyAlreadySelected(therapy, currentRow) {
        therapy = clean(therapy);

        if (!therapy) return false;

        return selectedTherapies(currentRow)
            .indexOf(therapy) >= 0;
    }

    function clearDuplicateRow(row) {
        if (!row) return;

        var index = parseInt(
            row.getAttribute("data-i"),
            10
        );

        var search = row.querySelector(".tp-search");
        var quantity = row.querySelector(".tp-qty");
        var rate = row.querySelector(".tp-rate");
        var amount = row.querySelector(".tp-amt");
        var range = row.querySelector(".tp-range");
        var category = row.querySelector(".tp-cat");
        var offer = row.querySelector(".tp-offer");

        if (search) {
            search.value = "";
            search.classList.add("life-duplicate-therapy");

            setTimeout(function () {
                search.classList.remove(
                    "life-duplicate-therapy"
                );
                search.focus();
            }, 1000);
        }

        if (quantity) quantity.value = 1;
        if (rate) {
            rate.value = 0;
            rate.disabled = false;
        }
        if (amount) amount.value = 0;
        if (range) range.innerHTML = "—";
        if (category) category.innerHTML = "";
        if (offer) offer.innerHTML = "";

        if (
            typeof BILL !== "undefined" &&
            BILL.lines &&
            !isNaN(index) &&
            BILL.lines[index]
        ) {
            BILL.lines[index] = {
                therapy:"",
                qty:1,
                rate:0
            };
        }

        if (typeof recalc === "function") {
            recalc();
        }
    }

    function validateAllDuplicates(showError) {
        var used = {};
        var duplicateNames = [];

        document.querySelectorAll(
            "#bl-lines .tp-row"
        ).forEach(function (row) {
            var input = row.querySelector(".tp-search");
            var originalName = String(
                input ? input.value : ""
            ).trim();

            var key = clean(originalName);

            if (!key) return;

            if (used[key]) {
                duplicateNames.push(originalName);

                if (input) {
                    input.classList.add(
                        "life-duplicate-therapy"
                    );
                }
            } else {
                used[key] = true;

                if (input) {
                    input.classList.remove(
                        "life-duplicate-therapy"
                    );
                }
            }
        });

        duplicateNames = duplicateNames.filter(
            function (name, index, list) {
                return list.indexOf(name) === index;
            }
        );

        if (duplicateNames.length && showError) {
            showMessage(
                "Duplicate Therapy Type is not allowed: " +
                duplicateNames.join(", ") +
                ". Increase Sessions in the existing row instead.",
                "red"
            );
        }

        return duplicateNames.length === 0;
    }

    /*
     * Block duplicate selection before the existing dropdown
     * click handler saves it into BILL.lines.
     */
    document.addEventListener(
        "click",
        function (event) {
            var option = event.target.closest(
                "#bl-lines .tp-dd-item[data-n]"
            );

            if (!option) return;

            var row = option.closest(".tp-row");
            var therapy = option.getAttribute("data-n");

            if (therapyAlreadySelected(therapy, row)) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                event.stopImmediatePropagation();

                clearDuplicateRow(row);

                showMessage(
                    therapy +
                    " is already selected. Please increase Sessions " +
                    "in the existing row.",
                    "red"
                );
            }
        },
        true
    );

    /*
     * Also catch a duplicate typed manually.
     */
    document.addEventListener(
        "change",
        function (event) {
            if (
                !event.target.matches(
                    "#bl-lines .tp-search"
                )
            ) {
                return;
            }

            var row = event.target.closest(".tp-row");

            if (
                therapyAlreadySelected(
                    event.target.value,
                    row
                )
            ) {
                var therapy = event.target.value;

                clearDuplicateRow(row);

                showMessage(
                    therapy +
                    " is already selected. Duplicate Therapy Types " +
                    "are not allowed.",
                    "red"
                );
            }
        },
        true
    );

    /*
     * Final protection before previewing or generating.
     */
    document.addEventListener(
        "click",
        function (event) {
            var action = event.target.closest(
                "#bl-preview, #bl-generate"
            );

            if (!action) return;

            if (!validateAllDuplicates(true)) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            }
        },
        true
    );

    function uniqueRecords(records) {
        var output = [];
        var seen = {};

        (records || []).forEach(function (record) {
            if (!record || !record.name) return;
            if (seen[record.name]) return;

            seen[record.name] = true;
            output.push(record);
        });

        return output;
    }

    function pricingRuleIsValid(rule, today) {
        if (!rule || parseInt(rule.disable || 0, 10)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (
            parseInt(rule.selling || 0, 10) !== 1
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        var fromDate = String(
            rule.valid_from || ""
        ).slice(0, 10);

        var toDate = String(
            rule.valid_upto || ""
        ).slice(0, 10);

        if (fromDate && fromDate > today) return false;
        if (toDate && toDate < today) return false;

        return true;
    }

    function rerenderAllOffers() {
        if (
            typeof offerCheckRow !== "function" ||
            typeof BILL === "undefined"
        ) {
            return;
        }

        document.querySelectorAll(
            "#bl-lines .tp-row"
        ).forEach(function (row) {
            var index = parseInt(
                row.getAttribute("data-i"),
                10
            );

            if (
                !isNaN(index) &&
                BILL.lines &&
                BILL.lines[index] &&
                BILL.lines[index].therapy
            ) {
                offerCheckRow(row, index);
            }
        });
    }

    function loadPricingRuleItems(rules) {
        /*
         * Do not query Pricing Rule Item Code directly.
         * Frappe blocks direct child-table get_list calls for
         * portal users with check_parent_permission().
         *
         * Fetch the permitted parent Pricing Rule documents
         * and read their items child tables instead.
         */

        if (
            !rules ||
            !rules.length ||
            typeof getDoc !== "function"
        ) {
            return Promise.resolve([]);
        }

        var requests = rules.map(function (rule) {
            return getDoc(
                "Pricing Rule",
                rule.name
            )

            .then(function (document) {
                var rows = [];

                (document.items || []).forEach(
                    function (item) {
                        if (!item.item_code) return;

                        rows.push({
                            parent:document.name,
                            item_code:String(
                                item.item_code
                            ).trim(),
                            uom:item.uom || "",
                            idx:parseInt(
                                item.idx || 0,
                                10
                            )
                        });
                    }
                );

                return rows;
            })

            .catch(function (error) {
                console.warn(
                    "[LIFE Billing] Could not read Pricing Rule",
                    rule.name,
                    error
                );

                return [];
            });
        });

        return Promise.all(requests)
            .then(function (results) {
                var itemRows = [];

                results.forEach(function (rows) {
                    (rows || []).forEach(
                        function (row) {
                            itemRows.push(row);
                        }
                    );
                });

                return itemRows;
            });
    }

    function buildOffers(rules, itemRows, today) {
        var ruleMap = {};
        var offers = [];

        rules.forEach(function (rule) {
            if (pricingRuleIsValid(rule, today)) {
                ruleMap[rule.name] = rule;
            }
        });

        (itemRows || []).forEach(function (itemRow) {
            var rule = ruleMap[itemRow.parent];

            if (!rule || !itemRow.item_code) return;

            offers.push({
                name:rule.name,
                title:rule.title || rule.name,
                apply_on:"Item Code",
                item_code:String(
                    itemRow.item_code
                ).trim(),
                uom:itemRow.uom || "",
                price_or_product_discount:
                    rule.price_or_product_discount || "Price",
                rate_or_discount:
                    rule.rate_or_discount || "",
                rate:parseFloat(rule.rate || 0),
                discount_percentage:parseFloat(
                    rule.discount_percentage || 0
                ),
                discount_amount:parseFloat(
                    rule.discount_amount || 0
                ),
                min_qty:parseFloat(rule.min_qty || 0),
                max_qty:parseFloat(rule.max_qty || 0),
                valid_from:rule.valid_from || "",
                valid_upto:rule.valid_upto || "",
                priority:parseInt(rule.priority || 0, 10)
            });
        });

        offers.sort(function (left, right) {
            var priorityDifference =
                parseInt(right.priority || 0, 10) -
                parseInt(left.priority || 0, 10);

            if (priorityDifference) {
                return priorityDifference;
            }

            return String(right.name).localeCompare(
                String(left.name)
            );
        });

        return offers;
    }

    function loadDynamicPricingRules() {

        /*
         * IMPORTANT:
         * getList() ultimately uses the global call() wrapper.
         * Do not start this optional live refresh until Frappe's
         * request function is genuinely ready.
         */
        if (
            pricingRulesLoaded ||
            pricingRulesLoading ||
            typeof getList !== "function" ||
            typeof window.frappe === "undefined" ||
            typeof window.frappe.call !== "function"
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        pricingRulesLoading = true;

        var today =
            typeof frappe !== "undefined" &&
            frappe.datetime &&
            frappe.datetime.get_today
                ? frappe.datetime.get_today()
                : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

        var fields = [
            "name",
            "title",
            "disable",
            "selling",
            "apply_on",
            "price_or_product_discount",
            "rate_or_discount",
            "rate",
            "discount_percentage",
            "discount_amount",
            "min_qty",
            "max_qty",
            "valid_from",
            "valid_upto",
            "priority",
            "modified"
        ];

        /*
         * Query dated and no-start-date rules separately,
         * then validate both From Date and To Date again.
         */
        Promise.all([
            getList(
                "Pricing Rule",
                [
                    ["disable", "=", 0],
                    ["selling", "=", 1],
                    ["apply_on", "=", "Item Code"],
                    ["valid_from", "<=", today]
                ],
                fields,
                {
                    limit:0,
                    order_by:
                        "priority desc, modified desc"
                }
            ),

            getList(
                "Pricing Rule",
                [
                    ["disable", "=", 0],
                    ["selling", "=", 1],
                    ["apply_on", "=", "Item Code"],
                    ["valid_from", "is", "not set"]
                ],
                fields,
                {
                    limit:0,
                    order_by:
                        "priority desc, modified desc"
                }
            )
        ])

        .then(function (result) {
            var rules = uniqueRecords(
                (result[0] || []).concat(result[1] || [])
            ).filter(function (rule) {
                return pricingRuleIsValid(rule, today);
            });

            return loadPricingRuleItems(rules)
                .then(function (itemRows) {
                    return {
                        rules:rules,
                        itemRows:itemRows
                    };
                });
        })

        .then(function (result) {
            var liveOffers = buildOffers(
                result.rules,
                result.itemRows,
                today
            );

            /*
             * Replace bootstrap offers only after the complete
             * live Pricing Rule load succeeds.
             */
            if (liveOffers.length) {
                OFFERS = liveOffers;
                pricingRulesLoaded = true;
                rerenderAllOffers();

                console.info(
                    "[LIFE Billing] Active Pricing Rule offers loaded",
                    {
                        date:today,
                        rules:result.rules.length,
                        item_offers:liveOffers.length
                    }
                );
            }
        })

        .catch(function (error) {
            /*
             * Keep existing bootstrap offers if direct loading fails.
             */
            console.error(
                "[LIFE Billing] Pricing Rule load failed",
                error
            );
        })

        .finally(function () {
            pricingRulesLoading = false;
        });

        return true;
    }

    /*
     * Wait until BOTH the Billing module and Frappe request API
     * are ready. Do not clear the timer before the loader actually
     * starts.
     */
    var attempts = 0;

    var timer = setInterval(function () {

        attempts += 1;

        var frappeReady =
            typeof window.frappe !== "undefined" &&
            typeof window.frappe.call === "function";

        var billingReady =
            typeof OFFERS !== "undefined" &&
            typeof getList === "function" &&
            typeof BILL !== "undefined";

        if (
            frappeReady &&
            billingReady
        ) {

            var started =
                loadDynamicPricingRules();

            if(started===true){
                clearInterval(timer);
                return;
            }
        }

        if (attempts >= 120) {

            clearInterval(timer);

            console.warn(
                "[LIFE Billing] Dynamic Pricing Rule loader timed out waiting for Frappe. Existing bootstrap offers remain active."
            );
        }

    }, 250);
})();
</script>

<script id="life-billing-five-corrections-v1-script">
(function(){
  "use strict";

  if(window.__lifeBillingFiveCorrectionsV1) return;
  window.__lifeBillingFiveCorrectionsV1=true;

  function el(id){
    return document.getElementById(id);
  }

  function clean(v){
    return String(v==null?"":v).trim();
  }

  /* ============================================================
     1. SUMMARY CARD
     CSS above intentionally allows the summary to grow naturally
     while remaining scrollable inside the viewport.
     ============================================================ */


  /* ============================================================
     2. COMPLIMENTARY SESSION PICKER
     Use mousedown capture so selection happens before input blur.
     ============================================================ */

  function lifePickComplimentary(option){
    if(!option) return;

    var row=option.closest(".split-line");
    if(!row) return;

    var codeInput=row.querySelector(".comp-code");
    var qtyInput=row.querySelector(".comp-qty");
    var info=row.querySelector(".comp-info");
    var dropdown=row.querySelector(".comp-dd");

    var code=clean(option.getAttribute("data-c"));
    if(!code) return;

    var picked=null;
    (window.COMP_ITEMS||COMP_ITEMS||[]).forEach(function(item){
      if(clean(item.item_code)===code){
        picked=item;
      }
    });

    if(!picked) return;

    var index=parseInt(row.getAttribute("data-i")||row.dataset.i||"-1",10);
    if(!(index>=0)) return;

    var qty=Math.max(1,parseInt((qtyInput&&qtyInput.value)||1,10)||1);
    var maxQty=parseInt(picked.max_qty||0,10)||0;

    if(maxQty>0 && qty>maxQty){
      qty=maxQty;
      if(qtyInput) qtyInput.value=qty;
    }

    if(codeInput){
      codeInput.value=picked.item_name||picked.item_code||code;
      codeInput.setAttribute("data-picked-code", picked.item_code||code);
    }

    BILL.comps=BILL.comps||[];
    BILL.comps[index]={
      item_code:picked.item_code||code,
      item_name:picked.item_name||picked.item_code||code,
      qty:qty,
      comp_price:parseFloat(picked.rate||0)||0,
      max_qty_allowed:maxQty
    };

    if(info){
      info.innerHTML=
        fmtM(parseFloat(picked.rate||0)||0)+
        (maxQty?(" · max "+maxQty+"/bill"):"");
    }

    if(dropdown){
      dropdown.classList.remove("show");
    }

    try{ updateCompSlab(); }catch(e){}
  }

  document.addEventListener("mousedown",function(event){
    var option=event.target && event.target.closest
      ? event.target.closest("#bl-comp-lines .comp-dd [data-c]")
      : null;

    if(!option) return;

    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if(event.stopImmediatePropagation) event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    lifePickComplimentary(option);
  },true);


  /* ============================================================
     3 + 5. DISCOUNT APPROVAL REFRESH — WEBPAGE ONLY

     No new Server Script is used in this version.

     The existing Billing page already reads Discount Approval Request
     rows with frappe.client.get_list. We keep that flow and force a
     fresh redraw after approvals / requests so newly-created L2 rows
     and Administrator approvals appear as soon as Frappe permissions
     allow the logged-in user to read them.

     IMPORTANT:
     If Frappe permissions hide a sibling approval row from the logged-in
     user, browser JavaScript cannot bypass that security restriction.
     ============================================================ */

  function lifeRefreshOpenApprovalInvoice(invoiceName){
    invoiceName=clean(invoiceName);
    if(!invoiceName) return;

    setTimeout(function(){
      try{
        if(
          typeof BILL_DOC!=="undefined" &&
          BILL_DOC &&
          BILL_DOC.name===invoiceName &&
          typeof refreshOpenBill==="function"
        ){
          refreshOpenBill();
          return;
        }

        if(typeof openBill==="function"){
          openBill(invoiceName);
        }
      }catch(error){
        console.warn(
          "[LIFE Billing] approval refresh failed",
          error
        );
      }
    },350);
  }

  /*
   * requestNextApproval() / multi-request flow already calls openBill(inv)
   * after creation. This MutationObserver additionally refreshes the open
   * invoice when the approval drawer is re-rendered, preventing stale rows.
   */
  var lifeApprovalRefreshTimer=null;

  function lifeScheduleApprovalRefresh(){
    clearTimeout(lifeApprovalRefreshTimer);

    lifeApprovalRefreshTimer=setTimeout(function(){
      try{
        var invoiceName=
          typeof BILL_DOC!=="undefined" &&
          BILL_DOC &&
          BILL_DOC.name
            ? BILL_DOC.name
            : "";

        if(invoiceName){
          lifeRefreshOpenApprovalInvoice(
            invoiceName
          );
        }
      }catch(error){}
    },500);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     4. COMPACT SEARCH
     The old mini input called doSearch(), but doSearch renders into
     #q-dd inside the hidden hero. This renders a dedicated dropdown.
     ============================================================ */

  var miniTimer=null;

  function ensureMiniDropdown(){
    var holder=el("mini-search");
    if(!holder) return null;

    var dd=el("mini-q-dd");
    if(!dd){
      dd=document.createElement("div");
      dd.id="mini-q-dd";
      dd.className="search-dd";
      holder.appendChild(dd);
    }
    return dd;
  }

  function miniClose(){
    var dd=el("mini-q-dd");
    if(dd) dd.classList.remove("show");
  }

  function miniPickClient(pid){
    var input=el("mini-q");
    if(input) input.value="";
    miniClose();
    if(typeof openSummary==="function"){
      openSummary(pid);
    }
  }

  function miniRender(raw){
    var dd=ensureMiniDropdown();
    if(!dd) return;

    raw=clean(raw);

    if(raw.length<3){
      dd.classList.remove("show");
      dd.innerHTML="";
      return;
    }

    var looksNumeric=/^[\d\s\-+()]+$/.test(raw);
    var filters;

    if(looksNumeric){
      var digits=raw.replace(/\D/g,"");

      if(digits.length===12 && digits.slice(0,2)==="91"){
        digits=digits.slice(2);
      }else if(digits.length===11 && digits.charAt(0)==="0"){
        digits=digits.slice(1);
      }

      if(digits.length>10){
        dd.innerHTML='<div class="sd-empty">📱 A mobile number cannot be more than 10 digits</div>';
        dd.classList.add("show");
        return;
      }

      filters=[["mobile","like","%"+digits+"%"]];
    }else{
      filters=[["patient_name","like","%"+raw+"%"]];
    }

    dd.innerHTML='<div class="sd-empty">Searching…</div>';
    dd.classList.add("show");

    getListSilent(
      "Patient",
      filters,
      [
        "name",
        "patient_name",
        "mobile",
        "sex",
        "custom_branch",
        "custom_lead",
        "status"
      ],
      {
        limit:10,
        order_by:"modified desc"
      }
    ).then(function(list){
      list=list||[];

      if(!list.length){
        dd.innerHTML=
          '<div class="sd-empty">😕 No client found for "'+
          esc(raw)+
          '"</div>';
        dd.classList.add("show");
        return;
      }

      dd.innerHTML=list.map(function(p){
        return (
          '<div class="sd-item" data-mini-pid="'+esc(p.name)+'">'+
            '<div class="sd-av" style="background:'+avc(p.patient_name||p.name)+'">'+
              ini(p.patient_name||p.name)+
            '</div>'+
            '<div>'+
              '<div class="sd-name">'+esc(p.patient_name||p.name)+'</div>'+
              '<div class="sd-meta">'+
                esc(p.name)+
                ' · 📱 '+esc(p.mobile||"—")+
                ' · 📍 '+esc(p.custom_branch||"—")+
              '</div>'+
            '</div>'+
          '</div>'
        );
      }).join("");

      dd.querySelectorAll("[data-mini-pid]").forEach(function(node){
        node.addEventListener("mousedown",function(event){
          event.preventDefault();
          miniPickClient(node.getAttribute("data-mini-pid"));
        });
      });

      dd.classList.add("show");
    }).catch(function(error){
      dd.innerHTML='<div class="sd-empty" style="color:var(--red)">Search failed. Please try again.</div>';
      dd.classList.add("show");
      console.warn("[LIFE Billing] compact search failed",error);
    });
  }

  function bindMiniSearch(){
    var input=el("mini-q");
    if(!input || input.getAttribute("data-life-mini-fixed")==="1"){
      return;
    }

    input.setAttribute("data-life-mini-fixed","1");
    input.removeAttribute("oninput");

    input.addEventListener("input",function(){
      clearTimeout(miniTimer);
      var value=this.value;
      miniTimer=setTimeout(function(){
        miniRender(value);
      },220);
    });

    input.addEventListener("focus",function(){
      if(clean(this.value).length>=3){
        miniRender(this.value);
      }
    });

    ensureMiniDropdown();
  }

  document.addEventListener("mousedown",function(event){
    if(!event.target.closest("#mini-search")){
      miniClose();
    }
  });

  bindMiniSearch();

  var observer=new MutationObserver(function(){
    bindMiniSearch();
  });

  observer.observe(document.body,{
    childList:true,
    subtree:true
  });

})();
</script>
